source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 已知在题图1-3所示电压、电流参考方向下，元件A的电压、电流分别为u=-3 V、i=5 A，元件B的电压、电流分别为u=5 V、i=-2 mA，试求两元件吸收的功率。
statement.en: Under the voltage and current reference directions shown in Fig. 1-3, element A has u = -3 V and i = 5 A, while element B has u = 5 V and i = -2 mA. Find the power absorbed by each element.

alt.zh: A：电流参考方向由左向右，电压左正右负；B：电流参考方向由右向左，电压右正左负。两者电流箭头都流入电压正参考端。
alt.en: A: current points left to right, with voltage positive on the left. B: current points right to left, with voltage positive on the right. Both current references enter the positive voltage-reference terminal.

prerequisites.zh: 电压和电流参考方向；关联参考方向；功率符号与单位换算。
prerequisites.en: Voltage and current reference directions; passive sign convention; power signs and unit conversion.

recognition.zh: 先看箭头是否流入标“+”的端子，再把带符号的数值代入公式。
recognition.en: First check whether the current arrow enters the terminal marked +, then substitute the signed values.

text.zh: A和B的电流参考方向都流入电压正参考端，因此两者吸收功率公式均为p=ui。
text.en: For both A and B, the current reference enters the positive voltage-reference terminal, so absorbed power is p = ui.

text.zh: A的电压为负，按给定参考方向直接代入。负吸收功率表示该元件实际提供功率。
text.en: Substitute the signed voltage for A. A negative absorbed power means that the element delivers power.

text.zh: 把-2 mA换成-0.002 A。B的吸收功率为-0.010 W，即-10 mW。
text.en: Convert -2 mA to -0.002 A. B absorbs -0.010 W, or -10 mW.

answer.zh: A吸收-15 W（提供15 W）；B吸收-10 mW（提供10 mW）。
answer.en: A absorbs -15 W (delivers 15 W); B absorbs -10 mW (delivers 10 mW).

pitfalls.zh: 不要因i为负而翻转箭头后仍代入原负值，避免重复改符号。
pitfalls.en: Do not reverse the arrow for a negative current and then keep the original negative value; that would change the sign twice.

pitfalls.zh: mA与A相差1000倍。
pitfalls.en: mA and A differ by a factor of 1000.

methods.zh: 按关联参考方向独立计算，并与书第332页（PDF341页）1-5参考答案逐项一致。
methods.en: Independently calculated using the passive sign convention and matched item by item to answer 1-5 on printed p. 332 (PDF p. 341).

title.zh: 已知支路电流，结合KCL与KVL求未知电流
title.en: Use KCL and KVL with known branch currents

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图1-5所示电路为某电路的一部分，已知i₁=6 A，i₂=-2 A，求图中电流i。
statement.en: The circuit in Fig. 1-5 is part of a larger circuit. Given i₁ = 6 A and i₂ = -2 A, find the current i shown in the figure.

alt.zh: 三个左端口分别经3 Ω电阻接入上、中、下节点，i₁、i₂、i₃参考方向均向右。上、中节点间6 Ω，中、下节点间18 Ω，上、下节点间右支路12 Ω；待求i沿12 Ω向下。
alt.en: Three left ports connect through 3 Ω resistors to the upper, middle, and lower nodes; i₁, i₂, and i₃ all point right. There are 6 Ω between upper and middle nodes, 18 Ω between middle and lower nodes, and 12 Ω in the right branch from upper to lower, with unknown i pointing downward.

prerequisites.zh: KCL、KVL、电阻关联参考方向。
prerequisites.en: KCL, KVL, and the resistor passive sign convention.

recognition.zh: 已有两个注入电流，先用KCL把内部支路电流都写成i，再对两条上到下的路径列一次KVL；不用求三个左端口的电压。
recognition.en: With two injection currents already known, use KCL to express the internal branch currents in terms of i, then equate the voltage drops along the two upper-to-lower paths. The left-port voltages are unnecessary.

title.en: Apply KCL at the upper node

text.zh: 设6 Ω中的电流向下为i₆。流入的6 A分成i和i₆，所以i₆=6-i。
text.en: Let i₆ point downward through 6 Ω. The 6 A entering the upper node splits into i and i₆.

title.en: Apply KCL at the middle node

text.zh: 设18 Ω中的电流向下为i₁₈。i₂=-2 A已经包含参考方向的信息，因此i₁₈=i₆+i₂=4-i。
text.en: Let i₁₈ point downward through 18 Ω. The value i₂ = -2 A already includes its reference-direction sign, so i₁₈ = i₆ + i₂ = 4 - i.

title.zh: 同起点、同终点的电压相等
title.en: Equate voltage drops between the same nodes

text.zh: 上到下经12 Ω的电压降为12i；经6 Ω和18 Ω的总电压降为6(6-i)+18(4-i)。
text.en: The voltage drop from upper to lower is 12i through 12 Ω and 6(6-i) + 18(4-i) through the other path.

text.zh: 整理得36i=108，故i=3 A。正号表示实际方向与图中向下的箭头一致。
text.en: Rearranging gives 36i = 108, so i = 3 A. The positive result agrees with the downward arrow.

answer.zh: i=3 A，沿12 Ω电阻向下。
answer.en: i = 3 A, downward through the 12 Ω resistor.

pitfalls.zh: i₂=-2 A表示中间端口实际流出2 A，KCL中保留负号。
pitfalls.en: i₂ = -2 A means 2 A actually leaves the middle port; retain the negative sign in KCL.

pitfalls.zh: 三个3 Ω电阻的电流已给定或可由整体KCL确定，求i不需要先算它们的压降。
pitfalls.en: The port currents are given or follow from overall KCL; their 3 Ω voltage drops are unnecessary for finding i.

methods.zh: 第二种方法：以下节点为0 V独立列节点方程，得上节点36 V、中节点18 V，故i=36/12=3 A。内部电流i₆=3 A、i₁₈=1 A满足全部KCL；书第332页（PDF341页）答案亦为3 A。
methods.en: Independent nodal check with the lower node at 0 V gives upper 36 V and middle 18 V, hence i = 36/12 = 3 A. Internal currents i₆ = 3 A and i₁₈ = 1 A satisfy every KCL equation. The answer on printed p. 332 (PDF p. 341) is also 3 A.

title.zh: 先由电流求电阻压降，再求电流源端电压
title.en: Find current-source voltages from resistor drops

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-22所示，求两个电流源两端的电压U₁、U₂。
statement.en: For the circuit shown in Fig. 1-22, find the voltages U₁ and U₂ across the two current sources.

alt.zh: 左支路为3 A向下电流源，U₁上正下负。中支路为2 Ω电阻串联5 V电压源，电压源上正下负。上节点经过1 Ω接右支路2 A向下电流源，U₂上正下负，其下串联3 Ω回到底节点。
alt.en: Left branch: 3 A current source downward, U₁ positive at the top. Middle branch: 2 Ω resistor in series with a 5 V source positive at the top. The upper node connects through 1 Ω to a downward 2 A current source with U₂ positive at the top, followed by 3 Ω to the lower node.

prerequisites.zh: KCL、KVL、节点电位与电压参考极性。
prerequisites.en: KCL, KVL, node potentials, and voltage reference polarity.

recognition.zh: 电流源已经确定其支路电流。先对上下节点用KCL，再沿已知电压源的支路求节点电位，最后求两个电流源电压。
recognition.en: The current sources fix their branch currents. Use KCL at the common nodes, find node potentials through the branch containing the known voltage source, then compute the source voltages.

text.zh: 取底节点为0 V。3 A和2 A都向下流出顶节点，因此中支路向上电流为5 A，即按向下参考方向为-5 A。
text.en: Set the lower node to 0 V. The 3 A and 2 A branches both leave the upper node downward, so the middle branch carries 5 A upward, or -5 A under a downward reference.

text.zh: 5 V电压源上端电位为5 V；2 Ω电阻按自上而下的压降为2×(-5)=-10 V，所以顶节点电位为-5 V。U₁按上正下负，等于-5 V。
text.en: The upper terminal of the 5 V source is at 5 V. The downward voltage drop across 2 Ω is 2(-5) = -10 V, making the upper node -5 V. Since U₁ is referenced positive at the top, U₁ = -5 V.

text.zh: 右支路电流为2 A。1 Ω电阻压降2 V，故电流源上端电位为-7 V；3 Ω电阻上端电位为6 V。按U₂的上正下负参考极性相减。
text.en: The right branch carries 2 A. The 1 Ω resistor drops 2 V, so the source upper terminal is at -7 V. The upper terminal of 3 Ω is at 6 V. Subtract according to U₂’s top-positive polarity.

answer.zh: U₁=-5 V，U₂=-13 V；两者实际电压极性均与图示参考极性相反。
answer.en: U₁ = -5 V and U₂ = -13 V. Both actual voltage polarities oppose the indicated reference polarities.

pitfalls.zh: 电流源并不自动规定其端电压为正；电流箭头和电压极性是不同的参考信息。
pitfalls.en: A current source does not force its terminal voltage to be positive; the current arrow and voltage polarity are separate references.

pitfalls.zh: 题干在书第34页，图在第35页，必须同时查看。
pitfalls.en: The statement is on printed p. 34 and the figure on p. 35; both pages are required.

methods.zh: 右支路KVL：2+(-13)+6=-5 V，与U₁一致。三电阻耗散50+4+12=66 W；3 A源、2 A源和5 V源吸收功率分别为-15、-26、-25 W，合计-66 W，功率守恒。书第332页（PDF341页）给出相同的-5 V、-13 V。
methods.en: Right-branch KVL gives 2 + (-13) + 6 = -5 V, matching U₁. The resistors dissipate 50 + 4 + 12 = 66 W; the 3 A, 2 A, and 5 V sources absorb -15, -26, and -25 W, totaling -66 W. Power balances. Printed p. 332 (PDF p. 341) gives the same -5 V and -13 V.

title.zh: 受控电压源：把控制关系与KVL一起列出
title.en: Controlled voltage source: combine its law with KVL

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路题图1-24所示，求在下列条件下受控源的电压：(1) uₛ=2 V；(2) uₛ=8 V。
statement.en: For the circuit in Fig. 1-24, find the controlled-source voltage for (1) uₛ = 2 V and (2) uₛ = 8 V.

alt.zh: 左侧独立电压源uₛ上正下负；上方2 Ω电阻电压u₁左正右负；右侧受控电压源3u₁上正下负，三者组成单回路。
alt.en: The independent voltage source uₛ on the left is positive at the top. The upper 2 Ω resistor has u₁ positive on the left. The right controlled voltage source is 3u₁, positive at the top. All three form one loop.

prerequisites.zh: KVL；电压控制电压源的控制关系。
prerequisites.en: KVL and the voltage-controlled voltage-source relation.

recognition.zh: 受控源的电压不是额外给定的常数。将3u₁作为同一未知量的倍数，整圈只剩一个电压未知量。
recognition.en: The controlled-source voltage is not an independent constant. Writing it as 3u₁ leaves only one unknown voltage in the loop.

text.zh: 从左下沿顺时针绕行：独立源提供电压上升uₛ，随后两段压降为u₁与3u₁。
text.en: Going clockwise from the lower left, the independent source gives a rise uₛ, followed by drops u₁ and 3u₁.

text.zh: 因此u₁=uₛ/4；题目要求的是受控源电压3u₁，而不是电阻电压u₁。
text.en: Thus u₁ = uₛ/4. The requested voltage is 3u₁ across the controlled source, not u₁ across the resistor.

text.zh: uₛ=2 V时，u₁=0.5 V，受控源电压1.5 V；uₛ=8 V时，u₁=2 V，受控源电压6 V。
text.en: For uₛ = 2 V, u₁ = 0.5 V and the controlled-source voltage is 1.5 V. For uₛ = 8 V, u₁ = 2 V and the controlled-source voltage is 6 V.

answer.zh: (1) 1.5 V；(2) 6 V，均按图示上正下负参考极性。
answer.en: (1) 1.5 V; (2) 6 V, with the indicated top-positive polarity.

pitfalls.zh: 不要把受控源当成独立源另设任意数值，也不要把u₁作为最终答案。
pitfalls.en: Do not treat the dependent source as an arbitrary independent value or report u₁ as the requested answer.

methods.zh: 分别回代KVL：0.5+1.5=2 V，2+6=8 V；同时满足受控关系u_d=3u₁。书第332页/PDF341页1-26给出相同的1.5 V、6 V。
methods.en: Substitution gives 0.5 + 1.5 = 2 V and 2 + 6 = 8 V, and both satisfy u_d = 3u₁. Answer 1-26 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 gives the same 1.5 V and 6 V.

title.zh: 受控电流源功率：先电流，后端电压
title.en: Controlled current-source power: find current and voltage

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图1-28所示电路中各参数已给定，试求受控电流源的功率，并说明是吸收功率还是提供功率。
statement.en: All parameters of the circuit in Fig. 1-28 are given. Find the power of the controlled current source and state whether it absorbs or delivers power.

alt.zh: 底部为公共节点。左节点经1 Ω接底部；左、中节点间2 Ω，中、右节点间4 Ω，左、右节点间上支路3 Ω。中节点经上正下负的6 V电压源接底部，I₁参考向上。右节点向下先经过上负下正的12 V源，再经过大小I₁/3、方向向下的受控电流源到底部。
alt.en: The bottom is common. The left node connects to it through 1 Ω. There are 2 Ω between left and middle, 4 Ω between middle and right, and 3 Ω between left and right. A 6 V source, positive at the middle node, connects middle to bottom, with I₁ upward. From the right node downward, a 12 V source is negative at the top and positive at the bottom, followed by a downward controlled current source I₁/3.

prerequisites.zh: KCL、KVL、受控电流源；关联参考方向下的功率。
prerequisites.en: KCL, KVL, controlled current sources, and passive-sign power.

recognition.zh: 6 V源先给出中节点电位。受控源电流由I₁决定，端电压则须把右节点电位与12 V源极性一起计算，不能只用I₁/3求功率。
recognition.en: The 6 V source fixes the middle-node potential. The dependent-source current follows from I₁, but its voltage also depends on the right-node potential and 12 V source polarity.

title.en: Define node potentials and control current

text.zh: 取底节点为0 V，左、右节点分别为vL、vR，中节点为6 V。中节点KCL把I₁写成两个电阻电流之和。以下电压用V、电阻用Ω。
text.en: Set the bottom to 0 V, the left and right potentials to vL and vR, and the middle potential to 6 V. Middle-node KCL expresses I₁ as the sum of two resistor currents. Voltages are in V and resistances in Ω.

title.en: Apply KCL at the left and right nodes

text.zh: 左节点的三条电阻支路电流相加为0；右节点向下支路电流由受控源固定为I₁/3。
text.en: Sum the three resistor currents at the left node. At the right node, the downward branch current is fixed to I₁/3 by the controlled source.

text.zh: 将I₁代入右节点方程，化为(vR−vL)/2=0，故vR=vL。左节点方程随后给出vL=vR=2 V。于是I₁=2+1=3 A，受控源电流为1 A向下。
text.en: Substituting I₁ in the right-node equation reduces it to (vR−vL)/2 = 0. Hence vR = vL; the left-node equation gives both as 2 V. Then I₁ = 2 + 1 = 3 A and the controlled source carries 1 A downward.

steps.formula: v_L=v_R=2\,\mathrm V,\qquad I_1=3\,\mathrm A,\qquad I_d=1\,\mathrm A

title.zh: 根据12 V源极性求端电压和功率
title.en: Use the 12 V polarity to find voltage and power

text.zh: 12 V源下正上负，因此受控电流源上端电位为vR+12=14 V。自行取其端电压上正下负，与向下电流构成关联方向，故吸收功率为正。
text.en: The 12 V source is positive at its lower terminal, placing the controlled-source upper terminal at vR + 12 = 14 V. Referencing its voltage positive at the top is passive with the downward current, so its absorbed power is positive.

answer.zh: 受控电流源吸收14 W。
answer.en: The controlled current source absorbs 14 W.

pitfalls.zh: 12 V源的上端标“−”、下端标“+”，不能把受控源上端电位误写成vR−12。
pitfalls.en: The 12 V source is negative at its upper terminal and positive at its lower terminal; the controlled-source upper potential is vR + 12.

pitfalls.zh: 受控源是电源模型，但仍可能吸收功率；必须依据端电压与电流的共同参考方向判断。
pitfalls.en: A controlled source can absorb power. Determine the sign from both its voltage and current references.

methods.zh: 独立功率平衡：1、2、4 Ω电阻分别耗散4、8、4 W，3 Ω电流为0；6 V源吸收−18 W，12 V源吸收−12 W，受控源吸收14 W，总和16−18−12+14=0。书第332页/PDF341页1-30也给出14 W、吸收功率。
methods.en: Independent power balance: the 1, 2 and 4 Ω resistors dissipate 4, 8 and 4 W; the 3 Ω current is zero. The 6 V and 12 V sources absorb −18 and −12 W, and the controlled source absorbs 14 W: 16−18−12+14 = 0. Answer 1-30 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 is also 14 W absorbed.

title.zh: 交叉线不相连：开关前后的等效电阻
title.en: Unconnected crossing wires: resistance before and after switching

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-30所示单口网络分别在开关S打开和闭合时的等效电阻。
statement.en: Find the equivalent resistance of the one-port network in Fig. 1-30 with switch S open and with S closed.

alt.zh: a在左上，b在左下，右上与右下两节点由开关S连接。a到右上为36 Ω，a到右下斜支路也为36 Ω；b到右下为24 Ω，b到右上斜支路也为24 Ω。两条斜线在中央交叉处无连接点，互不连接。
alt.en: Terminal a is upper left and b lower left. Switch S connects the upper-right and lower-right nodes. There are 36 Ω from a to each right node and 24 Ω from b to each right node. The crossing diagonal wires have no junction and are not connected.

prerequisites.zh: 按节点判断串并联；无连接点的交叉线。
prerequisites.en: Series/parallel reduction by nodes and unconnected wire crossings.

recognition.zh: 先按导线连接关系重画，不能把中央交叉当节点。开关打开时是两条独立串联支路，闭合时是两组并联电阻串联。
recognition.en: Redraw by connectivity, keeping the central crossing disconnected. With S open there are two series paths in parallel; with S closed, two parallel groups are in series.

text.zh: a经任一右侧节点到b都必须依次经过36 Ω和24 Ω，每条路径60 Ω；两条路径只在a、b端相接。
text.en: Each a-to-b path through a right node contains 36 Ω and 24 Ω in series, making 60 Ω. The two paths meet only at a and b.

text.zh: 两个右侧节点被短接合并。a到该公共节点有两个36 Ω并联，b到该节点有两个24 Ω并联，再将两组串联。
text.en: The two right nodes merge. The two 36 Ω resistors from a are parallel, as are the two 24 Ω resistors from b. These groups are then in series.

text.zh: 原来两条路径具有相同分压比例，所以右侧两个节点本来等电位。连接等电位节点不会改变端口电流。
text.en: The two original paths have identical divider ratios, so the right nodes are already at equal potentials. Connecting them does not change terminal current.

answer.zh: S打开：30 Ω；S闭合：30 Ω。
answer.en: S open: 30 Ω. S closed: 30 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 中央导线交叉无黑点，不可自行增加连接。开关闭合也不等于把整个端口短路。
pitfalls.en: Do not add a connection at the unmarked central crossing. Closing S does not short the entire port.

methods.zh: 独立1 V测试：令Va=1 V、Vb=0，开关打开时两个右侧节点均为24/(36+24)=0.4 V；总测试电流为2×(1−0.4)/36=1/30 A，故Req=30 Ω。等电位使闭合时开关电流为0，结果仍30 Ω。书第332页/PDF341页1-32为30 Ω、30 Ω。
methods.en: Independent 1 V test: with Va = 1 V and Vb = 0, both right nodes are at 24/(36+24) = 0.4 V. Total test current is 2(1−0.4)/36 = 1/30 A, giving 30 Ω. The closed switch carries zero current between equal potentials, preserving 30 Ω. Answer 1-32 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 gives 30 Ω in both cases.

title.zh: 电源等效变换：先合并为诺顿源
title.en: Source transformation: combine Norton sources first

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 利用电源等效变换求题图1-43所示电路中的电流i。
statement.en: Use source equivalence transformations to find the current i in Fig. 1-43.

alt.zh: 三个支路并联于上、下公共节点。左支路为1 Ω电阻串联9 V电压源（上正下负）；中支路为2 Ω串联4 V电压源（上负下正）；右支路7 Ω，i向下。
alt.en: Three branches share upper and lower nodes. The left has 1 Ω in series with a 9 V source positive at the top. The middle has 2 Ω in series with a 4 V source positive at the bottom. The right has 7 Ω with i downward.

prerequisites.zh: 电压源与串联电阻的诺顿等效；电流源并联；分流公式。
prerequisites.en: Norton transformation of a voltage source and series resistor; parallel sources; current division.

recognition.zh: 两电压源的正端相反，变换后电流源方向也相反。先作带符号的电流源合并，再对7 Ω负载分流。
recognition.en: The sources have opposite polarities, so their transformed current sources oppose. Combine their signed currents before finding the 7 Ω branch current.

text.zh: 9 V串联1 Ω等效为9 A向上电流源并联1 Ω，使上节点开路电位为正。
text.en: The 9 V source with 1 Ω becomes a 9 A upward current source in parallel with 1 Ω, preserving a positive open-circuit upper potential.

title.en: Transform and combine the middle branch

text.zh: 4 V源正端在底部，等效电流源为2 A向下。两源净电流为7 A向上，内阻为1 Ω与2 Ω并联。
text.en: The 4 V source is positive at the bottom, so its Norton current is 2 A downward. The net current is 7 A upward, with 1 Ω and 2 Ω in parallel.

text.zh: 7 A在内阻2/3 Ω和负载7 Ω之间分流。i沿7 Ω向下，为正。
text.en: The 7 A divides between 2/3 Ω and the 7 Ω load. Current i is positive downward through the load.

answer.en: i = 14/23 A ≈ 0.609 A, downward.

pitfalls.zh: 中支路4 V源的正端在下方，不能把两个诺顿电流源都取向上。
pitfalls.en: The 4 V source is positive at the lower terminal; its Norton source must oppose the 9 A source.

pitfalls.zh: 源等效保持端口特性，不保证变换前后内部元件的功率逐项相同。
pitfalls.en: Source equivalence preserves port behavior, not every internal element power.

methods.zh: 直接对原电路独立列KCL：(V−9)/1+(V+4)/2+V/7=0，得V=98/23 V，i=V/7=14/23 A。书第333页/PDF342页1-45列0.61 A，与精确值四舍五入一致。
methods.en: Independent original-circuit KCL gives (V−9)/1 + (V+4)/2 + V/7 = 0, so V = 98/23 V and i = V/7 = 14/23 A. Answer 1-45 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 gives 0.61 A, matching the rounded exact value.

title.zh: 一棵树确定全部基本割集与基本回路
title.en: One spanning tree determines all fundamental cutsets and loops

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 在题图2-1(b)中选树T(3,4,5,6)，分别找出对应的基本割集和基本回路。
statement.en: In Fig. 2-1(b), choose the spanning tree T = (3, 4, 5, 6). Find the corresponding fundamental cutsets and fundamental loops.

alt.zh: 为说明拓扑，临时将左、中、右上、左下、右下节点依次命名A、B、C、D、E。有向支路为1:A→D，2:A→B，3:C→A，4:D→B，5:B→C，6:B→E，7:E→C，8:E→D。图中的G为图名。
alt.en: For description, label the left, center, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right nodes A, B, C, D and E. Directed edges are 1: A→D, 2: A→B, 3: C→A, 4: D→B, 5: B→C, 6: B→E, 7: E→C and 8: E→D. G in the source figure denotes the graph.

prerequisites.zh: 树、树支、连支、基本割集与基本回路定义。
prerequisites.en: Spanning trees, twigs, links, fundamental cutsets and fundamental loops.

recognition.zh: 基本割集逐根删除树支求；基本回路逐根加入连支求。每组必须恰含一个对应树支或连支，不能枚举任意割集、任意回路。
recognition.en: Find each fundamental cutset by deleting one twig, and each fundamental loop by adding one link. Use the specified tree rather than enumerating arbitrary cuts or loops.

text.zh: 全图5个节点、8条支路。给定4条树支3、4、5、6连通全图且不成环；剩余连支为1、2、7、8。
text.en: The graph has 5 nodes and 8 edges. Twigs 3, 4, 5 and 6 connect all nodes without a cycle. Links are 1, 2, 7 and 8.

title.en: Delete each twig for its fundamental cutset

text.zh: 删3后A与其余节点分开，跨分区边为1、2、3；删4后D孤立，跨边为1、4、8；删5后{A,C}与{B,D,E}分开，跨边为1、2、5、7；删6后E孤立，跨边为6、7、8。
text.en: Deleting 3 isolates A, giving edges 1,2,3. Deleting 4 isolates D, giving 1,4,8. Deleting 5 separates {A,C} from {B,D,E}, giving 1,2,5,7. Deleting 6 isolates E, giving 6,7,8.

title.en: Add each link for its fundamental loop

text.zh: 加入连支1，沿树中D→B→C→A闭合，得到{1,3,4,5}；加入2得到{2,3,5}；加入7得到{5,6,7}；加入8得到{4,6,8}。集合内部顺序不影响答案。
text.en: Adding link 1 closes through the tree path D→B→C→A, giving {1,3,4,5}. Adding links 2, 7 and 8 gives {2,3,5}, {5,6,7} and {4,6,8}. Set ordering does not matter.

pitfalls.zh: 基本割集恰含一条树支，其余为连支；基本回路恰含一条连支，其余为树支。
pitfalls.en: A fundamental cutset contains exactly one twig; a fundamental loop contains exactly one link.

pitfalls.zh: 题目只问支路集合；若进一步列KCL/KVL，应另按选定割集或回路方向处理正负号。
pitfalls.en: This question asks for edge sets. Signed KCL/KVL equations additionally require cutset or loop orientations.

methods.zh: 用保存的有向边表独立进行删边连通分量与树路径检查：4个割集均恰含相应一个树支，4个回路均恰含相应一个连支，数量符合n−1=4和b−n+1=4。书第333页/PDF342页2-3的所有集合相同（书中回路元素顺序略有不同）。
methods.en: An independent edge-table check of components after twig deletion and paths in the tree confirms every cutset and loop; each has exactly its one designated twig or link. Counts match n−1 = 4 and b−n+1 = 4. All sets match answer 2-3 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342, regardless of listed element order.

title.zh: 节点法：先列注入电流，再求端口电压差
title.en: Nodal analysis: injections first, port difference last

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 试用节点电压法求题图2-9所示电路中的电压u。
statement.en: Use nodal-voltage analysis to find voltage u in Fig. 2-9.

alt.zh: 底左公共节点接地，15 V源上正下负，其上端经3 Ω接节点1。节点1经6 Ω接地，经2 Ω接节点2；另有5 A源从节点1指向节点2。节点2经2 Ω接节点3，节点3经2 Ω接地。输出u按节点2正、节点3负。
alt.en: The lower-left common node is ground. A 15 V source positive at the top connects through 3 Ω to node 1. Node 1 connects to ground through 6 Ω and to node 2 through 2 Ω, with a 5 A source also pointing from 1 to 2. Node 2 connects through 2 Ω to node 3, which connects through 2 Ω to ground. Output u is positive at node 2 and negative at node 3.

prerequisites.zh: 节点电压法；电流源的注入符号；电压等于节点电位差。
prerequisites.en: Nodal analysis, current-source injection signs and voltage as a node-potential difference.

recognition.zh: 5 A在节点1流出、节点2流入，两条方程右端符号相反。输出端负极是节点3，不能直接把节点2电位当输出。
recognition.en: The 5 A source leaves node 1 and enters node 2, so its injection signs oppose. The output negative terminal is node 3, not ground.

text.zh: 取节点电压为v₁、v₂、v₃，源上端已知15 V。节点1电阻流出电流之和等于−5 A。
text.en: Let node potentials be v₁, v₂ and v₃. The source upper terminal is at 15 V. Resistor currents leaving node 1 sum to −5 A.

text.zh: 节点2注入5 A，节点3没有外部注入。
text.en: Node 2 receives 5 A; node 3 has no external injection.

text.zh: 第一式化为v₂=2v₁，第三式给v₂=2v₃；代入第二式，得到v₁=v₃=5 V、v₂=10 V。
text.en: The first equation gives v₂ = 2v₁ and the third gives v₂ = 2v₃. Substitution into the second gives v₁ = v₃ = 5 V and v₂ = 10 V.

steps.formula: v_1=5\,\mathrm V,\quad v_2=10\,\mathrm V,\quad v_3=5\,\mathrm V

title.zh: 按输出参考极性取电位差

text.zh: 输出u的正端是2，负端是3。
text.en: The positive output terminal is 2 and the negative terminal is 3.

answer.zh: u=5 V。
answer.en: u = 5 V.

pitfalls.zh: 同一个5 A源在两个节点的注入符号相反，不能两处都写+5。
pitfalls.en: The same 5 A source has opposite injection signs at nodes 1 and 2.

pitfalls.zh: 节点3不是地，u=v₂−v₃，而非v₂。
pitfalls.en: Node 3 is not ground: u = v₂−v₃, not v₂.

methods.zh: 独立源变换复核：节点1左侧15 V/3 Ω与6 Ω网络等效为10 V串联2 Ω；节点1到2的5 A∥2 Ω变为使节点2升高10 V的串联源。外回路总电阻2+2+4=8 Ω，电流(10+10)/8=2.5 A，故节点2为10 V、节点3为5 V，输出5 V。书第333页/PDF342页2-11亦为5 V。
methods.en: Independent source-transformation check: the left 15 V/3 Ω and 6 Ω network becomes 10 V in series with 2 Ω. The 5 A parallel 2 Ω between nodes 1 and 2 becomes a 10 V rise toward node 2 in series with 2 Ω. The loop current is (10+10)/(2+2+4) = 2.5 A, giving node 2 at 10 V and node 3 at 5 V, hence u = 5 V. Answer 2-11 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 agrees.

title.zh: 受控电压源：先读正负端，再写约束
title.en: Controlled voltage source: polarity before constraints

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图2-10所示电路中的电流i。
statement.en: Find current i in the circuit of Fig. 2-10.

alt.zh: 上下为公共节点。左支路4 Ω，i参考向上；第二支路为3 A向上源；第三支路为电压5i的受控电压源（上负下正）串联2 Ω；最右支路12 Ω。
alt.en: The upper and lower nodes are common. The left branch is 4 Ω with i upward. The next is a 3 A upward source. The third has a controlled voltage source 5i, negative at the top and positive at the bottom, in series with 2 Ω. The right branch is 12 Ω.

prerequisites.zh: 节点法；电流控制电压源；控制电流的参考方向。
prerequisites.en: Nodal analysis, current-controlled voltage sources and current reference direction.

recognition.zh: 全电路只有一个公共上节点电位，但受控源与2 Ω之间还要写一个电压约束。i向上，因此i=−v/4。
recognition.en: There is one common upper-node potential, with an additional constraint at the junction of the controlled source and 2 Ω. Since i points upward, i = −v/4.

title.zh: 定义节点并写控制关系
title.en: Define potentials and the control relation

text.zh: 底节点为0 V，上节点为v，受控源下端与2 Ω上端连接点为vx。左支路i向上；受控源正端在下方。
text.en: Set the bottom to 0 V, the upper potential to v and the source/resistor junction to vx. Current i is upward, and the controlled source is positive at its lower terminal.

title.en: Apply KCL at the upper node

text.zh: 三条非独立电流源支路的向下电流分别为v/4、vx/2和v/12，它们之和等于3 A向上注入。
text.en: The downward currents in the three other branches are v/4, vx/2 and v/12. Their sum equals the 3 A upward injection.
Substituting i = −v/4 gives vx = −v/4. KCL becomes 5v/24 = 3, so v = 14.4 V and i = −3.6 A.

answer.zh: i=−3.6 A，即4 Ω支路实际电流3.6 A向下。
answer.en: i = −3.6 A: the actual current through 4 Ω is 3.6 A downward.

pitfalls.zh: 原图受控源上负下正，必须写vx−v=5i，不能写v−vx=5i。
pitfalls.en: The source is negative at the top and positive below: write vx−v = 5i, not v−vx = 5i.

pitfalls.zh: 负的i同时影响受控源电压，不应在代入时去掉负号。
pitfalls.en: The signed current also controls the source voltage; do not discard its negative sign.

methods.zh: 独立支路与功率核验：vx=−3.6 V，中间支路向下电流−1.8 A；上节点向下电流3.6−1.8+1.2=3 A。电阻耗散51.84+6.48+17.28=75.6 W；3 A源吸收−43.2 W，受控源上到下电压18 V、向下电流−1.8 A，吸收−32.4 W，总和0。书第333页/PDF342页2-12为−3.6 A。
methods.en: Independent branch/power check: vx = −3.6 V and the middle downward current is −1.8 A. Downward currents sum to 3.6−1.8+1.2 = 3 A. Resistor powers total 51.84+6.48+17.28 = 75.6 W. The 3 A source absorbs −43.2 W; the controlled source has an 18 V top-to-bottom drop with −1.8 A downward, absorbing −32.4 W. Total power is zero. Answer 2-12 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 is −3.6 A.

title.zh: 网孔法遇电流源：超网孔加电流约束
title.en: A current source in mesh analysis: supermesh plus constraint

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 试用网孔分析法求题图2-18所示电路中的电流i₁、i₂和i₃。
statement.en: Use mesh analysis to find currents i₁, i₂ and i₃ in Fig. 2-18.

alt.zh: 底部公共节点，左2 V源上负下正，经上方4 Ω接顶中节点，4 Ω电流i₁向右；顶中经5 Ω接右30 V源上端，i₂向右，30 V源也上负下正。顶中与底部之间另有2 Ω电阻（i₃向下）和3 A向下电流源两条并联支路。
alt.en: The bottom is common. The left 2 V source is negative at the top and connects through upper 4 Ω to the middle-top node, with i₁ rightward. A 5 Ω resistor carries i₂ rightward from this node to the upper terminal of the right 30 V source, also negative at the top. A 2 Ω resistor with i₃ downward and a 3 A downward current source separately connect middle-top to bottom.

prerequisites.zh: 顺时针网孔电流；共享支路电流差；超网孔。
prerequisites.en: Clockwise mesh currents, differences in shared branches and supermeshes.

recognition.zh: 电流源位于两个相邻网孔的公共边，其端电压未知，不能写成电阻压降。把这两个网孔合成超网孔，再补电流源约束。
recognition.en: The current source lies between adjacent meshes and has an unknown voltage. Form a supermesh around those meshes and add the current constraint.

text.zh: 从左到右，三个最小网孔取顺时针电流j₁、j₂、j₃。则i₁=j₁，i₂=j₃，2 Ω中向下电流i₃=j₁−j₂。
text.en: Take clockwise mesh currents j₁, j₂ and j₃ from left to right. Then i₁ = j₁, i₂ = j₃ and the downward 2 Ω current is i₃ = j₁−j₂.

text.zh: 左2 V源从下向上经过是从正端到负端，为2 V压降。
text.en: Traversing the left 2 V source upward goes from positive to negative, producing a 2 V drop.

title.zh: 中右超网孔与电流约束

text.zh: 超网孔绕过3 A源，经过5 Ω、30 V源和2 Ω。右30 V源从上向下是电压上升。3 A向下等于中网孔向下减右网孔向上。
text.en: The supermesh bypasses the 3 A source and passes through 5 Ω, the 30 V source and 2 Ω. Traversing the 30 V source downward is a voltage rise. The downward 3 A equals the middle mesh current minus the right mesh current.

text.zh: 解得j₁=2 A、j₂=7 A、j₃=4 A。因此i₁=2 A、i₂=4 A、i₃=−5 A；i₃实际向上5 A。
text.en: Solving gives j₁ = 2 A, j₂ = 7 A and j₃ = 4 A. Thus i₁ = 2 A, i₂ = 4 A and i₃ = −5 A; its actual direction is 5 A upward.

steps.formula: i_1=2\,\mathrm A,\qquad i_2=4\,\mathrm A,\qquad i_3=-5\,\mathrm A

answer.zh: i₁=2 A，i₂=4 A，i₃=−5 A（按图示参考方向）。
answer.en: i₁ = 2 A, i₂ = 4 A and i₃ = −5 A, using the figure reference directions.

pitfalls.zh: i₃是共享支路电流差，不是某一个网孔电流。
pitfalls.en: i₃ is a difference of mesh currents, not a single mesh current.

pitfalls.zh: 两个电压源均上负下正，绕行时必须逐个判定电压升降。
pitfalls.en: Both voltage sources are negative at the top; determine each voltage rise or drop from the traversal direction.

methods.en: Independent nodal check: with bottom at 0 V, the left and right upper terminals are −2 V and −30 V. The middle-top V satisfies (V+2)/4 + V/2 + (V+30)/5 + 3 = 0, giving V = −10 V. Then i₁ = [−2−(−10)]/4 = 2 A, i₂ = [−10−(−30)]/5 = 4 A and i₃ = −10/2 = −5 A. KCL gives 2 = 4−5+3. Answer 2-20 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 matches all three.

title.zh: 网孔法中的受控电压源与电流源约束
title.en: Mesh analysis with controlled voltage and current-source constraints

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 试用网孔分析法求题图2-19所示电路中的电流i。
statement.en: Use mesh analysis to find current i in Fig. 2-19.

alt.zh: 左、右上节点由顶端导线直接相连，顶导线电流i₁向右。中间横支路依次为2 Ω和1 Ω，中间节点经3 A向上的电流源接底节点。左侧10 V源、右侧受控电压源2i₁均上正下负，接在上节点与底节点间。所求i在左下导线上向左。
alt.en: The upper left and upper right nodes are directly joined by a top wire carrying i₁ rightward. A middle path contains 2 Ω then 1 Ω; their junction connects to the bottom through a 3 A upward current source. The left 10 V source and right controlled voltage source 2i₁ are both positive at the top. The requested i points left along the lower-left wire.

prerequisites.zh: 网孔电流与共享支路；超网孔；受控源控制关系。
prerequisites.en: Mesh currents and shared branches, supermeshes, and controlled-source relations.

recognition.zh: 顶导线压降为0，却仍可能有非零电流。受控源的控制量就是这条导线电流i₁；遇到3 A源，要加电流差约束而不是给它指定电压。
recognition.en: The top wire has zero voltage drop but can carry nonzero current. Its current i₁ controls the voltage source. The 3 A source supplies a mesh-current difference constraint, not a specified voltage.

text.zh: 上方、左下、右下三个最小网孔分别取顺时针电流j₁、j₂、j₃。顶导线只有上网孔经过，所以i₁=j₁；左下导线只有左下网孔经过，所以i=j₂。3 A向上对应j₃−j₂。
text.en: Assign clockwise currents j₁, j₂ and j₃ to the upper, lower-left and lower-right meshes. Only j₁ traverses the top wire, so i₁ = j₁. Only j₂ traverses the lower-left wire, so i = j₂. The upward 3 A is j₃−j₂.

title.en: Apply KVL to the upper mesh

text.zh: 上网孔顺时针从顶导线到右端，再经1 Ω、2 Ω返回左端。两段电阻电流均为相邻网孔电流之差。
text.en: Traverse the upper mesh clockwise along the top wire, then return through 1 Ω and 2 Ω. Each resistor current is the difference of adjacent mesh currents.

text.zh: 绕过3 A源，沿左下和右下网孔的外边界：依次经过2 Ω、1 Ω、受控电压源，再经10 V源从负到正。受控源压降必须保留为2j₁。
text.en: Bypass the 3 A source and traverse the lower supermesh boundary through 2 Ω, 1 Ω, the controlled voltage source, then the 10 V source from negative to positive. Retain the controlled-source drop as 2j₁.

text.zh: 将前两条KVL相加可得2j₁=10，故j₁=5 A；再用电流源约束和上网孔方程解得j₂=4 A、j₃=7 A。
text.en: Adding the two KVL equations gives 2j₁ = 10 and j₁ = 5 A. Using the current-source constraint and upper-mesh equation then gives j₂ = 4 A and j₃ = 7 A.

answer.zh: i=4 A，方向与图中向左的参考方向相同。
answer.en: i = 4 A, in the indicated leftward direction.

pitfalls.zh: 理想导线电压为0并不意味着电流为0。
pitfalls.en: Zero voltage across an ideal wire does not imply zero current.

pitfalls.zh: 受控源不能在写超网孔时去掉；其控制量是顶导线电流，不是所求i。
pitfalls.en: Keep the controlled source in the supermesh. Its control current is the top-wire current, not the requested i.

methods.zh: 独立节点/功率核验：底节点取0 V，左右上节点均为10 V；中间节点KCL给出(V−10)/2+(V−10)=3，得V=12 V。顶导线i₁=10/2=5 A，左节点有中间流入1 A、顶导线流出5 A，所以10 V源向上4 A，即i=4 A。电阻耗散6 W；10 V源、受控源和3 A源吸收功率依次−40、70、−36 W，总和0。精确有理数MNA复核相同。书第333页/PDF342页2-21为4 A。
methods.en: Independent nodal/power check: set the bottom to 0 V. Both upper nodes are 10 V; middle-node KCL gives (V−10)/2 + (V−10) = 3, so V = 12 V. The controlled relation gives i₁ = 10/2 = 5 A. At the left node, 1 A enters from the middle and 5 A leaves along the wire; the 10 V source therefore supplies 4 A upward, equal to i. Resistors dissipate 6 W; the 10 V, controlled and 3 A sources absorb −40, 70 and −36 W, totaling zero. Exact-rational MNA agrees. Answer 2-21 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 is 4 A.

title.zh: 叠加电流，再用总电流计算功率
title.en: Superpose currents, then use the total current for power

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 利用叠加定理求题图3-4所示电路中的电流i及电流i所在支路电阻消耗的功率。
statement.en: Use superposition to find current i in Fig. 3-4 and the power dissipated by the resistor in its branch.

alt.zh: 左4 V源上正下负，顶端经2 Ω到节点A。A经竖直2 Ω接左下节点，i向下；A经顶端10 Ω到节点B。B经竖直10 Ω接右下节点C，另有4 A源从C向上到B。左下节点经2 A向右的电流源到C。
alt.en: The left 4 V source is positive at the top and connects through 2 Ω to node A. A connects through vertical 2 Ω to the lower-left node, with i downward, and through upper 10 Ω to node B. B connects through vertical 10 Ω to lower-right node C, in parallel with a 4 A source directed from C to B. A 2 A current source points from the lower-left node to C.

prerequisites.zh: 叠加定理；独立电压源置零短路，独立电流源置零开路；电阻功率。
prerequisites.en: Superposition; short a zeroed independent voltage source and open a zeroed current source; resistor power.

recognition.zh: 本题有三个独立源，应分别求三个带符号电流贡献。右侧4 A源单独作用时，电流只在其并联10 Ω支路形成局部回路，对所求i的贡献为0。
recognition.en: There are three independent sources, so find three signed current contributions. With only the right 4 A source active, its current circulates through the parallel 10 Ω resistor and contributes zero to i.

text.zh: 将2 A、4 A源开路。右侧两只10 Ω形成通向悬空节点的支路，无电流。左侧两个2 Ω串联，所求支路向下电流为1 A。
text.en: Open the 2 A and 4 A sources. The right pair of 10 Ω resistors leads to a floating node and carries no current. The two left 2 Ω resistors are in series, giving 1 A downward in the requested branch.

text.zh: 将4 V源短路、4 A源开路。2 A从右侧经两只10 Ω流到节点A，再经过左侧两个并联2 Ω返回左下节点。两只2 Ω均分电流，所求向下电流为1 A。
text.en: Short the 4 V source and open the 4 A source. The 2 A current returns from the right through both 10 Ω resistors to A, then through the two parallel left 2 Ω resistors. They share equally, giving 1 A downward in the requested branch.

text.zh: 将4 V源短路、2 A源开路。右下节点只连接4 A源与其并联10 Ω，4 A由该10 Ω返回。顶端10 Ω中无电流，因此所求i的贡献为0。
text.en: Short the 4 V source and open the 2 A source. The lower-right node connects only to the 4 A source and its parallel 10 Ω resistor, which returns all 4 A. The upper 10 Ω carries no current, so this contribution to i is zero.

text.zh: 三个贡献按图示参考方向相加。功率必须由总电流求得，不能把各独立作用下的功率相加。
text.en: Add the three contributions with their signs. Compute power from the total current; powers for separate source excitations do not superpose.

answer.zh: i=2 A（向下）；该2 Ω电阻消耗8 W。
answer.en: i = 2 A downward; the 2 Ω resistor dissipates 8 W.

pitfalls.zh: 功率不是源激励的线性函数，1²×2+1²×2=4 W并非正确总功率。
pitfalls.en: Power is nonlinear in source excitation; 1²×2 + 1²×2 = 4 W is not the total power.

pitfalls.zh: 电流源置零应开路，不是短路。
pitfalls.en: A zeroed ideal current source is an open circuit.

methods.zh: 独立完整电路节点法：左下取0 V，左上4 V，设A、B、C为图示节点；右侧KCL给出B−A=20 V、C−B=−20 V，A点KCL为(A−4)/2+A/2+(A−B)/10=0，得A=4、B=24、C=4 V，故i=2 A。电阻总耗散88 W，2 A与4 A源分别提供8 W、80 W，4 V源电流0，功率平衡。精确MNA同时复核三个分量为1、1、0 A。书第334页/PDF343页3-4为2 A、8 W。
methods.en: Independent full-circuit nodal check: set the lower-left node to 0 V and upper-left to 4 V. Right-side KCL gives B−A = 20 V and C−B = −20 V. At A, (A−4)/2 + A/2 + (A−B)/10 = 0, yielding A = 4, B = 24 and C = 4 V, hence i = 2 A. Resistors dissipate 88 W; the 2 A and 4 A sources supply 8 and 80 W, while the 4 V source carries zero current. Exact MNA also verifies the three contributions as 1, 1 and 0 A. Answer 3-4 on printed p. 334/PDF p. 343 is 2 A and 8 W.

title.zh: 替代定理：把指定电流的电阻换成电流源
title.en: Substitution theorem: replace a specified-current resistor by a source

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图3-9所示，欲使支路电流I=2 A，试用替代定理求电阻R的值。
statement.en: For the circuit in Fig. 3-9, use the substitution theorem to find R such that branch current I = 2 A.

alt.zh: 左12 V源上正下负，经上方3 Ω到节点A；A经6 Ω接底部公共节点。A到节点B之间有1 Ω及向右4 A源并联。B经3 Ω和待求R分别接底部；R中电流I向下。题干在第87页，原图在第88页。
alt.en: The left 12 V source is positive at the top and connects through upper 3 Ω to A. A connects through 6 Ω to the common bottom node. Between A and B are parallel 1 Ω and rightward 4 A branches. B connects to the bottom through 3 Ω and unknown R; I points downward through R. The statement is on printed p. 87 and the figure on p. 88.

prerequisites.zh: 替代定理；节点KCL；欧姆定律。
prerequisites.en: Substitution theorem, nodal KCL and Ohm’s law.

recognition.zh: 已知R中应通过2 A，就用同方向2 A理想电流源替代R，先求这条支路需要的端电压，再用R=U/I还原。
recognition.en: Since R must carry 2 A, replace it by a 2 A source in the same direction. Find the required branch voltage, then recover R = U/I.

text.zh: 取底部为0 V，左源上端12 V。用B向下到地的2 A源替代R，设其上端电位为vB，左侧节点为vA。
text.en: Take the bottom as 0 V and the left source top as 12 V. Replace R by a 2 A source directed from B to ground, with upper potential vB. Let the other internal potential be vA.

text.zh: 取离开A为正。包括经3 Ω、6 Ω、1 Ω的电流以及向B流出的4 A。
text.en: Take currents leaving A as positive, including the 3 Ω, 6 Ω and 1 Ω paths and the 4 A source toward B.

title.en: Write KCL at B and solve for voltage

text.zh: B处4 A流入，替代源2 A流出，另外有1 Ω和3 Ω支路。联立两式得到vA=2 V、vB=3 V。
text.en: At B, 4 A enters and the substituted 2 A leaves, alongside the 1 Ω and 3 Ω branches. The two equations give vA = 2 V and vB = 3 V.

text.zh: R的上正下负端电压为3 V，向下电流为2 A，二者关联，故R为正。
text.en: R has a 3 V top-positive voltage and a 2 A downward current, using passive references, so R is positive.

pitfalls.zh: 替代支路的方向必须与指定I一致；替代后求出的电压是R的端电压。
pitfalls.en: The substituted source must follow the specified I direction; its resulting voltage is the original resistor voltage.

pitfalls.zh: 替代定理不是“将电阻删除”，也不要求改变其他电源。
pitfalls.en: Substitution does not simply delete the resistor or change the other sources.

methods.zh: 独立回代原电路：将1.5 Ω接回后，B=3 V时R向下2 A，旁路3 Ω向下1 A，1 Ω向左1 A，合计4 A正好等于源流入；A处(2−12)/3+2/6+(2−3)+4=0。原电路精确有理数MNA也给出A=2、B=3 V。电阻共耗散44 W，12 V源提供40 W、4 A源提供4 W，平衡。书第334页/PDF343页3-10为1.5 Ω。
methods.en: Independent original-circuit check: restore 1.5 Ω. At B = 3 V, R carries 2 A down, the parallel 3 Ω carries 1 A down, and the 1 Ω carries 1 A left, matching the incoming 4 A. At A, (2−12)/3 + 2/6 + (2−3) + 4 = 0. Exact-rational MNA of the restored circuit gives A = 2 and B = 3 V. Resistors dissipate 44 W; the 12 V and 4 A sources supply 40 and 4 W. Answer 3-10 on printed p. 334/PDF p. 343 is 1.5 Ω.

title.zh: 含受控源的戴维南等效：开路电压加测试源
title.en: Thévenin equivalent with a controlled source: open circuit plus test source

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图3-15所示单口网络的戴维南等效电路。
statement.en: Find the Thévenin equivalent of the one-port network in Fig. 3-15.

alt.zh: 4 V独立源上正下负，上端经2 Ω到中间节点c；c经竖直2 Ω接底节点b，竖直电阻电压U上正下负。c经受控电压源3U到端口a，受控源左负右正。b为端口下端。
alt.en: The 4 V independent source is positive at the top and connects through 2 Ω to middle node c. A vertical 2 Ω joins c to bottom terminal b, with U positive at c. A controlled voltage source 3U connects c to terminal a, negative on the left and positive on the right.

prerequisites.zh: 戴维南等效；开路电压；含受控源网络的外加测试源法。
prerequisites.en: Thévenin equivalent, open-circuit voltage and test-source resistance for controlled-source networks.

recognition.zh: 受控源右正左负意味着vₐ−U=3U，即端口电压是4U。求等效电阻时只将4 V独立源短路，受控源及其控制关系必须保留。
recognition.en: The controlled source is positive on the right, so vₐ−U = 3U and the port voltage is 4U. For equivalent resistance, short only the independent 4 V source and retain the controlled source and its law.

text.zh: 端口a开路，受控源中电流为0。两个2 Ω对4 V等分，故U=2 V；端口电压在此基础上再升高3U。
text.en: With a open, no current flows through the controlled source. The two 2 Ω resistors divide 4 V equally, giving U = 2 V. The port voltage rises by a further 3U.

title.zh: 独立源置零，保留受控源
title.en: Zero the independent source and retain the dependent source

text.zh: 将4 V源短路后，中间节点c到b有两个2 Ω并联。在a、b间外加上正下负的测试电压Vₜ，由受控源关系有Vₜ=4U。
text.en: After shorting the 4 V source, two 2 Ω resistors connect c to b in parallel. Apply a top-positive test voltage Vₜ across a,b. The controlled relation remains Vₜ = 4U.

title.zh: 求流入网络的测试电流
title.en: Find test current entering the network

text.zh: 从a流入的测试电流经受控源到c，再通过两个2 Ω流出，所以Iₜ=U/2+U/2。
text.en: The test current entering a passes through the controlled source to c, then through both 2 Ω resistors.

text.zh: 戴维南电压源8 V正端朝a，与4 Ω串联。若用从a向外流出的负载电流I_L表示端口特性，电压随电流以4 Ω的斜率下降。
text.en: The equivalent is an 8 V source, positive toward a, in series with 4 Ω. For load current I_L leaving a, port voltage falls with slope 4 Ω.

answer.zh: 戴维南等效：8 V电压源（a端正）串联4 Ω。
answer.en: Thévenin equivalent: an 8 V source, positive toward a, in series with 4 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 受控源不是独立源，求Rth时不能把它短路。
pitfalls.en: A controlled source is not an independent source; do not short it when finding Rth.

pitfalls.zh: 受控源极性右正左负，端口电压是U+3U，不是U−3U。
pitfalls.en: The dependent source is positive on the right, making the port voltage U+3U, not U−3U.

methods.zh: 独立完整端口方程：设I为从a流入网络的电流，c节点KCL为(U−4)/2+U/2−I=0，得U=2+I，故vab=4U=8+4I；改用流出电流I_L=−I，得到8−4I_L。另以精确MNA分别检验开路8 V、独立源置零后1 V测试电压对应1/4 A流入、端口短路电流2 A流出，均与Rth=8/2=4 Ω一致。书第334页/PDF343页3-16为8 V、4 Ω。
methods.en: Independent full port law: let I enter the network at a. KCL at c gives (U−4)/2 + U/2 − I = 0, hence U = 2+I and vab = 4U = 8+4I. With outward I_L = −I, this becomes 8−4I_L. Exact MNA separately gives 8 V open circuit, 1/4 A entering under a 1 V test after independent-source suppression, and a 2 A short-circuit current outward, all consistent with Rth = 8/2 = 4 Ω. Answer 3-16 on printed p. 334/PDF p. 343 is 8 V and 4 Ω.

title.zh: 受控源诺顿等效：短路电流与测试电阻
title.en: Norton equivalent with a controlled source: short-circuit current and test resistance

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图3-16所示单口网络的诺顿等效电路。
statement.en: Find the Norton equivalent of the one-port network in Fig. 3-16.

alt.zh: 左20 V源上正下负，顶端经2 Ω到端口a，2 Ω电压u₁左正右负。a向下先经上正下负的受控电压源2u₁，再经4 Ω接底端b。
alt.en: The left 20 V source is positive at the top and connects through 2 Ω to terminal a. The 2 Ω voltage u₁ is positive on the left. A downward branch from a contains a controlled voltage source 2u₁, positive at the top, followed by 4 Ω to bottom terminal b.

prerequisites.zh: 诺顿等效；短路电流；受控源网络测试法。
prerequisites.en: Norton equivalent, short-circuit current and test-source analysis with dependent sources.

recognition.zh: 端口短路时u₁=20 V，受控源电压仍为40 V，并不会一起变成0。它使4 Ω上端为−40 V，因此该支路实际向端口提供电流。
recognition.en: Shorting the port gives u₁ = 20 V, so the controlled source remains at 40 V. It places the 4 Ω upper terminal at −40 V, making this branch supply current toward the port.

title.en: Short the port to find Norton current

text.zh: 将a、b短路，取b为0 V，故a也为0 V。左2 Ω向a送入(20−0)/2=10 A。受控源2u₁=40 V，使其下端c为−40 V，4 Ω中向下电流−10 A，即向a再送入10 A。
text.en: Short a,b and set b to 0 V, so a is also 0 V. The left 2 Ω sends (20−0)/2 = 10 A into a. The controlled source is 2u₁ = 40 V, placing its lower node c at −40 V. The downward 4 Ω current is −10 A, supplying another 10 A to a.

title.zh: 置零独立源并加测试电压
title.en: Suppress the independent source and apply test voltage

text.zh: 仅把20 V源短路，在端口加Vₜ。此时u₁=−Vₜ，受控源关系Vₜ−v_c=2u₁=−2Vₜ，故v_c=3Vₜ。
text.en: Short only the 20 V source and apply Vₜ at the port. Then u₁ = −Vₜ and the controlled law is Vₜ−v_c = 2u₁ = −2Vₜ, so v_c = 3Vₜ.

title.en: Find Norton resistance and source direction

text.zh: 流入端口的测试电流分为经2 Ω到地与经受控源、4 Ω到地两部分。诺顿源方向从b向a，才能使外部短路电流从a流向b。
text.en: The entering test current splits between the 2 Ω path and the controlled-source/4 Ω path. The Norton source points from b to a, giving an external short-circuit current from a to b.

answer.zh: 诺顿等效：20 A电流源（从b向a）并联0.8 Ω。
answer.en: Norton equivalent: a 20 A source from b to a in parallel with 0.8 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: a、b短路只令端口电压为0，不令受控源的控制电压u₁为0。
pitfalls.en: Shorting a,b zeros the port voltage, not the controlling voltage u₁.

pitfalls.zh: 测试时u₁的参考极性左正右负，因此u₁=−Vₜ。
pitfalls.en: During the test, u₁ is positive on the left, so u₁ = −Vₜ.

methods.zh: 独立完整端口法：端口电压v时u₁=20−v，受控源下节点vc=v−2(20−v)=3v−40。流入网络的电流I=(v−20)/2+(3v−40)/4=5v/4−20，故向外电流为20−v/0.8。开路v=16 V，16/20=0.8 Ω。精确MNA以0.8 Ω负载检验得v=8 V、负载电流10 A；总电阻耗散216 W，两个源提供216 W，功率平衡。书第334页/PDF343页3-17为20 A、0.8 Ω。
methods.en: Independent full port law: at voltage v, u₁ = 20−v and the lower controlled-source node is vc = v−2(20−v) = 3v−40. Entering current is I = (v−20)/2 + (3v−40)/4 = 5v/4−20, so outward current is 20−v/0.8. Open circuit gives v = 16 V and 16/20 = 0.8 Ω. Exact MNA with a 0.8 Ω load gives 8 V and 10 A; resistors dissipate 216 W, exactly supplied by the two sources. Answer 3-17 on printed p. 334/PDF p. 343 is 20 A and 0.8 Ω.

title.zh: 戴维南法：先移开负载，再求端口等效
title.en: Thévenin method: remove the load before finding the port equivalent

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 应用戴维南定理求题图3-18所示电路中的电流i。
statement.en: Use Thévenin’s theorem to find current i in Fig. 3-18.

alt.zh: 底部公共节点。左节点A经1 Ω接底部，A到中节点B有24 V源，左正右负；B经上正下负的4 V源接底部。A到右节点C经顶端5 Ω，B到C经2 Ω；C经右侧4 Ω负载接底部，电流i向下。
alt.en: The bottom is common. Left node A connects through 1 Ω to the bottom. A 24 V source from A to middle node B is positive on the left. B connects through a top-positive 4 V source to the bottom. A connects to right node C through upper 5 Ω; B connects to C through 2 Ω. The right 4 Ω load joins C to the bottom, with i downward.

prerequisites.zh: 戴维南定理；开路端口KCL；独立电压源置零短路。
prerequisites.en: Thévenin’s theorem, open-port KCL and suppression of independent voltage sources.

recognition.zh: 将右侧4 Ω视为负载移开。两个理想源先固定B=4 V、A=28 V，左1 Ω只影响源电流，不改变这些节点电位。
recognition.en: Remove the right 4 Ω load. The ideal sources fix B = 4 V and A = 28 V. The left 1 Ω affects source currents but cannot change those fixed potentials.

title.en: Remove the load and find Uth

text.zh: 取底部0 V，B=4 V，A−B=24 V，所以A=28 V。设负载开路后C点电位为Uth，对C列KCL。
text.en: Take the bottom as 0 V. Then B = 4 V and A−B = 24 V, so A = 28 V. Let the open-circuit potential at C be Uth and apply KCL.

title.en: Suppress independent sources to find Rth

text.zh: 将24 V、4 V源均短路，A、B与底节点合并，1 Ω被短路。端口C到地只剩5 Ω与2 Ω并联。
text.en: Short the 24 V and 4 V sources. A, B and the bottom merge, bypassing the 1 Ω resistor. The port sees only 5 Ω in parallel with 2 Ω.

text.zh: 戴维南源与Rth、负载串联；电压源正端朝C，因此负载电流向下为正。
text.en: The Thévenin source, Rth and load are in series. The source is positive toward C, giving positive downward load current.

answer.zh: i=2 A，沿右侧4 Ω向下。
answer.en: i = 2 A downward through the right 4 Ω resistor.

pitfalls.zh: 开路时移去的是右侧4 Ω负载，不是中间2 Ω。
pitfalls.en: Remove the right 4 Ω load, not the middle 2 Ω resistor.

pitfalls.zh: 24 V源左正右负，因此A=B+24，不是B−24。
pitfalls.en: The 24 V source is positive on the left, so A = B+24, not B−24.

methods.zh: 独立直接节点法：接回负载后C满足(C−28)/5+(C−4)/2+C/4=0，得C=8 V，i=8/4=2 A。C点流入4 A经5 Ω，流出2 A经2 Ω、2 A经4 Ω，KCL成立。精确MNA同时复核开路76/7 V与接载8 V。完整电路电阻耗散888 W，24 V、4 V源分别提供768 W、120 W，功率平衡。书第334页/PDF343页3-19为2 A。
methods.en: Independent direct nodal check: with the load restored, (C−28)/5 + (C−4)/2 + C/4 = 0 gives C = 8 V and i = 8/4 = 2 A. At C, 4 A enters through 5 Ω and 2 A leaves through each of the 2 Ω and 4 Ω branches. Exact MNA also verifies the open-circuit 76/7 V and loaded 8 V. Resistors dissipate 888 W, supplied as 768 W and 120 W by the 24 V and 4 V sources. Answer 3-19 on printed p. 334/PDF p. 343 is 2 A.

title.zh: 由两次负载读数反推单口网络
title.en: Identify a one-port from two loaded measurements

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图3-21所示电路中，N为线性含源电阻网络。已知当开关S₁、S₂均打开时，电压表的读数为6 V；当开关S₁闭合、S₂打开时，电压表的读数为4 V。试求当开关S₁打开、S₂闭合时电压表的读数。
statement.en: In Fig. 3-21, N is a linear resistive network containing sources. The voltmeter reads 6 V with S₁ and S₂ both open, and 4 V with S₁ closed and S₂ open. Find its reading with S₁ open and S₂ closed.

alt.zh: 网络N的上下端口外接永久6 Ω并联支路；另有4 Ω串S₁、2 Ω串S₂两条可切换并联支路。右侧电压表跨接端口，上正下负，按理想电压表处理。
alt.en: Across N are a permanent 6 Ω branch, a 4 Ω branch in series with S₁, and a 2 Ω branch in series with S₂. The voltmeter is across the port, positive at the top, and is treated as ideal.

prerequisites.zh: 线性含源单口的戴维南模型；负载并联；电压分配。
prerequisites.en: Thévenin modeling of a linear source-containing one-port, parallel loads and voltage division.

recognition.zh: 两个开关打开时6 Ω仍接在端口，6 V不是N的开路电压。用两次“端电压、总负载电流”测量建立U=Uth−RthI，再预测第三种负载。
recognition.en: The 6 Ω remains connected with both switches open, so 6 V is not the open-circuit voltage of N. Use the two voltage/current measurements in U = Uth−Rth I, then predict the third load.

title.zh: 第一状态给出一条端口方程

text.zh: S₁、S₂均打开，负载只有6 Ω。理想电压表不取电流，因此N向外供电流6/6=1 A。
text.en: With both switches open, the only load is 6 Ω. The ideal voltmeter draws no current, so N supplies 6/6 = 1 A.

title.zh: 第二状态给出另一条方程

text.zh: S₁闭合、S₂打开，负载为6 Ω与4 Ω并联。端电压4 V时总电流4/6+4/4=5/3 A。
text.en: With S₁ closed and S₂ open, 6 Ω and 4 Ω are parallel. At 4 V, total load current is 4/6 + 4/4 = 5/3 A.

text.zh: 两式相减得到2=(2/3)Rth，再回代第一式。
text.en: Subtract the equations to get 2 = (2/3)Rth, then substitute into the first equation.

text.zh: S₁打开、S₂闭合时负载为6 Ω与2 Ω并联，即1.5 Ω。用戴维南电压分配。
text.en: With S₁ open and S₂ closed, the load is 6 Ω in parallel with 2 Ω, or 1.5 Ω. Apply voltage division to the identified Thévenin circuit.

answer.zh: 电压表读数为3 V（上正下负）。
answer.en: The voltmeter reads 3 V, positive at the top.

pitfalls.zh: 不可把第一状态误认为开路：6 Ω始终接入。
pitfalls.en: Do not treat the first state as an open circuit; the 6 Ω is always connected.

pitfalls.zh: 第二状态总电流应包含6 Ω支路和4 Ω支路。
pitfalls.en: The second-state current includes both the 6 Ω and 4 Ω branches.

methods.zh: 独立等效检验：也可先将固定6 Ω并入N，形成新单口，其开路电压就是6 V；接4 Ω时降为4 V，所以新单口内阻2 Ω。再接2 Ω得到6×2/(2+2)=3 V，与前法相同。原N参数9 V、3 Ω回代两次已知状态分别给6 V、4 V，第三状态供电流0.5+1.5=2 A且9−3×2=3 V。精确MNA三种状态均相符。书第334页/PDF343页3-22为3 V。
methods.en: Independent equivalent check: include the permanent 6 Ω inside an enlarged one-port. Its open-circuit voltage is 6 V; attaching 4 Ω reduces it to 4 V, so its resistance is 2 Ω. Attaching 2 Ω therefore gives 6×2/(2+2) = 3 V. The original 9 V, 3 Ω model reproduces the known 6 V and 4 V states; the third supplies 0.5+1.5 = 2 A and satisfies 9−3×2 = 3 V. Exact MNA verifies all three states. Answer 3-22 on printed p. 334/PDF p. 343 is 3 V.

title.zh: 最大功率与受控源：先求真实端口电阻
title.en: Maximum power with a controlled source: find the actual port resistance

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 试确定题图3-28所示电路中负载电阻R_L取何值时可获得最大功率。
statement.en: Determine the load resistance R_L that receives maximum power in Fig. 3-28.

alt.zh: 左侧15 V独立源上正下负，上端经4 Ω到节点c，4 Ω中控制电流I向右。c经上正下负的受控电压源6I接底部公共节点；c经2 Ω到负载上端a，R_L从a接到底部。
alt.en: The left 15 V independent source is positive at the top and connects through 4 Ω to c, with control current I rightward. A controlled voltage source 6I, positive at c, connects c to the bottom. A 2 Ω resistor joins c to load terminal a, and R_L joins a to the bottom.

prerequisites.zh: 最大功率传输定理；含受控源的戴维南等效；测试源法。
prerequisites.en: Maximum-power transfer, Thévenin equivalents with dependent sources and test-source analysis.

recognition.zh: 受控电压源直接限定中间节点电位，所以从负载看进去并非4 Ω与2 Ω简单串联。先保留控制关系求Rth，再令正电阻负载RL=Rth。
recognition.en: The controlled voltage source fixes the middle-node voltage, so the load does not simply see 4 Ω and 2 Ω in series. Retain its control law to find Rth, then match the positive load resistance to Rth.

text.zh: 移去RL，2 Ω中无电流，端口a电位等于c。左回路有4I+6I=15，得到I=1.5 A、c点电位6I=9 V。
text.en: Remove RL. No current flows through 2 Ω, so a and c have equal potentials. The left loop gives 4I+6I = 15, hence I = 1.5 A and c = 6I = 9 V.

title.zh: 独立源置零，求测试电阻
title.en: Suppress the independent source and find test resistance

text.zh: 只把15 V源短路，保留6I受控源。设c点电位为vc，则I=(0−vc)/4，同时vc=6I。两式只能给vc=0，因此外加端口测试电压全部落在2 Ω上。
text.en: Short only the 15 V source and retain the 6I source. If c is at vc, I = (0−vc)/4 while vc = 6I. These force vc = 0, so an applied port test voltage falls entirely across 2 Ω.

text.zh: 等效内阻为正，电阻负载在RL=Rth时获得最大功率。题目只要求负载值；最大功率可作为额外核验。
text.en: The equivalent resistance is positive, so the resistive load receives maximum power at RL = Rth. The question asks only for RL; the maximum power is a supplementary check.

steps.formula: R_L=R_{\rm th}=2\,\Omega,\qquad P_{\max}=\frac{U_{\rm th}^2}{4R_{\rm th}}=\frac{81}{8}\,\mathrm W

answer.zh: R_L=2 Ω时获得最大功率。
answer.en: Maximum power occurs at R_L = 2 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 求内阻时不能将受控源置零，也不能直接写4+2=6 Ω。
pitfalls.en: Do not suppress the controlled source or assume a resistance of 4+2 = 6 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 控制电流I仍按图示从左向右，独立源置零后I=−vc/4，负号不能漏。
pitfalls.en: The control current remains referenced left to right, so after source suppression I = −vc/4.

methods.zh: 独立完整负载关系：无论RL取何正值，左回路仍给c=9 V，所以P_L=81RL/(RL+2)²，导数为81(2−RL)/(RL+2)³；RL<2时为正，RL>2时为负，唯一最大值在2 Ω。此时负载电压4.5 V、电流2.25 A、功率81/8 W。精确MNA在该负载与多个邻近负载上复核，并检验完整功率平衡：4 Ω、2 Ω、负载耗散9+10.125+10.125 W，两源提供22.5+6.75 W，合计0。书第334页/PDF343页3-29为2 Ω。
methods.en: Independent full load law: for every positive RL, the left loop still fixes c = 9 V, so P_L = 81RL/(RL+2)². Its derivative is 81(2−RL)/(RL+2)³, positive below 2 and negative above 2, giving the unique maximum at 2 Ω. The load then has 4.5 V, 2.25 A and 81/8 W. Exact MNA verifies this load and several neighboring values, plus full power balance: the 4 Ω, 2 Ω and load dissipate 9+10.125+10.125 W, supplied as 22.5+6.75 W by the sources. Answer 3-29 on printed p. 334/PDF p. 343 is 2 Ω.

title.zh: 电容网络分压：先串并联，再回到每只电容
title.en: Capacitor voltage division: reduce, then recover each voltage

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 试求题图5-5所示电路中各电容上的电压，已知ab端的电压为u_ab=12 V。
statement.en: Find the voltage across each capacitor in Fig. 5-5, given u_ab = 12 V.

alt.zh: C₁=12 μF接a、c；C₂=3 μF接c、b；C₃=4 μF接c、d；C₄=12 μF接d、b。下方b为公共节点。题干在印刷页140，原图在页141。
alt.en: C₁ = 12 μF lies between a,c; C₂ = 3 μF between c,b; C₃ = 4 μF between c,d; and C₄ = 12 μF between d,b. Terminal b is the common bottom node. The statement is on printed p. 140 and figure on p. 141.

prerequisites.zh: 电容串并联；串联电荷相等；u_xy=v_x−v_y。
prerequisites.en: Series/parallel capacitors, equal series charge and u_xy = v_x−v_y.

recognition.zh: 先看节点：C₃与C₄串联，再与C₂并联，最后与C₁串联。按本题通常约定，中间浮置导体初始净电荷为0；如果预先存有任意净电荷，仅给端电压不能唯一确定各电压。
recognition.en: Read the nodes: C₃ and C₄ are series, their equivalent is parallel with C₂, and that group is series with C₁. Use the exercise’s usual assumption of zero initial net charge on floating internal conductors; arbitrary trapped net charge would require additional initial data.

text.zh: C₃与C₄串联得3 μF，与C₂并联后c、b间为6 μF。它再与C₁的12 μF串联。
text.en: C₃ and C₄ in series give 3 μF; in parallel with C₂ this gives 6 μF between c,b. This is in series with C₁ = 12 μF.

text.zh: 串联组电荷Q=C_ab×12 V=48 μC，因此C₁电压为4 V，c、b间电压为8 V。C₂直接跨接c、b。
text.en: The series charge is Q = C_ab×12 V = 48 μC. Thus C₁ has 4 V and the c,b group has 8 V. C₂ is directly across c,b.

text.zh: C₃、C₄串联组跨接8 V，其电荷Q₃₄=3 μF×8 V=24 μC。电容越小，在相同电荷下电压越大。
text.en: The C₃,C₄ series pair is across 8 V, with charge Q₃₄ = 3 μF×8 V = 24 μC. The smaller capacitance has the larger voltage for equal charge.

answer.zh: C₁：u_ac=4 V；C₂：u_cb=8 V；C₃：u_cd=6 V；C₄：u_db=2 V，均按下标顺序取正端、负端。
answer.en: C₁: u_ac = 4 V; C₂: u_cb = 8 V; C₃: u_cd = 6 V; C₄: u_db = 2 V. Each subscript order defines the positive and negative terminals.

pitfalls.zh: 串联电容按电容量倒数分压，不按容量大小正比分压。
pitfalls.en: Series capacitor voltages vary inversely with capacitance.

pitfalls.zh: C₁电荷48 μC不等于C₃的24 μC；中间并联支路会分配电荷。
pitfalls.en: C₁ carries 48 μC while C₃ carries 24 μC; charge splits between the middle parallel branches.

methods.zh: 独立节点电荷核验：取b=0、a=12 V，则c=8、d=2 V。c导体净电荷12(8−12)+3×8+4(8−2)=0 μC；d导体净电荷4(2−8)+12×2=0 μC。总储能为288 μJ，与等效4 μF在12 V下的½CU²相同。书第335页/PDF344页5-7四个电压完全一致。
methods.en: Independent node-charge check: set b = 0 and a = 12 V, giving c = 8 and d = 2 V. The c conductor has net charge 12(8−12)+3×8+4(8−2) = 0 μC; d has 4(2−8)+12×2 = 0 μC. Total energy is 288 μJ, equal to ½CU² for the 4 μF equivalent at 12 V. All four voltages match answer 5-7 on printed p. 335/PDF p. 344.

assumptions.zh: 采用本章串并联电容的通常条件：各内部孤立导体原先净电荷为0（例如所有电容由未充电状态接入）。如果内部导体预先带有未知净电荷，仅给u_ab不足以唯一决定四个电压。
assumptions.en: Use the usual condition for the chapter’s series/parallel capacitor model: each internal isolated conductor initially has zero net charge, as when all capacitors are connected uncharged. If unknown trapped charges are present, u_ab alone does not determine the four voltages uniquely.

title.zh: 换路初始值：同时保留电容电压与电感电流
title.en: Switching initial values: retain capacitor voltage and inductor current

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图5-7所示电路原已处于稳态，在t=0时刻开关S打开，求i(0⁺)。
statement.en: The circuit in Fig. 5-7 is initially in steady state. Switch S opens at t = 0. Find i(0⁺).

alt.zh: 左4 A向上电流源与5 Ω并联，其上节点经开关S连接1 F电容上端。电容下端接底部公共节点。电容上端经另一5 Ω到右节点，i向右。右节点经0.5 H电感和3 Ω分别接底部，两者并联。
alt.en: A 4 A upward source is parallel with left 5 Ω. Their upper node connects through S to the upper terminal of a 1 F capacitor; its lower terminal is common bottom. Another 5 Ω connects capacitor top to the right node, with i rightward. The right node connects to bottom through parallel 0.5 H and 3 Ω branches.

prerequisites.zh: 直流稳态电容开路、电感短路；换路定则；瞬时节点KCL。
prerequisites.en: Open capacitors and short inductors in DC steady state, switching continuity and instantaneous KCL.

recognition.zh: 题目只求0⁺瞬间，无需求整个LC暂态。先求0⁻的uC、iL，再在换路后的电路用同值电压源、电流源表示这两个初始状态。
recognition.en: Only the instant 0⁺ is requested, so the complete LC transient is unnecessary. Find uC and iL at 0⁻, then impose those states on the post-switch circuit.

text.zh: S原来闭合。稳态时1 F开路、0.5 H短路，右节点为0 V，3 Ω无电流。两只5 Ω从电流源上节点看去并联，4 A均分。
text.en: S is initially closed. In steady state, the capacitor is open and inductor shorted. The right node is 0 V and 3 Ω carries no current. The two 5 Ω branches are parallel and share 4 A equally.

text.zh: 开关打开只断开左侧激励。没有冲激激励，故电容电压仍10 V、电感电流仍向下2 A。
text.en: Opening S disconnects the left excitation. With no impulsive excitation, capacitor voltage remains 10 V and downward inductor current remains 2 A.

text.zh: 设右节点瞬时电压v。左边5 Ω送入(10−v)/5，右侧3 Ω与电感流出v/3+2。解得v=0，因此所求电流2 A。
text.en: Let the instantaneous right-node voltage be v. The 5 Ω supplies (10−v)/5, while the 3 Ω and inductor draw v/3+2. This gives v = 0 and the requested current 2 A.

answer.zh: i(0⁺)=2 A，方向向右。
answer.en: i(0⁺) = 2 A rightward.

pitfalls.zh: 电容电流和电感电压可以突变；保持连续的是uC和iL。
pitfalls.en: Capacitor current and inductor voltage may jump; uC and iL are the continuous states.

pitfalls.zh: 换路后电感不能笼统当短路，必须先用其已知初始电流列方程。本题得到0⁺电压恰好为0，是计算结果。
pitfalls.en: Do not automatically short the inductor after switching. Impose its initial current; its zero voltage at 0⁺ is a result here.

methods.zh: 独立约束检查：0⁻电流源KCL为10/5+10/5=4 A；0⁺右节点KCL为2=2+0，电容电压、电感电流均满足连续性。换路瞬间总储能为½×1×10²+½×0.5×2²=51 J，切换前后相同，没有状态跳变所需的冲激能量。书第335页/PDF344页5-11为2 A。
methods.en: Independent constraints: before switching, source-node KCL is 10/5+10/5 = 4 A; afterward, right-node KCL is 2 = 2+0 and both states are continuous. Stored energy is ½×1×10² + ½×0.5×2² = 51 J on both sides of switching. Answer 5-11 on printed p. 335/PDF p. 344 is 2 A.

title.zh: 受控源初始充电与断开后的RC放电
title.en: Controlled-source charging and RC discharge after opening

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图5-11所示电路在开关S打开前已达稳态，t=0时刻开关打开，求开关打开后的电容电压u_C(t)。
statement.en: The circuit in Fig. 5-11 is in steady state before switch S opens at t = 0. Find the capacitor voltage u_C(t) after opening.

alt.zh: 左10 V源上正下负，向上参考电流i，经S和5 kΩ到节点x。x经上正下负的受控电压源10⁴i接底部，并经20 kΩ到2 μF电容上端。电容下端接底部，uC上正下负。原图明确标20 kΩ与2 μF。
alt.en: The left 10 V source is positive at the top, with upward current i, and connects through S and 5 kΩ to node x. A top-positive controlled voltage source 10⁴i joins x to bottom. A 20 kΩ resistor connects x to the top of a 2 μF capacitor, with uC top-positive. The original figure explicitly labels 20 kΩ and 2 μF.

prerequisites.zh: 受控源关系；电容电压连续性；RC零输入响应；单位换算。
prerequisites.en: Controlled-source relations, capacitor-voltage continuity, RC zero-input response and unit conversion.

recognition.zh: 先用闭合时的受控关系求初始充电电压。打开后控制电流i因断路而为0，所以受控源电压成为0，电容仅经20 kΩ放电。这里源变为0是控制量计算结果。
recognition.en: First find the initial charge using the closed-switch control law. After opening, i is zero because its branch is broken; the controlled voltage becomes zero and the capacitor discharges through 20 kΩ. The dependent source becomes zero as a consequence of its control current.

text.zh: 稳态电容开路，20 kΩ无电流，因此uC(0⁻)=vx。由左回路和受控源可得i=(10−vx)/5000、vx=10000i。
text.en: In steady state, the capacitor is open and 20 kΩ carries no current, so uC(0⁻) = vx. The left loop and source law give i = (10−vx)/5000 and vx = 10000i.

text.zh: 电容电压连续；开关打开后i=0，vx=0，最终电压0。电容看入电阻为20 kΩ，时间常数须将μF化为10⁻⁶ F。
text.en: Capacitor voltage is continuous. After opening, i = 0 and vx = 0; the final voltage is zero. The capacitor sees 20 kΩ. Convert μF to 10⁻⁶ F when calculating the time constant.

title.zh: 写出正确响应并核对附录
title.en: State the response and compare the appendix

text.zh: 因此衰减系数为1/τ=25 s⁻¹。原书附录写6.67e⁻²·⁵ᵗ，按本题原图参数指数小了10倍；这里采用满足原电路方程的25 s⁻¹，并明确保留此差异。
text.en: The decay rate is 1/τ = 25 s⁻¹. The printed appendix gives 6.67e^(−2.5t), whose exponent is ten times too small for the supplied figure. Use 25 s⁻¹, which satisfies the original circuit equation, and retain the discrepancy explicitly.

answer.zh: u_C(t)=(20/3)e^(−25t) V，t≥0，t以秒计。附录的−2.5t与原图参数不符。
answer.en: u_C(t) = (20/3)e^(−25t) V for t≥0 in seconds. The appendix exponent −2.5t is inconsistent with the figure parameters.

pitfalls.zh: 不得为了匹配附录而改读原图的电容或电阻值。
pitfalls.en: Do not reinterpret the figure values just to match the appendix.

methods.zh: 独立微分方程核验：2×10⁻⁶ duC/dt+uC/20000=0，代入e⁻²⁵ᵗ时两项严格抵消，代入e⁻²·⁵ᵗ则不成立。储能核验：初始½C(20/3)²=1/22500 J，积分∫₀∞uC²/20000 dt恰为同值，且最终电压0。原图20 kΩ、2 μF及附录第335页/PDF344页的−2.5t已分别放大目视确认。附录初值6.67是20/3的舍入，但指数存在实质不一致。
methods.en: Independent ODE check: 2×10⁻⁶ duC/dt + uC/20000 = 0. Substitution of e^(−25t) cancels exactly, while e^(−2.5t) does not. Energy check: the initial ½C(20/3)² is 1/22500 J, exactly equal to ∫₀∞uC²/20000 dt; final voltage is zero. The figure’s 20 kΩ and 2 μF and the appendix exponent −2.5t on printed p. 335/PDF p. 344 were each visually enlarged and checked. Its 6.67 initial value is ordinary rounding, but the exponent is materially inconsistent.

appendixComparison.reason: 20 kohm × 2 microF = 0.04 s; the printed appendix decay rate is inconsistent by a factor of 10.

title.zh: 三种初态下的零输入、零状态与全响应
title.en: Zero-input, zero-state and full responses for three initial states

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh:
对题图5-20所示电路。
(1) 若Uₛ=18 V，u_C(0⁻)=−6 V，求电容电压的零输入响应、零状态响应和全响应。
(2) 若Uₛ=18 V，u_C(0⁻)=−12 V，求全响应u_C(t)。
(3) 若Uₛ=36 V，u_C(0⁻)=−6 V，求全响应u_C(t)。
statement.en:
For the circuit in Fig. 5-20:
(1) With Uₛ = 18 V and u_C(0⁻) = −6 V, find the zero-input, zero-state and full capacitor-voltage responses.
(2) With Uₛ = 18 V and u_C(0⁻) = −12 V, find the full u_C(t).
(3) With Uₛ = 36 V and u_C(0⁻) = −6 V, find the full u_C(t).

alt.zh: Uₛ独立源上正下负，上端经6 Ω到电容上节点；该节点经3 Ω与1/4 F电容分别接底部公共节点。uC上正下负。
alt.en: The top-positive Uₛ source connects through 6 Ω to the capacitor’s top node. Parallel 3 Ω and 1/4 F branches connect this node to common bottom. uC is positive at the top.

prerequisites.zh: RC三要素法；零输入响应保留初态；零状态响应初态为0；线性叠加。
prerequisites.en: The three-parameter RC method, retained initial state for zero-input response, zero initial state for zero-state response, and linear superposition.

recognition.zh: 三问拓扑相同，所以时间常数相同。源大小决定最终值，电容初态决定指数项幅度。第一问先把两个响应写清，再叠加。
recognition.en: All three parts share the topology and time constant. The source fixes the final value, while the capacitor initial state fixes the exponential amplitude. In part (1), write both component responses before adding them.

title.zh: 统一求时间常数和最终值
title.en: Find the common time constant and final value

text.zh: 独立源置零后，电容看到6 Ω与3 Ω并联为2 Ω。稳态电容开路，3 Ω分得源电压的1/3。
text.en: With the independent source suppressed, the capacitor sees 6 Ω parallel with 3 Ω, or 2 Ω. In steady state the capacitor is open, and 3 Ω receives one third of the source voltage.

title.zh: 第一问分别写两个分量

text.zh: 零输入时仅保留−6 V初态；零状态时源18 V有效、初态0，最终值6 V。相加后初态为−6 V、最终值6 V。
text.en: The zero-input response retains only the −6 V initial state. The zero-state response uses the 18 V source and zero initial state, approaching 6 V. Their sum starts at −6 V and approaches 6 V.

steps.formula: u_{\rm zi}=-6e^{-2t},\quad u_{\rm zs}=6(1-e^{-2t}),\quad u_C=6-12e^{-2t}\quad(\mathrm V)

title.en: Change the initial state in part (2)

text.zh: 最终值仍6 V，初态改为−12 V，所以指数项系数为−12−6=−18 V。
text.en: The final value remains 6 V, but the initial value is −12 V. The exponential amplitude is −12−6 = −18 V.

text.zh: 源36 V使最终值变为12 V，初态仍−6 V，指数项系数为−6−12=−18 V。全部公式适用于t≥0且t以秒计。
text.en: The 36 V source makes the final value 12 V. The initial value remains −6 V, giving amplitude −6−12 = −18 V. All formulas apply for t≥0 in seconds.

pitfalls.zh: 三问初始电压都有负号；第二问是−12 V，不是+12 V。
pitfalls.en: The initial voltages are signed; part (2) has −12 V, not +12 V.

pitfalls.zh: 时间常数用源置零后的6 Ω∥3 Ω，不是6+3。
pitfalls.en: Use 6 Ω∥3 Ω after source suppression, not 6+3 Ω, for the time constant.

methods.zh: 独立原电路方程为¼duC/dt+(uC−Uₛ)/6+uC/3=0，即duC/dt+2uC=(2/3)Uₛ。逐一代入三个全响应，常数项和指数项残差均严格为0；初始值分别−6、−12、−6 V，最终值分别6、6、12 V，初始斜率分别24、36、36 V/s。第一问零输入储能4.5 J，恰等于在等效2 Ω中的总耗散。书第336页/PDF345页5-24全部小问一致。
methods.en: The independent original-circuit equation is ¼duC/dt + (uC−Uₛ)/6 + uC/3 = 0, or duC/dt+2uC = (2/3)Uₛ. Each full response gives exactly zero constant and exponential residuals. Their initial values are −6, −12 and −6 V; final values 6, 6 and 12 V; initial slopes 24, 36 and 36 V/s. The part (1) zero-input energy is 4.5 J, equal to the total loss in equivalent 2 Ω. Every part matches answer 5-24 on printed p. 336/PDF p. 345.

title.zh: 理想电压源将RL与RC暂态分开
title.en: An ideal voltage source separates RL and RC transients

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图5-23所示电路在开关S闭合前已经达到稳态，t=0时刻开关闭合，求开关闭合后的电流i(t)。
statement.en: The circuit in Fig. 5-23 reaches steady state before S closes at t = 0. Find current i(t) after closing.

alt.zh: 左支路为25 V源上正下负，向上经5 Ω、再经顶端0.5 H电感到节点A。A经顶端10 Ω到右节点B，B经竖直10 Ω接地；B还经0.2 F电容及上正下负40 V源串联接地。S闭合后把A接到上正下负10 V源上端，所求i(t)沿S和10 V源向下。
alt.en: The left top-positive 25 V source connects upward through 5 Ω and then upper 0.5 H to node A. A connects through upper 10 Ω to B, which connects through vertical 10 Ω to ground. Another B-to-ground branch contains a 0.2 F capacitor followed by a top-positive 40 V source. Closing S connects A to the top of a top-positive 10 V source. Requested i(t) flows down through S and that 10 V source.

prerequisites.zh: 直流稳态；电感电流、电容电压连续；分别求RL、RC响应；节点KCL。
prerequisites.en: DC steady state, inductor-current and capacitor-voltage continuity, separate RL/RC responses and nodal KCL.

recognition.zh: 开关闭合后A被理想10 V源固定为10 V，使左右动态支路各自成为一阶电路。先分别求电感流入A的电流和A流向右侧的电流，再相减得到开关支路电流。
recognition.en: After closing, the ideal 10 V source fixes A at 10 V, making the left and right dynamic branches independently first order. Find current entering A from the inductor and current leaving A to the right, then subtract.

text.zh: S打开稳态时电感短路、电容开路。25 V通过5 Ω、10 Ω、10 Ω串联，电流1 A，故A=20 V、B=10 V。电容下端是40 V，所以上正下负电容电压为−30 V。
text.en: With S open in steady state, short the inductor and open the capacitor. The 25 V source drives 1 A through series 5 Ω, 10 Ω and 10 Ω, giving A = 20 V and B = 10 V. The capacitor lower terminal is at 40 V, so its top-positive voltage is −30 V.

steps.formula: i_L(0^+)=1\,\mathrm A,\qquad u_C(0^+)=-30\,\mathrm V,\qquad v_B(0^+)=10\,\mathrm V

text.zh: 取电感电流由左向右流入A。换路后A=10 V，25 V与10 V之差15 V作用在5 Ω、0.5 H上。最终电流3 A，时间常数0.1 s。
text.en: Reference inductor current leftward-to-right into A. With A = 10 V, 15 V drives 5 Ω and 0.5 H. The final current is 3 A and time constant 0.1 s.

title.en: Solve the right RC node voltage

text.zh: 稳态时B在两个10 Ω间分得5 V，初值10 V；电容看入电阻10 Ω∥10 Ω=5 Ω，时间常数5×0.2=1 s。40 V下端源为恒定值，所以B与电容电压具有相同时间常数。
text.en: B approaches 5 V from its 10 V initial value through the two 10 Ω resistors. The capacitor sees 10 Ω∥10 Ω = 5 Ω, giving τ = 5×0.2 = 1 s. Its lower terminal remains at 40 V, so B and capacitor voltage share this time constant.

title.en: Recover the requested current by KCL

text.zh: A点流入电感电流，流出右支路与向下i。因此所求i等于左电流减右电流。
text.en: At A, inductor current enters, while right-branch current and downward i leave. Hence i is left current minus right current.

answer.en: i(t) = 2.5−2e^(−10t)+0.5e^(−t) A for t≥0, with downward positive.

pitfalls.zh: 电容初始电压是10−40=−30 V，不是节点B的10 V。
pitfalls.en: Initial capacitor voltage is 10−40 = −30 V, not B’s 10 V.

pitfalls.zh: 所求i不是电感电流；必须扣除流向右侧的电流。
pitfalls.en: The requested i is not the inductor current; subtract current going right.

methods.zh: 独立原支路方程：0.5diL/dt+5iL=15，和(B−10)/10+B/10+0.2d(B−40)/dt=0，代入两个响应严格成立；节点A的i=iL−(10−B)/10给出同式。初值i(0⁺)=1 A、最终i(∞)=2.5 A。另将所有电阻耗散、25 V/10 V/40 V源吸收功率及电感电容储能变化率按指数系数精确相加，恒等于0。书第336页/PDF345页5-27一致。
methods.en: Independent branch equations are 0.5diL/dt+5iL = 15 and (B−10)/10 + B/10 + 0.2d(B−40)/dt = 0. Both responses satisfy them exactly, and A-node KCL i = iL−(10−B)/10 reproduces the result. Initial i(0⁺) is 1 A and final i is 2.5 A. An exact exponential-coefficient audit also sums all resistor losses, absorbed source powers and storage-energy rates to zero for every t. Answer 5-27 on printed p. 336/PDF p. 345 agrees.

title.zh: 二次换路：第二段从实际换路值重新开始
title.en: Two switching events: restart from the actual second-switch state

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图5-25所示电路中，开关S原来处于端钮1时，电路已经达到稳态，t=0时刻开关S从端钮1接到端钮2，t=2 s时刻开关S又从端钮2接到端钮1，求t≥0时的u(t)。
statement.en: In Fig. 5-25, the circuit is initially in steady state with S at terminal 1. At t = 0, S moves from 1 to 2; at t = 2 s, it returns from 2 to 1. Find u(t) for t≥0.

alt.zh: 左5 mA电流源向上注入节点A，A经顶端2 kΩ到输出节点B。A另经2 kΩ到开关端钮1；B另经1 kΩ到端钮2，开关公共端接底部地。B经50 μF电容再经上正下负3 V源接地。电容电压uC上正下负，输出u从B到地上正下负，所以u=uC+3 V。
alt.en: A 5 mA upward source injects node A. Upper 2 kΩ joins A to output B. A also connects through 2 kΩ to switch terminal 1; B through 1 kΩ to terminal 2. The switch common is grounded. B connects to ground through a 50 μF capacitor followed by a top-positive 3 V source. Capacitor voltage uC and output u are top-positive, with u = uC+3 V.

prerequisites.zh: 分段一阶响应；电容电压连续；每次换路重新求时间常数与最终值。
prerequisites.en: Piecewise first-order responses, capacitor-voltage continuity and new final values/time constants at each switch.

recognition.zh: 输出u不是单独的电容电压，但3 V恒定，所以它也连续。第二段必须从第一段在2 s的实际值开始，并将时间原点移到2 s。
recognition.en: Output u is not the capacitor voltage alone, but its 3 V offset is constant, so u is continuous too. Start the second segment from the actual first-segment value at 2 s and shift its time origin to 2 s.

text.zh: S在1时，电容开路，顶端2 kΩ无电流，5 mA全流过左竖直2 kΩ，所以A、B均为10 V。电容初始电压为10−3=7 V。
text.en: With S at 1 and the capacitor open in steady state, upper 2 kΩ carries no current. All 5 mA flows through the left vertical 2 kΩ, giving A = B = 10 V. Initial capacitor voltage is 10−3 = 7 V.

text.zh: 此时左竖直2 kΩ下端悬空，电流源通过顶端2 kΩ向B送入5 mA。最终u=5 mA×1 kΩ=5 V。源置零开路后电容看到1 kΩ，故τ₁=0.05 s。
text.en: The left vertical 2 kΩ ends open. The source sends 5 mA through upper 2 kΩ into B. Final u is 5 mA×1 kΩ = 5 V. Opening the zeroed current source leaves a 1 kΩ resistance seen by the capacitor, so τ₁ = 0.05 s.

title.en: Retain the exact state at 2 s

text.zh: 两秒相当于40个时间常数，虽已极接近5 V，严格初值仍为5+5e⁻⁴⁰ V。电容电压与输出在换路时都连续。
text.en: Two seconds is 40 time constants, so u is extremely close to 5 V, but exactly 5+5e^(−40) V. Both capacitor voltage and output remain continuous at switching.

text.zh: 最终u回到10 V。源置零后电容经顶端2 kΩ和左竖直2 kΩ串联放电，τ₂=4 kΩ×50 μF=0.2 s。以t−2为新时间变量，从精确换路值出发。
text.en: The final output returns to 10 V. After source suppression, the capacitor sees upper 2 kΩ in series with left vertical 2 kΩ, giving τ₂ = 4 kΩ×50 μF = 0.2 s. Use t−2 and the exact switching value.

text.zh: 书后第二段写10−5e⁻⁵⁽ᵗ⁻²⁾ V，相当于把e⁻⁴⁰舍去。它在工程精度下足够准确，但这里保留小项以严格满足连续性。
text.en: The appendix writes 10−5e^(−5(t−2)) V for the second segment, dropping e^(−40). This is excellent numerically, but the retained term enforces exact continuity.

answer.en:
For 0≤t≤2 s: u = 5+5e^(−20t) V.
For t>2 s: u = 10−5(1−e^(−40))e^(−5(t−2)) V.
The appendix’s second segment, 10−5e^(−5(t−2)) V, is the approximation dropping the tiny residual.

pitfalls.zh: 第二段指数是t−2，不是t；时间常数从0.05 s变为0.2 s。
pitfalls.en: The second exponent uses t−2, not t; the time constant changes from 0.05 s to 0.2 s.

pitfalls.zh: 不能把输出u与电容电压uC混用；二者相差恒定3 V。
pitfalls.en: Do not confuse output u with capacitor voltage uC; they differ by a constant 3 V.

methods.zh: 独立原方程：第一段50 μF du/dt+u/1000=5 mA；第二段50 μF du/dt+(u−10)/4000=0。两个分段式逐项代入残差均为0，2 s左右极限均为5+5e⁻⁴⁰ V，最终u=10 V。对应电容电压从7 V趋向2 V，再趋向7 V。书第336页/PDF345页5-29第一段完全一致；第二段是舍去5e⁻⁴⁰ V残余的近似，相差最大约2.12×10⁻¹⁷ V，并非第二次换路可令电容跳变。
methods.en: Independent equations: the first segment satisfies 50 μF du/dt + u/1000 = 5 mA; the second satisfies 50 μF du/dt + (u−10)/4000 = 0. Both residuals vanish identically, both limits at 2 s equal 5+5e^(−40) V, and the final output is 10 V. Capacitor voltage goes from 7 V toward 2 V, then toward 7 V. Answer 5-29 on printed p. 336/PDF p. 345 matches the first segment exactly; its second is the approximation dropping the residual 5e^(−40) V, with maximum difference about 2.12×10⁻¹⁷ V. Switching does not permit a capacitor-voltage jump.

appendixComparison.reason: The appendix drops exp(-40) at the second switch; the supplied solution retains it for exact continuity.

title.zh: 阶跃波形：由跳变时刻与方向写函数
title.en: Step waveforms: encode transition time and direction

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 用单位阶跃函数表示题图5-27所示的3个电压波形。
statement.en: Express the three voltage waveforms in Fig. 5-27 using the unit-step function.

alt.zh: (a) u₁在t<1 s时为0，在t>1 s时为5 V；(b) u₂在t<−1 s时为0，在t>−1 s时为5 V；(c) u₃在t<1 s时为5 V，在t>1 s时为0。图中跳变点单点取值未指定。
alt.en: (a) u₁ is 0 for t<1 s and 5 V for t>1 s. (b) u₂ is 0 for t<−1 s and 5 V for t>−1 s. (c) u₃ is 5 V for t<1 s and 0 for t>1 s. Values exactly at the jumps are unspecified.

prerequisites.zh: 单位阶跃ε(t)；平移；时间反向；下降阶跃。
prerequisites.en: The unit step ε(t), time translation, time reversal and falling steps.

recognition.zh: 把“什么时候跳、跳多大、向上还是向下”分开判断。ε(t−t₀)在t₀后开启；ε(t₀−t)在t₀前开启。
recognition.en: Identify when the jump occurs, its size and its direction separately. ε(t−t₀) is on after t₀; ε(t₀−t) is on before t₀.

text.zh: t−1在1 s前为负、1 s后为正，因此乘5 V得到图(a)。
text.en: t−1 is negative before 1 s and positive afterward; multiplying by 5 V gives waveform (a).

text.zh: 跳变在−1 s，所以函数参数为t−(−1)=t+1。
text.en: The jump is at −1 s, so the argument is t−(−1) = t+1.

text.zh: 在1 s前应开启、之后关闭，因此使用反向参数1−t；也可写5[1−ε(t−1)]，但跳点取值须使用一致约定。
text.en: It must be on before 1 s and off afterward, so use 1−t. One can also write 5[1−ε(t−1)], with a consistent convention at the jump.

pitfalls.zh: 提前到−1 s的阶跃是t+1，不是t−1。
pitfalls.en: A step advanced to −1 s uses t+1, not t−1.

pitfalls.zh: 下降阶跃需要反向或相减，不能直接再用正的5ε(t−1)。
pitfalls.en: A falling step requires reversal or subtraction, not another positive 5ε(t−1).

methods.zh: 独立区间取值核验：在t=−2、0、2 s代入三式，依次得到(0,0,5)、(0,5,5)、(5,5,0) V，与图的左右平台一致；跳变量分别+5、+5、−5 V。图未规定跳点取值，采用同一ε(0)约定即可。书第336页/PDF345页5-31三式一致。
methods.en: Independent interval checks: at t = −2, 0 and 2 s, the three expressions give (0,0,5), (0,5,5) and (5,5,0) V, matching the plotted plateaus. Jump sizes are +5, +5 and −5 V. The graph does not specify point values at the jumps; use one consistent ε(0) convention. All three expressions match answer 5-31 on printed p. 336/PDF p. 345.

title.zh: 有效值相量：先统一余弦形式，再除以√2
title.en: RMS phasors: convert to cosine, then divide by √2

source.title: 电路分析基础
source.figure: 题干原式（本题无独立题图）

statement.zh:
写出下列正弦量的有效值相量。
(1) u₁(t)=cosωt；(2) u₂(t)=−sinωt；(3) u₃(t)=−cosωt；(4) u₄(t)=sinωt。
statement.en:
Write the RMS phasors of the following sinusoidal quantities:
(1) u₁(t) = cosωt; (2) u₂(t) = −sinωt; (3) u₃(t) = −cosωt; (4) u₄(t) = sinωt.

prerequisites.zh: 余弦基准有效值相量；正弦与余弦相差90°；负号等价于180°相移。
prerequisites.en: Cosine-reference RMS phasors, the 90° sine/cosine shift and the 180° phase reversal for a negative sign.

recognition.zh: 本书采用余弦基准。每个波形幅值为1，故有效值均为1/√2。相量的相角必须从化为正幅值余弦后的初相角读取。
recognition.en: The book uses a cosine reference. All amplitudes are 1, so every RMS magnitude is 1/√2. Read the phase after converting to a positive-amplitude cosine.

text.zh: 若u=Uₘcos(ωt+φ)，有效值相量为(Uₘ/√2)∠φ。不要把相量幅值仍写成原波形的峰值。
text.en: For u = Uₘcos(ωt+φ), the RMS phasor is (Uₘ/√2)∠φ. Do not retain the waveform’s peak magnitude in an RMS phasor.

text.zh: cosωt的相角为0°；−cosωt=cos(ωt+180°)。负号进入相角，有效值大小保持非负。
text.en: cosωt has phase 0°. Also −cosωt = cos(ωt+180°). Move the negative sign into the phase and keep the RMS magnitude nonnegative.

text.zh: −sinωt=cos(ωt+90°)，sinωt=cos(ωt−90°)。所以负正弦对应+90°，正正弦对应−90°。
text.en: −sinωt = cos(ωt+90°) and sinωt = cos(ωt−90°). Thus negative sine gives +90° and positive sine gives −90°.

pitfalls.zh: 使用余弦基准时sinωt对应−90°，不是+90°。
pitfalls.en: Under a cosine reference, sinωt has phase −90°, not +90°.

pitfalls.zh: 有效值相量的模为1/√2，不是1。
pitfalls.en: An RMS phasor has magnitude 1/√2 here, not 1.

methods.zh: 独立逆变换核验：将四个相量分别代入u(t)=√2 Re{U̇eʲωᵗ}，还原为cosωt、−sinωt、−cosωt、sinωt；多组时间点数值核验相符。各相量模平方均为1/2，与单位幅值正弦波的周期均方值相同。书第337页/PDF346页7-6给出的0.707及四个相角一致。
methods.en: Independent inverse-transform check: u(t) = √2 Re{U̇e^(jωt)} reconstructs cosωt, −sinωt, −cosωt and sinωt. Numerical checks at multiple times agree. Every squared magnitude is 1/2, the cycle mean-square value of a unit-amplitude sinusoid. The 0.707 magnitudes and all four angles match answer 7-6 on printed p. 337/PDF p. 346.

title.zh: 并联RC电流正交：有效值用勾股关系
title.en: Orthogonal parallel-RC currents: use the RMS right triangle

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图7-6所示正弦交流电路中，已知I=10 A，I₂=6 A，求电流I₁。
statement.en: For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-6, I = 10 A and I₂ = 6 A are RMS magnitudes. Find I₁.

alt.zh: 输入电流I向右，经串联jωL后进入并联电容与电阻R。电容阻抗−j/(ωC)，支路电流I₁向下；电阻支路电流I₂向下。下方为公共返回线。
alt.en: Input current I goes right through series jωL, then splits into parallel capacitor and resistor R. The capacitor impedance is −j/(ωC), with I₁ downward. The resistor branch has I₂ downward. The bottom is the common return.

prerequisites.zh: 相量KCL；并联共电压；电容电流超前电压90°，电阻电流同相。
prerequisites.en: Phasor KCL, common parallel voltage, capacitor current leading by 90° and in-phase resistor current.

recognition.zh: 电容支路和电阻支路共有电压，两个电流相差90°。因此10 A不是两个支路有效值的算术和，必须对正交相量求模。
recognition.en: The capacitor and resistor share a voltage, so their currents are 90° apart. The 10 A total is not the arithmetic sum of branch RMS magnitudes; take the magnitude of orthogonal phasors.

text.zh: 取并联两端电压为0°基准。电阻电流I₂=6∠0° A，电容电流I₁=jI₁。上游串联电感不改变这两个并联支路电流之间的90°关系。
text.en: Choose the parallel voltage as the 0° reference. The resistor current is 6∠0° A and capacitor current is jI₁. The upstream series inductor does not change the 90° relation between the two parallel currents.

title.zh: 用总电流的模求支路有效值
title.en: Use the total magnitude to recover the branch RMS value

text.zh: 相量实部、虚部正交，所以总电流有效值平方为两支路平方和。
text.en: Real and imaginary components are orthogonal, so the squared total RMS magnitude is the sum of the squared branch magnitudes.

title.zh: 区分相对相角与绝对相角

text.zh: 在所选并联电压基准下，可写İ₁=j8 A、İ=6+j8 A。题目未提供全电路的绝对相位，确定的数值答案是I₁的有效值8 A。
text.en: Relative to the chosen parallel-voltage reference, İ₁ = j8 A and İ = 6+j8 A. The problem gives no overall absolute phase; the determined numerical answer is the RMS magnitude I₁ = 8 A.

answer.zh: I₁=8 A（有效值）。取并联电压为0°时，İ₁=8∠90° A。
answer.en: I₁ = 8 A RMS. With parallel voltage chosen as 0°, İ₁ = 8∠90° A.

pitfalls.zh: 不能写I₁=10−6=4 A；只有相量而非模满足直接相加。
pitfalls.en: Do not write I₁ = 10−6 = 4 A; phasors, not their magnitudes, add directly.

pitfalls.zh: 题目未给绝对相位，不能把自选参考角当作已知绝对相角。
pitfalls.en: Do not present a chosen reference phase as an externally given absolute phase.

methods.zh: 独立复数核验：6+j8的模为√(36+64)=10，电阻与电容电流的均方交叉项2Re{6·(j8)*}=0，所以总均方值为100 A²。相量KCL与周期均方关系独立吻合。书第337页/PDF346页7-12为8 A。
methods.en: Independent complex check: |6+j8| = √(36+64) = 10. The RMS cross term is 2Re{6·(j8)*} = 0, so the total mean square is 100 A². Phasor KCL and the cycle mean-square relation agree independently. Answer 7-12 on printed p. 337/PDF p. 346 is 8 A.

title.zh: 串联未知元件：相量相减后求阻抗
title.en: An unknown series element: subtract phasor voltages, then divide

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图7-11所示正弦交流电路中，已知U̇=10∠53.1° V，U̇₁=6∠0° V，求İ、U̇₂及未知元件的复阻抗Z₂，并说明该元件是什么元件。
statement.en: For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-11, U̇ = 10∠53.1° V and U̇₁ = 6∠0° V. Find İ, U̇₂ and the unknown element impedance Z₂, and identify the element.

alt.zh: 左电压源U̇上正下负，串联上方3 Ω电阻与右侧Z₂。电流İ顺时针；电阻电压U̇₁左正右负，Z₂电压U̇₂上正下负，均为关联参考方向。
alt.en: The left source U̇ is positive at the top and drives series upper 3 Ω and right Z₂. Current İ is clockwise. U̇₁ across 3 Ω is positive on the left; U̇₂ across Z₂ is positive at the top. Both use passive references.

prerequisites.zh: 有效值相量；串联KVL；矩形式复数相减；阻抗虚部判别。
prerequisites.en: RMS phasors, series KVL, rectangular complex subtraction and impedance classification by reactance.

recognition.zh: 电阻电压先给出电流相量。再把总电压化为矩形式与6 V相减，最后除以电流。给定53.1°是6−8−10三角形角度53.130…°的一位小数近似。
