completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 从转移曲线判断MOS类型及阈值
title.en: Read MOS type and threshold from transfer curves

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图题4.1.1所示为MOS管的转移特性，请分别说明各属于何种类型的MOS管。指出它们的阈值电压各为多少？（图中i_D的参考方向为流进漏极。）
statement.en: Fig. 4.1.1 shows MOS transfer characteristics. Identify the type of MOSFET represented by each curve and state its threshold voltage. The reference direction of i_D is into the drain.

alt.zh: 三条i_D-v_GS曲线：(a)i_D为正，零电流交点v_GS=-3 V且v_GS=0时仍有正电流；(b)i_D为负，零电流交点+2 V且v_GS=0时有负电流；(c)i_D为负，在v_GS=-4 V进入导通，v_GS=0时截止。
alt.en: Three i_D versus v_GS curves: (a) positive i_D, zero-current threshold at -3 V and nonzero current at v_GS = 0; (b) negative i_D, threshold at +2 V and nonzero current at zero gate voltage; (c) negative i_D, onset at -4 V and off at zero gate voltage.

prerequisites.zh: NMOS/PMOS电流方向；增强型/耗尽型定义；阈值电压的带符号值。
prerequisites.en: NMOS/PMOS current directions; enhancement/depletion definitions; signed threshold voltage.

recognition.zh: 先用漏极电流符号识别N/P沟道，再看v_GS=0是否已导通识别增强/耗尽，最后读曲线与横轴的阈值交点。
recognition.en: Use the drain-current sign to identify N/P channel, then inspect conduction at v_GS = 0 to distinguish enhancement/depletion, and finally read the threshold at the zero-current intercept.

title.en: (a): positive drain current and conduction at zero gate voltage

text.zh: 电流参考方向流进漏极，正i_D对应NMOS。v_GS=0时已有电流，故为耗尽型，阈值读为-3 V。
text.en: With i_D referenced into the drain, positive current indicates NMOS. Nonzero current at v_GS = 0 identifies depletion mode, with threshold -3 V.

title.en: (b): negative drain current and conduction at zero gate voltage

text.zh: 负i_D表示实际电流流出漏极，对应PMOS。零栅压仍导通，故为耗尽型；正向栅压增至+2 V才截止，阈值+2 V。
text.en: Negative i_D means current leaves the drain, identifying PMOS. Conduction at zero gate voltage indicates depletion mode; a positive gate voltage of +2 V is needed to cut it off, so the threshold is +2 V.

title.zh: (c)：负漏极电流且需负栅压开启
title.en: (c): negative drain current requiring negative gate voltage

text.zh: 负i_D对应PMOS。v_GS=0时截止，只有栅压低于-4 V才导通，因此为增强型PMOS，阈值-4 V。
text.en: Negative i_D identifies PMOS. It is off at v_GS = 0 and turns on only when v_GS falls below -4 V, so it is an enhancement-mode PMOS with threshold -4 V.

answer.zh: (a)耗尽型NMOS，V_TN=-3 V；(b)耗尽型PMOS，V_TP=+2 V；(c)增强型PMOS，V_TP=-4 V。
answer.en: (a) Depletion-mode NMOS, V_TN = -3 V. (b) Depletion-mode PMOS, V_TP = +2 V. (c) Enhancement-mode PMOS, V_TP = -4 V.

pitfalls.zh: PMOS阈值不能一概写成负值，耗尽型PMOS阈值可为正。
pitfalls.en: A PMOS threshold is not always negative; depletion-mode PMOS can have a positive threshold.

pitfalls.zh: 阈值读取电流刚消失的横轴交点，不读取纵轴电流截距。
pitfalls.en: Read the threshold from the zero-current gate-voltage intercept, not the drain-current-axis intercept.

methods.zh: 按三项独立特征复核：电流符号确定沟道类型，零栅压是否导通确定增强/耗尽，曲线开始导通方向与阈值符号满足NMOS v_GS>V_TN、PMOS v_GS<V_TP。三图均一致。
methods.en: Cross-checked three independent features: current sign identifies channel type, zero-gate conduction identifies enhancement/depletion, and the onset direction agrees with NMOS v_GS > V_TN or PMOS v_GS < V_TP. All three curves are consistent.

assumptions.zh: 按图中i_D流入漏极的参考方向；以理想转移曲线读取阈值。
assumptions.en: Drain-current reference is into the drain, as stated; thresholds are read from the ideal transfer curves.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。
completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 由迁移率、氧化层电容及宽长比求NMOS电流
title.en: Find NMOS current from mobility, oxide capacitance and aspect ratio

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设增强型NMOS管的参数为V_TN=1 V，W=100 μm，L=5 μm，μ_n=650 cm²/(V·s)，C_ox=76.7×10⁻⁹ F/cm²。已知V_GS=2V_TN时，MOS管工作在恒流区，试计算此时的电流I_D。
statement.en: An enhancement-mode NMOS has V_TN = 1 V, W = 100 μm, L = 5 μm, μ_n = 650 cm²/(V·s), and C_ox = 76.7 × 10⁻⁹ F/cm². At V_GS = 2V_TN it operates in saturation. Calculate I_D.

prerequisites.zh: MOS饱和区平方律；过驱动电压；单位一致性。
prerequisites.en: MOS saturation square law; overdrive voltage; consistent units.

recognition.zh: 先算过驱动V_GS-V_TN和几何比W/L，再把迁移率与单位面积电容相乘。直接使用完整平方律，避免不同K定义造成漏掉1/2。
recognition.en: First find overdrive V_GS - V_TN and aspect ratio W/L, then multiply mobility by capacitance per unit area. Use the complete square-law expression to avoid losing the factor 1/2 under differing K conventions.

text.zh: V_GS=2V_TN=2 V，故过驱动为1 V；W、L同用μm，因此比值为20。
text.en: V_GS = 2V_TN = 2 V, giving overdrive 1 V. W and L are both in μm, so their ratio is 20.

text.zh: 忽略沟道长度调制，恒流区电流为(1/2)μ_n C_ox(W/L)V_OV²。μ_n中的cm²与C_ox中的cm⁻²互消。
text.en: Neglecting channel-length modulation, saturation current is (1/2)μ_n C_ox(W/L)V_OV². The cm² in mobility cancels the cm⁻² in oxide capacitance.
Substituting 650, 76.7 × 10⁻⁹, 20 and 1² gives 4.9855 × 10⁻⁴ A, approximately 0.499 mA.

text.zh: 题目已经说明处于恒流区，该假设要求V_DS≥V_GS-V_TN=1 V。题目未给V_DS，因此只能列出这一必要条件，不能编造具体漏源电压。
text.en: The exercise states saturation operation, which requires V_DS ≥ V_GS - V_TN = 1 V. No V_DS is supplied, so this condition can be stated but a particular drain-source voltage cannot be invented.

answer.zh: 忽略沟道长度调制，I_D=0.49855 mA≈0.499 mA（约0.50 mA）；题设恒流区要求V_DS≥1 V。
answer.en: Neglecting channel-length modulation, I_D = 0.49855 mA ≈ 0.499 mA (about 0.50 mA). The stated saturation region requires V_DS ≥ 1 V.

pitfalls.zh: 式中已有1/2，不要因另定义K而再乘或再除一次2。
pitfalls.en: The full equation already contains 1/2; do not multiply or divide by 2 again when introducing K.

pitfalls.zh: 原题C_ox为76.7×10⁻⁹ F/cm²，不能误读成10⁻⁸。
pitfalls.en: The original C_ox is 76.7 × 10⁻⁹ F/cm², not 10⁻⁸.

methods.zh: 第二次独立使用SI单位：μ_n=0.065 m²/(V·s)，C_ox=7.67×10⁻⁴ F/m²，代入同一物理模型得到0.00049855 A，与cm单位计算一致；并检查过驱动1 V为正。
methods.en: Independent SI-unit check: μ_n = 0.065 m²/(V·s) and C_ox = 7.67 × 10⁻⁴ F/m². Substitution gives 0.00049855 A, matching the cm-unit calculation; the overdrive is also positive at 1 V.

assumptions.zh: 理想长沟道MOS平方律，忽略沟道长度调制；按题设处于恒流区。
assumptions.en: Ideal long-channel MOS square law, neglecting channel-length modulation, with saturation operation as stated.

completionNote.zh: 7个小问均已核验；第（6）问给出附模型边界的条件化答案：按本教材式（4.1.11）为可变电阻区，但真实体源相连器件的漏-体结正偏，不能仅用四区近似描述整个器件。
completionNote.en: All seven parts are checked. Part (6) has a conditional answer with an explicit model limitation: textbook Eq. (4.1.11) classifies it as triode, while a real source-tied-body device has a forward-biased drain-body junction and cannot be described completely by the four-region approximation alone.

title.zh: MOS工作区：先判导通，再比较夹断边界
title.en: MOS operating regions: check turn-on before the pinch-off boundary

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh:
测量电路中MOS管的漏源电压、栅源电压值如下，它们的阈值电压也已知，试判断各管工作在什么区域（恒流区、可变电阻区、夹断点或截止区）。设MOS管的衬底电极均与源极并接在一起。
（1）V_DS=3 V，V_GS=2 V，V_TN=1 V；（2）V_DS=1 V，V_GS=2 V，V_TN=1 V；（3）V_DS=3 V，V_GS=1 V，V_TN=1.5 V；（4）V_DS=3 V，V_GS=-1 V，V_TN=-2 V；（5）V_DS=-3 V，V_GS=-2 V，V_TP=-1 V；（6）V_DS=3 V，V_GS=-2 V，V_TP=-1 V；（7）V_DS=-3 V，V_GS=-1 V，V_TP=-1.5 V。
statement.en:
Measured MOS drain-source and gate-source voltages, together with known thresholds, are listed below. Determine whether each transistor is in saturation, the variable-resistance region, the pinch-off boundary, or cutoff. Each body is tied to its source.
(1) V_DS=3 V, V_GS=2 V, V_TN=1 V. (2) V_DS=1 V, V_GS=2 V, V_TN=1 V. (3) V_DS=3 V, V_GS=1 V, V_TN=1.5 V. (4) V_DS=3 V, V_GS=-1 V, V_TN=-2 V. (5) V_DS=-3 V, V_GS=-2 V, V_TP=-1 V. (6) V_DS=3 V, V_GS=-2 V, V_TP=-1 V. (7) V_DS=-3 V, V_GS=-1 V, V_TP=-1.5 V.

prerequisites.zh: NMOS/PMOS的带符号阈值；过驱动电压；体结偏置。
prerequisites.en: Signed NMOS/PMOS thresholds; overdrive voltage; body-junction bias.

recognition.zh: 不能把NMOS公式直接套到PMOS上。对正常极性PMOS先改用V_SG、V_SD和|V_TP|；对反常漏源极性另查体结条件。
recognition.en: Do not apply NMOS inequalities directly to PMOS. For normally biased PMOS use V_SG, V_SD and |V_TP|; separately inspect body junctions for reversed drain-source polarity.

text.zh: 在通常V_DS≥0的条件下，先看V_GS是否超过带符号V_TN；导通后再比较V_DS和V_GS−V_TN。
text.en: For normal V_DS≥0, first compare V_GS with the signed threshold V_TN. Once on, compare V_DS with V_GS−V_TN.

text.zh: 两题V_OV均为1 V。（1）3>1，恒流区；（2）1=1，处在夹断边界。
text.en: Both have V_OV=1 V. (1) 3>1: saturation. (2) 1=1: pinch-off boundary.

title.en: (3), (4): retain the sign of a negative threshold

text.zh: （3）1<1.5，未形成沟道，截止。（4）虽V_GS=-1 V，但阈值-2 V更低，过驱动1 V，V_DS=3 V，故恒流区。
text.en: (3) 1<1.5: no channel, cutoff. (4) V_GS=-1 V still exceeds the -2 V threshold; overdrive is 1 V and V_DS=3 V, giving saturation.

text.zh: （5）V_SG=2 V>|V_TP|=1 V，过驱动1 V，V_SD=3 V，恒流区。（7）V_SG=1 V<1.5 V，截止。
text.en: (5) V_SG=2 V exceeds |V_TP|=1 V; its 1 V overdrive is below V_SD=3 V, so it is in saturation. (7) V_SG=1 V<1.5 V: cutoff.

title.zh: （6）：按教材判据给出条件化答案，并核对体结
title.en: (6): give a conditional textbook-model answer and check the body junction

text.zh: 按本教材第97页式（4.1.11）列出的可变电阻区判据，V_GS=-2 V≤V_TP=-1 V，且V_DS=+3 V>V_GS−V_TP=-1 V，因此在该简化判据下答“可变电阻区”。必须同时注明：题设衬底接源，实际PMOS的P型漏区比N型衬底高3 V，漏-体PN结正偏。此时不能仅用忽略体结的四区沟道模型描述整个器件；这个教材模型答案不是对真实器件正常偏置状态的无条件判断。原题的正V_DS和V_TP均保留，不擅自改号或改管型。
text.en: Using the variable-resistance-region inequalities printed in textbook Eq. (4.1.11), p. 97, V_GS=-2 V≤V_TP=-1 V and V_DS=+3 V>V_GS−V_TP=-1 V. Thus the answer under that simplified criterion is the variable-resistance (triode) region. A qualification is essential: with body tied to source, the actual PMOS P-type drain is 3 V above its N-type body, so the drain-body PN junction is forward biased. A four-region channel model that neglects the body junction cannot by itself describe the complete device in this condition. The textbook-model answer is therefore not an unconditional claim about a normally biased real device. Preserve the printed positive V_DS and V_TP; do not silently change a sign or transistor type.

answer.zh: （1）恒流区；（2）夹断点；（3）截止区；（4）恒流区；（5）恒流区；（6）按本教材式（4.1.11）的简化判据为可变电阻区；真实体源相连PMOS在给定正V_DS下漏-体结正偏，须保留此模型适用范围说明；（7）截止区。
answer.en: (1) Saturation. (2) Pinch-off boundary. (3) Cutoff. (4) Saturation. (5) Saturation. (6) Triode under the simplified criterion of textbook Eq. (4.1.11); the real source-tied-body PMOS has a forward-biased drain-body junction at the stated positive V_DS, so the model limitation must accompany the answer. (7) Cutoff.

pitfalls.zh: 负的V_GS不必然意味着截止；要与带符号阈值比较。
pitfalls.en: Negative V_GS does not automatically mean cutoff; compare it with the signed threshold.

pitfalls.zh: 保留原书第（6）问的V_TP和正V_DS，不擅自修题。
pitfalls.en: Preserve the printed V_TP and positive V_DS in part (6); do not silently alter the problem.

methods.zh: 逐项独立核对沟道形成及夹断条件。第（6）问目视核对原题（印刷145–146页/PDF178–179页），再按印刷97页/PDF130页式（4.1.11）的显式代数判据复算；另对照印刷98页/PDF131页的衬底接最高电位、隔离PN结反偏要求，并用MIT课程讲义及Infineon官方应用笔记交叉核对PMOS体二极管方向。未使用外部习题答案。
methods.en: Independently checked channel formation and pinch-off for every part. For (6), visually verified the printed problem (pp. 145–146 / PDF pp. 178–179), then evaluated the explicit algebraic inequalities of Eq. (4.1.11), printed p. 97 / PDF p. 130. Separately checked the body-at-highest-potential and reverse-biased-isolation-junction requirement on printed p. 98 / PDF p. 131, and cross-checked PMOS body-diode orientation with MIT lecture notes and an official Infineon application note. No external exercise answer key was used.

assumptions.zh: （1）（2）（3）（4）（5）（7）采用本章正常漏源极性下的理想长沟道MOS区域模型。（6）的“可变电阻区”仅指采用本教材式（4.1.11）显式判据、忽略漏-体结电流和正偏体结对沟道近似的影响时的模型分类；真实体源相连的器件在给定+3 V漏源偏压下有漏-体结正偏，须另计体二极管及外电路条件。未假设原题印刷错误，也未确定教师的评分答案。
assumptions.en: Parts (1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(7) use the chapter's ideal long-channel MOS region model under normal drain-source polarity. The triode answer for (6) refers only to applying the explicit criterion of textbook Eq. (4.1.11), neglecting drain-body junction current and the effects of forward body-junction bias on the channel approximation. A real source-tied-body device at the given +3 V drain-source bias has a forward-biased drain-body junction and requires body-diode and external-circuit modeling. No printing error or instructor grading decision is assumed.

modelLimitations.zh: 第（6）问的教材代数分类与真实体结偏置须并列保留。仅凭题给三个电压不能计算真实端口电流，也不能证明体结电流可忽略。
modelLimitations.en: Keep both the textbook algebraic classification and the real body-junction bias qualification for (6). The three given voltages do not determine the real terminal current or establish that body-junction current is negligible.

textbookModelEvidence.finding: Variable-resistance inequalities printed as v_GS≤V_TP and v_DS>v_GS−V_TP; the plotted PMOS output curves show normal v_DS≤0 polarity.
The channel-body PN junction must remain reverse biased for isolation; PMOS body is connected to the highest circuit potential.

externalReferences.title: MIT 2.996/6.971 Lecture 3: Diodes and Transistors
externalReferences.relevance: Four-terminal MOSFET and the restriction that the body-drain diode remain reverse biased.

externalReferences.title: Infineon Reverse Battery Protection, section 3.3
externalReferences.relevance: PMOS intrinsic body diode conducts in the drain-to-source direction; the channel can switch on in parallel with it.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

title.zh: 固定分压共源极：算偏置后检查恒流区
title.en: Divider-biased common source: compute bias, then check saturation

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图4.3.6b所示，设R_g1=90 kΩ，R_g2=60 kΩ，R_d=30 kΩ，V_DD=5 V，V_TN=1 V，K_n=0.1 mA/V²。试计算电路的V_GS和V_DS。
statement.en: For the circuit in Fig. 4.3.6(b), R_g1=90 kΩ, R_g2=60 kΩ, R_d=30 kΩ, V_DD=5 V, V_TN=1 V and K_n=0.1 mA/V². Find V_GS and V_DS.

prerequisites.zh: MOS栅极零直流电流；分压；恒流区平方律；KVL。
prerequisites.en: Zero DC gate current; voltage division; saturation square law; KVL.

recognition.zh: 栅极分压不被MOS输入加载，先得V_GS，再假设恒流区算I_D和V_DS，最后检查假设。
recognition.en: The MOS gate does not load the DC divider. Find V_GS, assume saturation to compute I_D and V_DS, then validate that assumption.

text.zh: 源极接地，栅极电流为零，故下分压电阻60 kΩ上的电压就是V_GS。
text.en: The source is grounded and gate current is zero, so V_GS is the voltage across the lower 60 kΩ divider resistor.

text.zh: 采用本书K_n定义I_D=K_n(V_GS−V_TN)²，不额外乘1/2。
text.en: Use the textbook convention I_D=K_n(V_GS−V_TN)²; do not insert an extra factor of 1/2.

text.zh: V_GS>V_TN，且V_DS=2 V超过过驱动1 V，恒流区假设成立。
text.en: V_GS exceeds the threshold, and V_DS=2 V exceeds the 1 V overdrive, so saturation is consistent.

answer.zh: V_GS=2 V，V_DS=2 V，I_D=0.1 mA，工作在恒流区。
answer.en: V_GS=2 V, V_DS=2 V, I_D=0.1 mA; saturation.

pitfalls.zh: 本书K_n已含1/2；与SPICE参数KP不能直接等同。
pitfalls.en: The textbook K_n already includes 1/2; it is not the same as SPICE KP.

methods.zh: 用分压支路电流5 V/150 kΩ=33.333 μA独立回算栅电位；漏极KVL为2+0.1 mA×30 kΩ=5 V；漏端v_GD=0 V低于阈值，夹断条件成立。
methods.en: Independent divider-current check gives 5 V/150 kΩ=33.333 μA and the same gate voltage. Drain KVL is 2+0.1 mA×30 kΩ=5 V. Drain-end v_GD=0 V is below threshold, consistent with pinch-off.

assumptions.zh: 理想长沟道NMOS，忽略沟道长度调制和栅极电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal long-channel NMOS, neglecting channel-length modulation and gate current.

alt.zh: 分压共源极直流电路：90 kΩ自+5 V至栅，60 kΩ自栅至地；源极及衬底接地，漏极通过30 kΩ接+5 V。原图标的是通用参数，数值以本题题干为准。
alt.en: DC common-source circuit: 90 kΩ from +5 V to gate, 60 kΩ from gate to ground, grounded source and body, and 30 kΩ from +5 V to drain. The source figure uses generic labels; use the values in this exercise.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

title.zh: 源极负反馈：分开输入增益与源增益
title.en: Source degeneration: distinguish input gain from source gain

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图4.4.6a所示。已知R_d=10 kΩ，R_si=R_s=0.5 kΩ，R_g1=165 kΩ，R_g2=35 kΩ，MOS管参数V_TN=0.8 V，K_n=1 mA/V²，λ=0。电路静态工作点处V_GS=1.5 V。试求电压增益A_v=v_o/v_i、源电压增益A_vs=v_o/v_s、输入电阻R_i和输出电阻R_o。
statement.en: For Fig. 4.4.6(a), R_d=10 kΩ, R_si=R_s=0.5 kΩ, R_g1=165 kΩ, R_g2=35 kΩ, V_TN=0.8 V, K_n=1 mA/V² and λ=0. At the bias point V_GS=1.5 V. Find A_v=v_o/v_i, A_vs=v_o/v_s, input resistance R_i, and output resistance R_o.

prerequisites.zh: MOS互导；源极负反馈；输入分压；测试源法求输出电阻。
prerequisites.en: MOS transconductance; source degeneration; input division; output-resistance test source.

recognition.zh: R_s没有旁路，不能使用−g_mR_d。先在输入端v_i处求增益，再乘信号源内阻造成的分压求A_vs。
recognition.en: R_s is unbypassed, so −g_mR_d is not the gain. First find the gain from actual input v_i, then include source-resistance division for A_vs.

title.en: Find g_m from the bias point

text.zh: 过驱动0.7 V。由本书平方律求I_DQ=0.49 mA，互导为1.4 mS。λ=0意味着r_ds→∞。
text.en: The overdrive is 0.7 V. The textbook square law gives I_DQ=0.49 mA and g_m=1.4 mS. λ=0 makes r_ds infinite.

text.zh: 中频时电容短路，直流电源交流接地。i_d=g_m(v_i−v_s′)，源极交流电压v_s′=i_dR_s，输出v_o=−i_dR_d。
text.en: At midband, capacitors are shorts and DC supplies are AC grounds. With source-node AC voltage v_s′, i_d=g_m(v_i−v_s′), v_s′=i_dR_s and v_o=−i_dR_d.

text.zh: MOS栅极无电流，输入负载是两个偏置电阻并联。源增益还要考虑R_si=0.5 kΩ。
text.en: The gate draws no current, so input loading is the parallel bias resistors. Source gain also includes R_si=0.5 kΩ.

text.zh: 求输出电阻时输入信号源置零。λ=0时漏端测试电压不会经r_ds影响源极，因此受控电流不因测试电压而变化，输出只见R_d。
text.en: Set the input source to zero. With λ=0, a drain test voltage cannot feed back through r_ds to the source; the controlled current does not change with that test voltage. The output sees R_d alone.

pitfalls.zh: R_s未旁路，分母中的1+g_mR_s不能省。
pitfalls.en: R_s is not bypassed; retain 1+g_mR_s.

pitfalls.zh: 输入端v_i位于R_si之后，A_v与A_vs定义不同。
pitfalls.en: Input v_i is after R_si, so A_v and A_vs have different definitions.

methods.zh: 独立给输入端1 V测试量，联立源极KCL得v_s′=7/17 V、v_gs=10/17 V、i_d=14/17 mA，输出−140/17 V；再独立将源信号1 V经过R_si与R_i分压回算A_vs。输出端1 V测试得0.1 mA。
methods.en: An independent 1 V input test and source-node KCL give v_s′=7/17 V, v_gs=10/17 V, i_d=14/17 mA and output −140/17 V. A separate 1 V source test including R_si and R_i reproduces A_vs. A 1 V output test gives 0.1 mA.

assumptions.zh: 中频小信号、题设恒流区工作点、λ=0，无外接负载。
assumptions.en: Midband small signal, the stated saturation bias point, λ=0, no external load.

alt.zh: 源极带未旁路0.5 kΩ的NMOS共源电路，漏极10 kΩ到正电源；栅极由165 kΩ、35 kΩ偏置，信号源串0.5 kΩ，经耦合电容输入，输出经耦合电容从漏极取出。
alt.en: NMOS common source with an unbypassed 0.5 kΩ source resistor, 10 kΩ drain resistor, 165 kΩ/35 kΩ gate divider, 0.5 kΩ signal-source resistance and coupling capacitors at input and output.

completionNote.zh: 全题四问已完成。第（4）问已实际运行ngspice 47，并用保留电容的节点方程交叉核验；模型自行算得的g_m与前3问给定值稍有差异。
completionNote.en: All four parts are complete. Part (4) was executed in ngspice 47 and cross-checked by nodal equations retaining the capacitors. The model-derived g_m differs slightly from the given value in parts (1)–(3).

title.zh: 只旁路R₂：看清分压节点与源极节点
title.en: Only R₂ is bypassed: distinguish bias and source nodes

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh:
已知电路参数如图题4.4.3所示，MOS管工作点上的互导g_m=1 mS，设r_ds≫R_d。（1）画出电路的小信号等效电路；（2）求电压增益A_v；（3）求电路的输入电阻R_i和输出电阻R_o；（4）设输入信号v_i为正弦波，其频率为1 kHz、幅值为10 mV，MOS管参数设置为K_P=110 μA/V²，W=40 μm，L=2 μm，V_TO=1.7 V，试用SPICE观测v_i、v_o波形。
图中：V_DD=20 V，R_d=10 kΩ，R_g1=300 kΩ，R_g2=100 kΩ，R_g3=2 MΩ，R₁=2 kΩ，R₂=10 kΩ，C₁=0.02 μF，C₂=4.7 μF，C=47 μF。
statement.en:
Use the component values in Fig. 4.4.3, with bias-point g_m=1 mS and r_ds≫R_d. (1) Draw the small-signal equivalent. (2) Find voltage gain A_v. (3) Find input resistance R_i and output resistance R_o. (4) With sinusoidal v_i of frequency 1 kHz and amplitude 10 mV, use SPICE to observe v_i and v_o, setting K_P=110 μA/V², W=40 μm, L=2 μm and V_TO=1.7 V.
Figure values: V_DD=20 V; R_d=10 kΩ; R_g1=300 kΩ; R_g2=100 kΩ; R_g3=2 MΩ; R₁=2 kΩ; R₂=10 kΩ; C₁=0.02 μF; C₂=4.7 μF; C=47 μF.

prerequisites.zh: 交流等效；源极负反馈；偏置网络输入负载；SPICE参数定义。
prerequisites.en: AC equivalent circuits; source degeneration; bias-network input loading; SPICE parameter conventions.

recognition.zh: 先沿原图连接找节点。C只旁路R₂；Rg3的下端接偏置分压点，它和R₁/R₂之间的节点没有连接。
recognition.en: Trace the actual nodes first. C bypasses only R₂. The lower end of Rg3 connects to the bias divider, not the junction of R₁ and R₂.

text.zh: 中频时三个电容短路，V_DD交流接地；R₂被旁路，保留源极R₁=2 kΩ。栅极经Rg3=2 MΩ和(Rg1∥Rg2)=75 kΩ串联接地；漏极为10 kΩ接地。MOS用漏到源受控电流源g_mv_gs代替，忽略r_ds。附图按这些节点绘制。
text.en: At midband the three capacitors are shorts and V_DD is AC ground. R₂ is bypassed; R₁=2 kΩ remains. The gate connects to ground through Rg3=2 MΩ in series with Rg1∥Rg2=75 kΩ. The drain has 10 kΩ to ground. Replace MOS with the drain-to-source controlled current g_mv_gs and omit r_ds. The attached equivalent follows these nodes.

text.zh: 输入v_i就是交流栅电位。源极R₁造成局部反馈，交流漏电流为g_mv_i/(1+g_mR₁)。
text.en: Input v_i is the AC gate voltage. Source resistor R₁ produces local feedback, giving AC drain current g_mv_i/(1+g_mR₁).

text.zh: 栅极不吸收电流，但Rg3中有流向偏置网络的输入电流，因此Ri要包含Rg3与并联分压电阻的串联。忽略r_ds时输出只见R_d。
text.en: The gate draws no current, but Rg3 carries input current into the bias network. Therefore R_i includes Rg3 in series with the parallel divider. Neglecting r_ds, the output sees R_d.

title.en: (4) Executed SPICE waveforms and analytical cross-check

text.zh: 使用下方原图网表实际运行ngspice 47（LEVEL=1，λ=0），得到V_GQ=5 V、V_SQ≈2.83645 V、V_DQ≈17.6363 V、I_DQ≈0.2363705 mA及g_m≈1.019819 mS。输入为1 kHz、10 mV峰值正弦波；对7–10 ms输出拟合基波，峰值约33.54885 mV，相位约−179.715°，近似反相。保留所有电容的1 kHz小信号AC结果为−3.35500−j0.0166784，独立节点方程得到相同结果。前3问按题给g_m=1 mS计算，第4问由指定模型自行产生Q点和g_m，不能强行令二者相同。图中为实际瞬态数据，拟合残差RMS约0.01414 mV，包含微小非线性与启动余量。
text.en: The attached circuit was run in ngspice 47 (LEVEL=1, λ=0), producing V_GQ=5 V, V_SQ≈2.83645 V, V_DQ≈17.6363 V, I_DQ≈0.2363705 mA and g_m≈1.019819 mS. The input is a 1 kHz sine with 10 mV peak amplitude. A fundamental fit over 7–10 ms gives output peak amplitude about 33.54885 mV and phase about −179.715°, approximately inverted. AC analysis retaining every capacitor gives −3.35500−j0.0166784 at 1 kHz, reproduced by independent nodal equations. Parts (1)–(3) use the stated 1 mS; part (4) derives its own bias and g_m from the specified model. The plot contains actual transient data. The fit residual RMS is about 0.01414 mV, including slight nonlinearity and startup residue.

answer.zh: （1）见小信号等效图；（2）A_v=−10/3≈−3.3333；（3）R_i=2.075 MΩ，R_o=10 kΩ；（4）已执行ngspice 47：1 kHz、10 mV峰值输入，输出基波峰值约33.54885 mV，相位约−179.715°，近似反相；见实际波形与网表。
answer.en: (1) See the equivalent. (2) A_v=−10/3≈−3.3333. (3) R_i=2.075 MΩ, R_o=10 kΩ. (4) Executed in ngspice 47: a 1 kHz, 10 mV peak input yields about 33.54885 mV output fundamental peak with phase about −179.715°, approximately inverted. See the actual waveforms and netlist.

pitfalls.zh: Rg3不接R₁/R₂节点；Ri不是2 MΩ，也不是75 kΩ。
pitfalls.en: Rg3 is not connected to the R₁/R₂ junction; R_i is neither 2 MΩ alone nor 75 kΩ.

pitfalls.zh: SPICE KP是μC_ox；本书K_n还含W/(2L)。
pitfalls.en: SPICE KP is μC_ox; textbook K_n additionally contains W/(2L).

methods.zh: 第1–3问独立列源、漏节点KCL，1 V输入给v_s=2/3 V、i_d=1/3 mA、v_o=−10/3 V，输入电流1/2.075 MΩ A；输出1 V测试给0.1 mA。第4问实际ngspice 47直流、AC及瞬态运行均成功；以独立6节点复数导纳矩阵保留C1、C2、旁路C与Rg3/分压网络，得到1 kHz增益−3.35499766−j0.01667836，KCL残差小于7×10⁻18 A。瞬态输出7–10 ms用正弦、余弦及常数最小二乘拟合，基波幅值与AC×10 mV相差约0.0046%。
methods.en: Parts (1)–(3): independent source/drain KCL gives v_s=2/3 V, i_d=1/3 mA and v_o=−10/3 V for a 1 V input; input current is 1/2.075 MΩ A. A 1 V output test gives 0.1 mA. Part (4): actual ngspice 47 operating-point, AC and transient runs succeeded. An independent six-node complex admittance matrix retains C1, C2, bypass C and the Rg3/divider network, reproducing gain −3.35499766−j0.01667836 at 1 kHz with KCL residual below 7×10⁻18 A. A least-squares sine/cosine/constant fit over 7–10 ms differs from AC gain times 10 mV by about 0.0046%.

assumptions.zh: 第1–3问为中频小信号、g_m=1 mS，r_ds→∞；第4问采用题设SPICE参数、LEVEL=1、λ=0，无额外寄生参数。输出1 TΩ仅提供数值直流通路，相对10 kΩ对交流影响可忽略。
assumptions.en: Parts (1)–(3): midband, g_m=1 mS, r_ds→∞. Part (4): specified SPICE parameters, LEVEL=1, λ=0, no added parasitic parameters. A 1 TΩ output resistor supplies a numerical DC path with negligible AC loading relative to 10 kΩ.

alt.zh: NMOS漏极接10 kΩ到20 V；源极经R₁=2 kΩ、R₂=10 kΩ串联接地，47 μF只旁路R₂。栅极通过2 MΩ接300 kΩ/100 kΩ偏置分压点。输入电容0.02 μF，输出电容4.7 μF。
alt.en: NMOS drain through 10 kΩ to 20 V; source through series R₁=2 kΩ and R₂=10 kΩ to ground, with 47 μF bypassing only R₂. Gate through 2 MΩ to a 300 kΩ/100 kΩ bias divider. Input capacitor 0.02 μF; output capacitor 4.7 μF.

alt.zh: 中频等效图：栅经2 MΩ串75 kΩ接地；源极2 kΩ接地；漏极10 kΩ接地，漏到源受控电流源g_mv_gs，输出在漏极。
alt.en: Midband equivalent: gate through 2 MΩ plus 75 kΩ to ground, source through 2 kΩ to ground, drain through 10 kΩ to ground, drain-to-source controlled current g_mv_gs, and output at drain.

alt.zh: ngspice 47实际瞬态波形，7–10 ms窗口；输入10 mV峰值、输出约33.55 mV峰值，1 kHz，近似反相。
alt.en: Actual ngspice 47 transient waveforms over 7–10 ms: input 10 mV peak, output about 33.55 mV peak, 1 kHz, approximately inverted.

simulation.model: NMOS LEVEL=1 KP=110u VTO=1.7 LAMBDA=0 W=40u L=2u

note.zh: 附图来自实际瞬态数据；在指定理想LEVEL=1模型下核验。
note.en: The plot uses actual transient data, verified for the specified ideal LEVEL=1 model.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

title.zh: 源极跟随器：先剔除平方方程的无效根
title.en: Source follower: reject the invalid square-law root first

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图4.5.1a所示，设电路参数为V_DD=12 V，R_g1=150 kΩ，R_g2=450 kΩ，R_s=1 kΩ，R_si=10 kΩ。MOS管参数为V_TN=1.5 V，K_n=2 mA/V²，λ=0。试求（1）静态工作点Q；（2）电压增益A_v和源电压增益A_vs；（3）输入电阻R_i和输出电阻R_o。
statement.en: For Fig. 4.5.1(a), V_DD=12 V, R_g1=150 kΩ, R_g2=450 kΩ, R_s=1 kΩ and R_si=10 kΩ. MOS parameters: V_TN=1.5 V, K_n=2 mA/V², λ=0. Find (1) the bias point Q; (2) voltage gain A_v and source voltage gain A_vs; (3) input resistance R_i and output resistance R_o.

prerequisites.zh: 栅极分压；源极跟随器平方律偏置；过驱动正值；小信号KCL。
prerequisites.en: Gate divider; square-law source-follower bias; positive overdrive; small-signal KCL.

recognition.zh: 先把I_D写成源极电压反馈后的平方方程。平方会产生不满足V_GS>V_TN的根，必须筛选。再由有效工作点求g_m。
recognition.en: Write the square-law equation including source-voltage feedback. Squaring can produce a root with V_GS below threshold; reject it before finding g_m.

text.zh: 栅极电位9 V，源极电位为I_D R_s。若I_D用mA表示，则V_GS=9−I_D。
text.en: Gate voltage is 9 V and source voltage is I_D R_s. With I_D in mA, V_GS=9−I_D.

title.zh: 选择物理根并核对恒流区
title.en: Choose the physical root and check saturation

text.zh: 两根约5.79744、9.70256 mA。第二根使V_GS−V_TN<0，不能使用导通平方律，舍去。有效根给V_GS≈3.20256 V、V_DS≈6.20256 V；V_DS大于过驱动1.70256 V，恒流区成立。
text.en: The roots are about 5.79744 and 9.70256 mA. The second has negative overdrive, so the on-state square law does not apply and that root is rejected. The valid root gives V_GS≈3.20256 V and V_DS≈6.20256 V, exceeding the 1.70256 V overdrive.

text.zh: 互导约6.81025 mS。源极跟随器同相且电压增益小于1。源电压增益另考虑10 kΩ信号源内阻。课程不要求源电压增益，但为完整覆盖教材小问仍给出。
text.en: Transconductance is about 6.81025 mS. The source follower is non-inverting with gain below one. Source gain also includes the 10 kΩ source resistance. Although the course excludes A_vs for this exercise, it is included to complete the textbook part.

text.zh: 输入是偏置电阻并联。求输出电阻时信号源置零、输入端栅极交流接地，在源极加测试电压，测试电流为v_t/R_s+g_m v_t。
text.en: Input resistance is the parallel bias resistors. For output resistance, zero the source and AC-ground the gate. A source-node test voltage draws v_t/R_s+g_m v_t.

pitfalls.zh: 不能只看到平方方程两根都为正就全保留；还要检查过驱动为正。
pitfalls.en: Two positive roots are not both valid; require positive overdrive.

pitfalls.zh: 求R_o时不能保留外部信号，也不能把源极R_s遗漏。
pitfalls.en: Zero the signal when finding R_o and retain the source resistor R_s.

methods.zh: 将有效I_D代回直流平方律、栅源电压和漏源KVL，残差在浮点精度内。独立用源节点测试KCL g_m(1−v_s)=v_s/R_s重求A_v，输出测试KCL重求R_o；0<A_vs<A_v<1，满足跟随器物理趋势。
methods.en: Substitution into the DC square law and gate/source/drain KVL gives floating-point residuals. Independent source-node KCL g_m(1−v_s)=v_s/R_s reproduces A_v, and an output test reproduces R_o. The ordering 0<A_vs<A_v<1 matches a follower.

assumptions.zh: 中频小信号、λ=0、无额外输出负载、衬底接源。
assumptions.en: Midband small signal, λ=0, no additional output load, body tied to source.

alt.zh: NMOS共漏极源极跟随器：漏极接12 V，源极经1 kΩ接地并取输出；栅极150 kΩ上拉、450 kΩ下拉，10 kΩ内阻信号源通过耦合电容接栅。
alt.en: NMOS source follower: drain at 12 V, source through 1 kΩ to ground with output at source, gate divider 150 kΩ upper/450 kΩ lower, and input through a coupling capacitor from a source with 10 kΩ resistance.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

title.zh: 共栅极：静态检查后求同相增益
title.en: Common gate: check the bias point, then find non-inverting gain

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 共栅极放大电路如图题4.5.5所示。电路参数为V_DD=V_SS=5 V，R_s=10 kΩ，R_d=5 kΩ，R_L=5 kΩ。MOS管参数K_n=3 mA/V²，V_TN=1 V，λ=0。（1）计算静态工作点Q；（2）求g_m；（3）求A_v=v_o/v_i。
statement.en: For the common-gate amplifier in Fig. 4.5.5, V_DD=V_SS=5 V, R_s=10 kΩ, R_d=5 kΩ and R_L=5 kΩ. MOS parameters: K_n=3 mA/V², V_TN=1 V, λ=0. (1) Find Q. (2) Find g_m. (3) Find A_v=v_o/v_i.

prerequisites.zh: 双电源偏置；平方律选根；共栅极小信号模型。
prerequisites.en: Dual-supply bias; square-law root selection; common-gate small-signal model.

recognition.zh: 静态时耦合电容断开，R_L不参与偏置；动态时负载经电容并到R_d上。输入v_i已经是实际源极交流电压，不再为R_s乘额外分压。
recognition.en: At DC, coupling capacitors are open and R_L does not load the bias. At AC, R_L is in parallel with R_d. Input v_i is already the actual source-node voltage, so no extra R_s division is needed.

text.zh: 栅极为0 V，源极V_S=−5+10I_D（I_D以mA计），故过驱动为4−10I_D。
text.en: The gate is at 0 V and V_S=−5+10I_D with I_D in mA, so overdrive is 4−10I_D.

title.zh: 选择有效根并检查区域
title.en: Choose the valid root and check the region

text.zh: 有效根I_D≈0.365114 mA；另一根约0.438220 mA使过驱动为负，舍去。源极约−1.34886 V，漏极约3.17443 V，因此V_GS≈1.34886 V、V_DS≈4.52329 V，远大于过驱动。
text.en: The valid root is I_D≈0.365114 mA; the other, about 0.438220 mA, gives negative overdrive and is rejected. The source is about −1.34886 V and drain about 3.17443 V, giving V_GS≈1.34886 V and V_DS≈4.52329 V, well above overdrive.

text.zh: 本书K_n已经含几何因子及1/2，故g_m=2K_n V_OV。
text.en: The textbook K_n already contains geometry and 1/2, so g_m=2K_n V_OV.

text.zh: 栅极交流接地，v_gs=−v_i。漏电流增量为−g_mv_i，输出v_o=−i_d(R_d∥R_L)，两次负号给同相增益。
text.en: The gate is AC-grounded, so v_gs=−v_i and i_d=−g_mv_i. Output v_o=−i_d(R_d∥R_L), giving a positive gain.

pitfalls.zh: R_L被耦合电容隔离，不计入直流漏极电阻。
pitfalls.en: The coupling capacitor isolates R_L at DC; omit it from the DC drain load.

pitfalls.zh: V_SS=5 V表示负电源端为−5 V，不是源极电压固定−5 V。
pitfalls.en: V_SS=5 V means the negative rail is −5 V; it does not fix the source node at −5 V.

methods.zh: 独立以过驱动x代替I_D，解30x²+x−4=0得到同一物理根。再代回R_s、R_d的直流欧姆定律及MOS平方律。交流用漏节点KCL v_o/R_d+v_o/R_L−g_m v_i=0独立得到增益。
methods.en: Independently solving in overdrive x gives 30x²+x−4=0 and the same physical root. Substitution verifies both resistor DC laws and the MOS square law. Independent drain-node KCL v_o/R_d+v_o/R_L−g_m v_i=0 reproduces the AC gain.

assumptions.zh: 长沟道MOS平方律；λ=0；中频耦合电容短路；衬底接源。
assumptions.en: Long-channel square-law MOS, λ=0, midband coupling capacitors shorted, body tied to source.

alt.zh: NMOS共栅电路：栅接地，源极经10 kΩ接−5 V并经耦合电容接输入；漏极经5 kΩ接+5 V并经耦合电容接5 kΩ负载到地。衬底接源。
alt.en: NMOS common gate: grounded gate; source through 10 kΩ to −5 V and through a coupling capacitor to input; drain through 5 kΩ to +5 V and through a coupling capacitor to a 5 kΩ grounded load. Body tied to source.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

title.zh: 由三端电位识别PNP与电极
title.en: Identify a PNP and its terminals from three voltages

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 测得某放大电路中处于放大状态的BJT的三个电极A、B、C的对地电位分别为V_A=−9 V，V_B=−6 V，V_C=−6.2 V，试分析A、B、C中哪个是基极b、发射极e、集电极c，并说明此BJT是NPN型管还是PNP型管。
statement.en: An amplifying circuit has a BJT operating in its forward-active region. Its terminal voltages relative to ground are V_A=−9 V, V_B=−6 V and V_C=−6.2 V. Identify the base b, emitter e and collector c among A, B and C, and determine whether the transistor is NPN or PNP.

prerequisites.zh: BJT放大区：发射结正偏、集电结反偏；带负号电位排序。
prerequisites.en: Forward-active BJT: forward-biased emitter junction, reverse-biased collector junction; ordering negative voltages.

recognition.zh: 先找只差约0.2 V的一对作为发射结，再用另一结必须反偏来排除错误极性。不能强加硅管0.7 V条件。
recognition.en: First identify the pair separated by about 0.2 V as the emitter junction, then use reverse collector-junction bias to reject the wrong polarity. Do not impose a 0.7 V silicon drop.

text.zh: B端−6 V比C端−6.2 V高0.2 V。若为PNP，较高电位的P区B端可作发射极，C端为N区基极，满足发射结正偏。这里字母B是题目端点标签，不是基极的缩写。
text.en: Terminal B at −6 V is 0.2 V above terminal C at −6.2 V. For PNP, the higher P-type terminal B can be emitter and C the N-type base, forward-biasing the emitter junction. The capital letter B is only a terminal label, not the base designation.

title.en: Check collector bias and reject NPN

text.zh: 剩下A端−9 V是PNP的P区集电极，它比N区基极低2.8 V，集电结反偏。若把B作NPN基极、C作发射极，则A集电极低于基极，集电结正偏，不符合题设放大区。
text.en: The remaining A terminal at −9 V is the PNP collector, 2.8 V below the N-type base, so the collector junction is reverse-biased. Assigning B as an NPN base and C as emitter would forward-bias the collector junction because A is below the base, contradicting forward-active operation.

answer.zh: A为集电极c，B为发射极e，C为基极b；PNP型BJT。
answer.en: A is collector c, B is emitter e, C is base b; PNP BJT.

pitfalls.zh: −6 V高于−6.2 V和−9 V；不能按绝对值排序。
pitfalls.en: −6 V is above −6.2 V and −9 V; do not order by magnitude.

pitfalls.zh: 题目的端点B不是基极b；大小写标签不可混用。
pitfalls.en: Problem terminal B is not automatically base b; keep the labels distinct.

methods.zh: 独立检查PNP两结偏置：V_E−V_b=+0.2 V，发射结正偏；V_c−V_b=−2.8 V，集电结反偏。检查NPN替代分配会使集电结正偏，故排除。未据0.2 V电压差断言具体材料。
methods.en: Independently checked both PNP junctions: V_E−V_b=+0.2 V gives forward emitter bias, and V_c−V_b=−2.8 V gives reverse collector bias. The alternative NPN assignment forward-biases the collector junction and is rejected. No material is inferred solely from the 0.2 V drop.

assumptions.zh: 题设BJT处于正常放大区；不预设硅管固定0.7 V压降。
assumptions.en: The stated normal forward-active BJT condition; no assumed fixed 0.7 V silicon drop.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

title.zh: 用同一组电流定义计算β与α
title.en: Compute beta and alpha from consistent terminal currents

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设某BJT处于放大状态。（1）若基极电流i_B=6 μA，集电极电流i_C=510 μA，试求β、α及i_E；（2）如果i_B=50 μA，i_C=2.65 mA，试求β、α及i_E。
statement.en: A BJT operates in its forward-active region. (1) If i_B=6 μA and i_C=510 μA, find β, α and i_E. (2) If i_B=50 μA and i_C=2.65 mA, find β, α and i_E.

prerequisites.zh: BJT电流KCL；β=i_C/i_B；α=i_C/i_E；单位换算。
prerequisites.en: BJT current KCL; β=i_C/i_B; α=i_C/i_E; unit conversion.

recognition.zh: 先把电流统一单位，再用i_E=i_C+i_B；β与α分母不同。不要把第（2）问已知的i_C误读成i_E。
recognition.en: First use consistent units and i_E=i_C+i_B. Beta and alpha have different denominators. Do not misread the given i_C in part (2) as i_E.

text.zh: 本章按正向放大状态的电流大小计算；发射极电流为基极与集电极之和。
text.en: Use positive current magnitudes in forward-active operation. Emitter current is the sum of base and collector currents.

text.zh: 两电流均以μA计，直接相加与相除。
text.en: Both currents are in μA; add and divide directly.

text.zh: i_C=2.65 mA=2650 μA；加上50 μA得到发射极2.70 mA。
text.en: i_C=2.65 mA=2650 μA. Add 50 μA to obtain emitter current 2.70 mA.

pitfalls.zh: 第（2）问原书给的是集电极i_C=2.65 mA，不是发射极。
pitfalls.en: Part (2) gives collector current i_C=2.65 mA, not emitter current.

pitfalls.zh: α小于1，而β通常远大于1；两者不要互换。
pitfalls.en: Alpha is below one, while beta is typically much larger than one; do not interchange them.

methods.zh: 独立用α=β/(1+β)复算两组结果；再以i_E(1−α)恢复i_B为6 μA和50 μA，i_Eα恢复i_C为510 μA和2.65 mA。
methods.en: Independently recomputed both alpha values using α=β/(1+β). Then i_E(1−α) recovers base currents 6 μA and 50 μA, while i_Eα recovers collector currents 510 μA and 2.65 mA.

assumptions.zh: 正常放大区电流大小，忽略题中未给出的漏电流修正。
assumptions.en: Forward-active current magnitudes, with no unspecified leakage correction.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 开关偏置：先比较βI_B与负载限流
title.en: Switched bias: compare beta times base current with load-limited current

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题5.2.2所示，设BJT的β=80，V_BE=0.6 V，I_CEO、V_CES可忽略不计，试分析当开关S分别接通A、B、C三位置时，BJT各工作在其输出特性曲线的哪个区域，并求出相应的集电极电流I_C。
statement.en: For Fig. 5.2.2, β=80, V_BE=0.6 V, and I_CEO and V_CES are negligible. For switch positions A, B and C, identify the BJT operating region and find collector current I_C.

alt.zh: NPN发射极接地，集电极通过4 kΩ接+12 V；基极开关A经40 kΩ接+12 V，B经500 kΩ接+12 V，C经20 kΩ接−12 V。
alt.en: NPN emitter grounded, collector through 4 kΩ to +12 V. Switch A biases the base through 40 kΩ to +12 V, B through 500 kΩ to +12 V, and C through 20 kΩ to −12 V.

prerequisites.zh: BJT分段模型；基极回路KVL；集电极负载上限。
prerequisites.en: Piecewise BJT model; base-loop KVL; collector load-current limit.

recognition.zh: 不能在所有状态都写I_C=βI_B。先算负载允许的最大集电极电流，再试放大区，超过上限就改为饱和。
recognition.en: I_C=βI_B does not hold in every state. First compute the collector current allowed by the load, then test forward-active operation; exceeding the load limit implies saturation.

text.zh: 忽略饱和压降时，集电极降到0 V，4 kΩ电阻最大电流为3 mA。
text.en: With negligible saturation voltage, the collector reaches 0 V and the 4 kΩ resistor limits current to 3 mA.

text.zh: 40 kΩ使基极电流0.285 mA，假设放大区会要求22.8 mA，远超3 mA，故饱和。实际I_C由负载决定。
text.en: The 40 kΩ resistor supplies 0.285 mA base current. An active-state calculation would demand 22.8 mA, exceeding 3 mA, so the transistor saturates and the load sets I_C.

text.zh: 500 kΩ给出22.8 μA基流，集电流1.824 mA。集电极4.704 V高于基极0.6 V，集电结反偏，放大区成立。
text.en: 500 kΩ gives 22.8 μA base current and 1.824 mA collector current. The collector is at 4.704 V, above the 0.6 V base, so the collector junction is reverse-biased.

title.zh: C：反向偏置，简化模型截止
title.en: C: reverse base bias, cutoff in the simplified model

text.zh: C接−12 V，基极低于接地发射极，不满足发射结正偏；按题设忽略漏电流的截止模型，I_C=0。这个答案采用本题分段模型，不扩展到未给出的反向击穿参数。
text.en: C connects to −12 V, placing the base below the grounded emitter, so the emitter junction is not forward-biased. Under the stated no-leakage cutoff model, I_C=0; no unspecified reverse-breakdown model is assumed.

answer.zh: A：饱和区，I_C=3 mA；B：放大区，I_C=1.824 mA；C：截止区，I_C=0（题设简化模型）。
answer.en: A: saturation, I_C=3 mA. B: forward-active, I_C=1.824 mA. C: cutoff, I_C=0 under the stated simplified model.

pitfalls.zh: 饱和区的实际I_C不能继续用βI_B计算。
pitfalls.en: Do not use βI_B for actual collector current in saturation.

methods.zh: 独立检查A的负载KVL为3 mA×4 kΩ=12 V；B的基极KVL为22.8 μA×500 kΩ+0.6=12 V，集电结反偏；C的简化截止解满足I_CEO=0。
methods.en: Independently checked A load KVL, 3 mA×4 kΩ=12 V; B base KVL, 22.8 μA×500 kΩ+0.6=12 V, with reverse collector bias; C follows the zero-I_CEO cutoff model.

assumptions.zh: 按题设恒定V_BE和忽略漏电流/饱和压降的分段BJT模型；开关C按无反向击穿的简化截止模型。
assumptions.en: Piecewise BJT model with stated constant V_BE and negligible leakage/saturation voltage; switch C uses the simplified cutoff model without reverse breakdown.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 强射极退化的共射：输入电阻含(β+1)R_e
title.en: Degenerated common emitter: input resistance includes (beta+1)Re

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）
source.smallSignalParameterSource: 模拟课件第5章，第41张幻灯片：低频小功率管r_bb′≈200 Ω

statement.zh: 在图题5.2.4电路中，设V_CC=V_EE=12 V，R_c=4 kΩ，R_e=6.2 kΩ，BJT的β=100，V_BEQ=0.7 V。（1）估算Q点；（2）求A_v、R_i和R_o。
statement.en: For Fig. 5.2.4, V_CC=V_EE=12 V, R_c=4 kΩ, R_e=6.2 kΩ, β=100 and V_BEQ=0.7 V. (1) Estimate Q. (2) Find A_v, R_i and R_o.

alt.zh: NPN基极由理想信号源接地参考，集电极经4 kΩ接+12 V，发射极经6.2 kΩ接−12 V，输出在集电极。
alt.en: NPN base driven by an ideal ground-referenced source; collector through 4 kΩ to +12 V; emitter through 6.2 kΩ to −12 V; collector output.

prerequisites.zh: 双电源直流偏置；BJT电流KCL；r_be模型；未旁路发射极反馈。
prerequisites.en: Dual-supply bias; BJT current KCL; r_be model; unbypassed emitter degeneration.

recognition.zh: 基极静态为0 V，先求发射极电流。交流时R_e未旁路，不能把输入电阻写成r_be，也不能把增益写成−βR_c/r_be。
recognition.en: The DC base voltage is zero, so find emitter current first. R_e is unbypassed at AC; neither R_i=r_be nor A_v=−βR_c/r_be applies.

text.zh: V_BQ=0，V_EQ=−0.7 V，R_e上电压11.3 V。保留β有限时I_C=βI_E/(β+1)。
text.en: V_BQ=0 and V_EQ=−0.7 V, so the emitter resistor sees 11.3 V. Retain finite beta using I_C=βI_E/(β+1).

text.zh: 集电极V_C≈4.78186 V，基极0 V，集电结反偏；发射结0.7 V正偏，工作点成立。若按I_C≈I_E估算，则得到I_C≈1.823 mA、V_CE≈5.410 V。
text.en: Collector voltage is about 4.78186 V, above the 0 V base; the collector junction is reverse-biased and the emitter junction has 0.7 V forward bias. Using I_C≈I_E instead gives approximately 1.823 mA and V_CE≈5.410 V.

text.zh: 采用授课课件第5章第41页常用估算r_bb′≈200 Ω、室温V_T=26 mV。题目未给实际r_bb′，所报小信号数值依赖此课程模型。
text.en: Use the course slide 41 convention r_bb′≈200 Ω and room-temperature V_T=26 mV. Actual r_bb′ is not given, so the reported small-signal values depend on this course model.

text.zh: 基极输入电压需同时承担r_be压降与发射极电阻上的(β+1)i_b R_e，故分母包含反馈电阻的放大反映。输出为−βi_bR_c。
text.en: The base input supplies both i_b r_be and emitter drop (β+1)i_b R_e. The output is −βi_bR_c.

text.zh: 忽略晶体管输出电阻，输入源置零后输出测试电压不会改变基极电流，输出见R_c。
text.en: Taking r_o→∞ (neglecting the Early effect), a collector test voltage with the input zeroed does not change base current; the output sees R_c.

answer.en: With finite beta: I_CQ≈1.80454 mA and V_CEQ≈5.48186 V. With course r_bb′≈200 Ω and V_T=26 mV: A_v≈−0.637104, R_i≈627.841 kΩ, R_o=4 kΩ.

pitfalls.zh: R_e没有旁路，计算交流通路时不能删掉。
pitfalls.en: R_e is not bypassed and must remain in the AC circuit.

methods.zh: 独立以1 V基极输入列KCL：i_b=1/[r_be+(β+1)R_e]，i_e=(β+1)i_b，v_o=−βi_bR_c，与结果一致；直流分别验证两结偏置和双电源KVL。
methods.en: Independent KCL with a 1 V base test gives i_b=1/[r_be+(β+1)R_e], i_e=(β+1)i_b and v_o=−βi_bR_c. Both DC junction biases and dual-rail KVL also check.

assumptions.zh: 恒V_BE=0.7 V，保留有限β；中频、r_bb′=200 Ω、V_T=26 mV、忽略晶体管输出电阻。
assumptions.en: Constant V_BE=0.7 V with finite beta; midband, r_bb′=200 Ω, V_T=26 mV, the Early effect neglected (r_o→∞).

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: PNP共射极：用带符号电压判断失真
title.en: PNP common emitter: use signed voltage to classify clipping

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh:
电路如图题5.2.7a所示，已知BJT的β=100，V_BEQ=−0.7 V。（1）试估算该电路的Q点；（2）画出小信号等效电路；（3）求该电路的电压增益A_v、输入电阻R_i、输出电阻R_o；（4）若v_o出现图题5.2.7b所示的失真现象，问是截止失真还是饱和失真？为消除此失真，应调整电路中的哪个元件？如何调整？
图中：电源−12 V，R_b=300 kΩ，R_c=2 kΩ，R_L=4 kΩ；信号源内阻R_si未给数值。图b为输出负半周被削平。
statement.en:
For Fig. 5.2.7(a), β=100 and V_BEQ=−0.7 V. (1) Estimate Q. (2) Draw the small-signal equivalent. (3) Find voltage gain A_v, input resistance R_i and output resistance R_o. (4) If v_o has the distortion in Fig. 5.2.7(b), determine whether it is cutoff or saturation distortion, and identify the component and adjustment needed to eliminate it.
Figure values: −12 V rail, R_b=300 kΩ, R_c=2 kΩ and R_L=4 kΩ; source resistance R_si is unspecified. Figure (b) clips the negative output half-cycle.

alt.zh: PNP发射极接地，基极通过300 kΩ接−12 V，集电极通过2 kΩ接−12 V；耦合电容输入与输出，输出负载4 kΩ接地。右图输出负半周削平。
alt.en: Grounded-emitter PNP, base through 300 kΩ to −12 V, collector through 2 kΩ to −12 V, input/output coupling capacitors, and 4 kΩ grounded output load. The right waveform clips on its negative half-cycle.

prerequisites.zh: PNP带符号偏置；共射极小信号模型；截止/饱和边界。
prerequisites.en: Signed PNP bias; common-emitter small-signal model; cutoff and saturation boundaries.

recognition.zh: PNP电流大小先取正值算，再恢复V_CE的负号。交流增益仍反相；用含R_L的交流负载线判断削平方向，不能把有载中频波形的截止边界直接设为负电源电压。
recognition.en: Compute positive PNP current magnitudes first, then restore the negative V_CE. The AC gain still inverts. Use the AC load line including R_L to classify clipping; do not set the cutoff boundary of the loaded midband waveform directly to the negative supply rail.

text.zh: 发射极0 V，基极−0.7 V，基极电阻上电压11.3 V。
text.en: The emitter is at 0 V and base at −0.7 V, leaving 11.3 V across R_b.

text.zh: 基极−0.7 V，集电极−4.46667 V，PNP集电极低于基极，集电结反偏，放大区成立。
text.en: The PNP collector at −4.46667 V is below the −0.7 V base; its collector junction is reverse-biased, consistent with forward-active operation.

text.zh: 中频电容短路，−12 V为交流地。发射极交流接地，基极r_be与R_b并联接地；集电极R_c与R_L并联接地。晶体管用r_be和从集电极到发射极的受控增量电流βi_b表示，i_b定义为流入基极的带符号增量。信号源保留串联R_si。
text.en: At midband the capacitors are shorts and −12 V is AC ground. The emitter is grounded; r_be and R_b are parallel to ground at the base; R_c and R_L are parallel to ground at the collector. Model the transistor by r_be and controlled incremental current βi_b from collector to emitter, with i_b defined as the signed current increment entering the base. Retain source resistance R_si.

text.zh: A_v以实际输入v_i定义，不需要未给值的R_si；输入电阻需并联300 kΩ偏置电阻，不能只报r_be。
text.en: A_v is defined from actual input v_i, so the unspecified R_si is not needed. Input resistance includes the 300 kΩ bias resistor in parallel, rather than r_be alone.

title.zh: （4）带负载交流负载线：负向削平为截止
title.en: (4) Loaded AC load line: negative clipping is cutoff

text.zh: 在中频近似下，输出耦合电容的直流电压约保持Q点值，故v_o=v_C−V_CQ。令I_CQ=3.76667 mA表示静态集电流大小，j_C为PNP从发射极流向集电极的瞬时电流大小，集电极KCL给j_C=I_CQ+v_o/(R_c∥R_L)。截止时j_C=0，所以v_o约为−5.0222 V，为负向极限；对应瞬时v_C约−9.4889 V，并非−12 V。饱和端则是集电极趋近发射极，对应正输出。图b的负向削平因此是截止失真。减小R_b可提高静态电流、增加截止端的交流摆幅余量；调整后仍须检查饱和端余量。该负载线用于给定Q点附近的中频近似，题目未给信号幅度、频率和电容数值，不能据此精确预测大失真后的整个稳态波形。
text.en: At midband, the output coupling capacitor approximately retains its quiescent DC voltage, so v_o=v_C−V_CQ. Let I_CQ=3.76667 mA denote the quiescent collector-current magnitude, and let j_C be the instantaneous PNP current magnitude flowing from emitter to collector. Collector KCL gives j_C=I_CQ+v_o/(R_c∥R_L). At cutoff j_C=0, giving v_o≈−5.0222 V: the negative swing limit. The corresponding instantaneous collector voltage is about −9.4889 V, not −12 V. At the saturation end the collector approaches the emitter, producing positive output. The negative clipping in Fig. (b) is therefore cutoff distortion. Decreasing R_b raises bias current and increases cutoff-side AC headroom; recheck saturation-side headroom after adjustment. This is a midband load-line approximation about the stated Q point. Signal amplitude, frequency and capacitance values are unspecified, so it is not an exact prediction of the entire steady-state waveform after strong clipping.

answer.zh: （1）|I_CQ|≈3.76667 mA，V_CEQ≈−4.46667 V；（2）见小信号等效图；（3）采用r_bb′=200 Ω、V_T=26 mV：A_v≈−149.768，R_i≈887.631 Ω，R_o=2 kΩ；（4）截止失真，减小R_b提高偏置电流，并复查饱和余量。
answer.en: (1) |I_CQ|≈3.76667 mA, V_CEQ≈−4.46667 V. (2) See the equivalent. (3) With r_bb′=200 Ω and V_T=26 mV: A_v≈−149.768, R_i≈887.631 Ω, R_o=2 kΩ. (4) Cutoff distortion; decrease R_b to raise bias current, then recheck saturation headroom.

pitfalls.zh: PNP的V_CE为负，不能只给其绝对值而不说明。
pitfalls.en: PNP V_CE is negative; do not silently give only its magnitude.

pitfalls.zh: R_i=r_be∥R_b；忽略R_b只是一种数值近似。
pitfalls.en: R_i=r_be∥R_b; omitting R_b is only a numerical approximation.

pitfalls.zh: 输出耦合电容隔直但传递交流，截止摆幅要用R_c∥R_L的交流负载线，不能直接用直流负载线的−12 V端点。
pitfalls.en: The output coupling capacitor blocks DC but passes AC. Use the R_c∥R_L AC load line for cutoff swing; do not directly use the −12 V endpoint of the DC load line.

methods.zh: 独立重算直流电阻KVL与PNP两结偏置；采用带符号的流入基极增量电流，r_be、βi_b方向与反相增益一致。交流以v_i=1 mV列集电极KCL回算A_v。失真方向改用含R_L的交流负载线复核：耦合电容保持Q点直流电压时j_C=(v_C+12)/R_c+v_o/R_L=I_CQ+v_o/(R_c∥R_L)；令j_C=0得到v_o≈−5.02222 V、v_C≈−9.48889 V，原电路KCL残差为0，负向削平是截止。不能用V_C→−12 V代替有载中频波形的核验。
methods.en: Independently recomputed DC resistor KVL and both PNP junction biases. With the signed incremental current entering the base, the r_be and βi_b references are consistent with the inverting gain. A 1 mV AC test input and collector KCL reproduce A_v. Clipping direction was independently checked with the AC load line including R_L: with the coupling capacitor retaining its quiescent DC voltage, j_C=(v_C+12)/R_c+v_o/R_L=I_CQ+v_o/(R_c∥R_L). Setting j_C=0 gives v_o≈−5.02222 V and v_C≈−9.48889 V, satisfying the original collector KCL with zero residual and establishing negative clipping as cutoff. V_C→−12 V is not used as the loaded midband waveform check.

assumptions.zh: 直流取恒V_BE=−0.7 V及有限β。交流取中频、r_bb′=200 Ω、V_T=26 mV；忽略厄利效应，即晶体管r_o→∞。失真方向按含R_L、耦合电容近似保留Q点直流电压的交流负载线判断；不声称精确预测任意频率或强失真后的完整波形。
assumptions.en: DC uses constant V_BE=−0.7 V and finite beta. AC uses midband operation, r_bb′=200 Ω and V_T=26 mV; neglect the Early effect, taking transistor r_o→∞. Clipping direction uses the AC load line including R_L, with the coupling capacitor approximately retaining its quiescent DC voltage. This does not claim an exact complete waveform at arbitrary frequency or after strong distortion.

alt.zh: 共射极增量等效图：输入端r_be并R_b接地；输出端R_c并R_L接地，受控增量电流βi_b从集电极到交流接地发射极。
alt.en: Common-emitter incremental equivalent: r_be parallel R_b at the input, R_c parallel R_L at the output, and controlled incremental current βi_b from collector to AC-grounded emitter.

completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 射极偏置：基极加载不可在精确复核时漏掉
title.en: Emitter bias: retain base loading in the checked solution

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh:
射极偏置电路如图题5.2.8所示，已知β=60。（1）用估算法求Q点；（2）求BJT的输入电阻r_be；（3）用小信号模型分析法求电压增益A_v；（4）电路其他参数不变，如果要使V_CEQ=4 V，问基极上偏流电阻R_b1为多大？
图中：V_CC=16 V，R_b1=60 kΩ，R_b2=20 kΩ，R_c=3 kΩ，R_e=2 kΩ，R_L=6 kΩ；输入、输出耦合电容各30 μF，射极旁路50 μF，BJT标为3DG4。
statement.en:
For the emitter-biased circuit in Fig. 5.2.8, β=60. (1) Estimate Q. (2) Find transistor input resistance r_be. (3) Use the small-signal model to find voltage gain A_v. (4) With all other parameters unchanged, find the upper base-bias resistor R_b1 needed for V_CEQ=4 V.
Figure values: V_CC=16 V, R_b1=60 kΩ, R_b2=20 kΩ, R_c=3 kΩ, R_e=2 kΩ, R_L=6 kΩ; input/output coupling capacitors 30 μF each, emitter bypass 50 μF, transistor 3DG4.

alt.zh: NPN分压射极偏置：60 kΩ/20 kΩ基极分压，3 kΩ集电极电阻，2 kΩ射极电阻由50 μF旁路；输出耦合到6 kΩ负载。
alt.en: Divider-biased NPN: 60 kΩ/20 kΩ base divider, 3 kΩ collector resistor, 2 kΩ emitter resistor bypassed by 50 μF, and output coupled to 6 kΩ.

prerequisites.zh: 分压器戴维南等效；有限β的基极加载；旁路射极共射增益。
prerequisites.en: Divider Thevenin equivalent; finite-beta base loading; bypassed-emitter common-emitter gain.

recognition.zh: 分压器戴维南电阻15 kΩ相对(β+1)R_e=122 kΩ并非完全可忽略。主解保留基极加载，并另给常见忽略加载估算，避免混用两组Q点。
recognition.en: Divider resistance 15 kΩ is not entirely negligible beside (β+1)R_e=122 kΩ. The checked main solution retains base loading and separately identifies the common unloaded-divider estimate, avoiding mixed bias points.

title.en: (1) Retain divider loading in the estimate

text.zh: 取硅BJT恒V_BE≈0.7 V，分压等效V_TH=4 V、R_TH=15 kΩ。由基极回路求I_B，再得I_C、I_E。
text.en: Use silicon constant V_BE≈0.7 V. The divider gives V_TH=4 V and R_TH=15 kΩ. Solve the base loop, then find I_C and I_E.

title.en: Find V_CE and identify the common approximation

text.zh: 保留加载时V_E≈2.93869 V、V_C≈11.66423 V，V_CE≈8.72555 V；两结偏置满足放大区。若课堂直接忽略基流对分压器的加载并取I_C≈I_E，则得I_C≈1.65 mA、V_CE≈7.75 V；这是一组精度较低的另一近似，不能拿它与主解的r_be交叉混用。
text.en: With loading retained, V_E≈2.93869 V, V_C≈11.66423 V and V_CE≈8.72555 V; both junction biases satisfy forward-active operation. Ignoring divider loading and taking I_C≈I_E instead gives about 1.65 mA and 7.75 V. This lower-accuracy approximation must not be mixed with the main solution’s r_be.

text.zh: 按课件常用r_bb′≈200 Ω、V_T=26 mV，始终使用主解的I_E。
text.en: Use course r_bb′≈200 Ω and V_T=26 mV, consistently with the main solution’s I_E.

text.zh: 中频射极旁路有效，发射极交流接地；负载并到集电极电阻，R_c∥R_L=2 kΩ。
text.en: At midband, the emitter bypass grounds the emitter at AC. The collector load is R_c∥R_L=2 kΩ.

title.en: (4) Recover I_B from the target V_CE

text.zh: 保留β有限，V_CE=16−I_B[βR_c+(β+1)R_e]。目标4 V给出I_B≈39.7351 μA和V_B≈5.54768 V。
text.en: With finite beta, V_CE=16−I_B[βR_c+(β+1)R_e]. The 4 V target gives I_B≈39.7351 μA and V_B≈5.54768 V.

title.en: Use base KCL for R_b1, then substitute back

text.zh: 上电阻电流必须同时提供下分压电流和基流。用目标V_B及I_B解R_b1，得到约32.96 kΩ。若忽略基极加载并取I_C≈I_E，常见粗略结果约38.18 kΩ，代回有限β模型不会得到精确4 V。
text.en: The upper resistor must supply both lower-divider current and base current. Using target V_B and I_B gives about 32.96 kΩ. The common unloaded-divider estimate of about 38.18 kΩ does not reproduce exactly 4 V in the finite-beta model.

answer.en: With V_BE=0.7 V and finite-beta loading: (1) I_CQ≈1.44526 mA, V_CEQ≈8.72555 V. (2) r_be≈1.27939 kΩ. (3) A_v≈−93.7944. (4) R_b1≈32.9602 kΩ. The small-signal values additionally use course r_bb′=200 Ω and V_T=26 mV.

pitfalls.zh: 保留加载与忽略加载是不同精度模型，不能把两种结果混合。
pitfalls.en: Loaded and unloaded divider calculations use different approximations; do not mix their results.

pitfalls.zh: 设计R_b1时上电阻电流不等于下电阻电流，相差I_B。
pitfalls.en: When designing R_b1, upper and lower resistor currents differ by I_B.

methods.zh: 独立在基极直接写原网络KCL，核对(16−V_B)/60k=V_B/20k+I_B；直流两结偏置均满足放大区。第4问将新R_b1代回原分压网络重新求I_B和V_CE，回得4 V。交流以测试输入列集电极KCL复核增益。
methods.en: Independently checked original-network base KCL, (16−V_B)/60k=V_B/20k+I_B, and both forward-active junction biases. For part (4), re-solving the original divider with the new R_b1 recovers V_CE=4 V. A test-input collector KCL independently verifies the AC gain.

assumptions.zh: 恒V_BE=0.7 V，有限β及分压加载；中频、r_bb′=200 Ω、V_T=26 mV，射极旁路有效；忽略厄利效应，即晶体管r_o→∞。
assumptions.en: Constant V_BE=0.7 V with finite beta and divider loading; midband operation, r_bb′=200 Ω, V_T=26 mV and an effective emitter bypass. Neglect the Early effect, taking transistor r_o→∞.

completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 追踪反馈通路：电容决定直流还是交流
title.en: Trace feedback paths: capacitors determine DC versus AC feedback

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 在图题8.1.1所示的各电路中，哪些元件组成了级间反馈通路？它们所引入的反馈是正反馈还是负反馈？是直流反馈还是交流反馈（设各电路中电容的容抗对交流信号均可忽略）？
statement.en: For every circuit in Fig. 8.1.1, identify the components forming interstage feedback paths, determine positive or negative feedback, and identify DC and/or AC feedback. Capacitor reactances are negligible for the AC signal.

alt.zh: 图8.1.1的六图：(a)运放和射极跟随器，输出经R₂/R₁反馈到反相端；(b)A₂作电压跟随器，经R₃反馈到A₁反相求和点；(c)两运放串联，负载电流经过R₆，其电压返回A₁同相端；(d)运放驱动NMOS，源极经R₁接地，并经R₂回反相求和点，漏极R_d输出；(e)三级共源极，R_f从末级漏极回首级栅极；(f)三级PNP共射，T₁与T₃共用R_e1，R_f1/R_f2之间有接地电容C₂，输出经C₃耦合。
alt.en: Six circuits: (a) op amp plus emitter follower with R₂/R₁ feedback to the inverting input; (b) A₂ voltage follower returns through R₃ to A₁ summing node; (c) two op amps, with load-current sense resistor R₆ returning to A₁ non-inverting input; (d) op amp driving NMOS, source resistor R₁ and R₂ return to the summing node, drain-resistor output; (e) three common-source stages with R_f from final drain to first gate; (f) three PNP common-emitter stages, shared T₁/T₃ emitter resistor R_e1, and grounded C₂ at the R_f1/R_f2 junction, with C₃ output coupling.

prerequisites.zh: 反馈通路；瞬时极性法；电容直流开路/交流短路。
prerequisites.en: Feedback paths; instantaneous-polarity method; capacitors open at DC and short at AC.

recognition.zh: 先把输出量扰动，沿返回路径追踪净输入变化；不能只数反相级。含电容的图先分别画直流与中频通路。
recognition.en: Perturb the output and trace how the return path changes the net input; counting inversions alone is insufficient. Analyze separate DC and midband circuits where capacitors appear.

text.zh: 输出电压增大使反相输入经R₂/R₁分压增大，运放输出及跟随器输出被压低，负反馈。反馈通路无隔直电容，直流、交流都存在。
text.en: A higher output increases the inverting-input divider voltage, reducing the amplifier/follower output. This is negative feedback at both DC and AC; the return path has no blocking capacitor.

text.zh: A₂自身为电压跟随器，输出电压经A₂缓冲、R₃返回A₁反相求和点；输出增大会使A₁输出下降，为负反馈，兼有直流与交流。
text.en: A₂ is a voltage follower. The output returns through A₂ and R₃ to the inverting summing node of A₁. A positive output change drives A₁ output down: negative feedback at DC and AC.

text.zh: 负载电流增大使R₆电压增大，A₁同相端增大使A₁输出增大；A₂为反相级，末级输出及负载电流反而减小，为负反馈。R₂、R₅分别是运放局部反馈，R₆构成跨级电流反馈；直流交流都有。
text.en: Increased load current raises the R₆ voltage and A₁ non-inverting input, increasing A₁ output. A₂ inverts, reducing final output/current: negative feedback. R₂ and R₅ are local op-amp loops; R₆ supplies the interstage current feedback. It acts at DC and AC.

text.zh: 漏/源电流增大使源极取样电压增大，经R₂提高运放反相端，运放输出下降，抑制MOS电流，为负反馈。反馈通路对直流与交流都存在。
text.en: Increased MOS drain/source current raises the source-sense voltage. R₂ raises the inverting input, lowering op-amp output and opposing the MOS-current increase. Negative feedback acts at DC and AC.

text.zh: 末级输出升高经R_f使首级栅极升高，三级共源极放大总反相，末级输出被拉低，为负反馈。电路直接耦合，直流交流都有。
text.en: A positive final output change raises the first gate through R_f. Three common-source stages invert overall, driving the final output down. Direct coupling permits DC and AC negative feedback.

text.zh: R_e1由T₁、T₃共用，末级电流改变首级射极电位，形成直流和交流的电流串联负反馈。R_f2、R_f1从末级集电极回首级基极，形成直流电压并联负反馈；中频C₂把二者中点交流接地，切断这条跨级交流返回通路，R_f1、R_f2只分别作为输入/输出交流负载。C₁、C₃为输入输出耦合电容。
text.en: Shared emitter resistor R_e1 links T₁ and T₃, giving DC and AC negative current-series feedback. R_f2 and R_f1 return the final collector voltage to the first base, providing DC negative voltage-shunt feedback. At midband C₂ AC-grounds their junction, interrupting that interstage AC return; R_f1 and R_f2 separately load the input and output. C₁ and C₃ are coupling capacitors.

answer.zh: (a)R₁/R₂、(b)A₂/R₃、(c)R₆、(d)R₁/R₂、(e)R_f均引入负反馈，兼有直流与交流。(f)共用R_e1：直流和交流电流串联负反馈；R_f1/R_f2：仅直流跨级电压并联负反馈，交流被C₂隔断。
answer.en: (a) R₁/R₂, (b) A₂/R₃, (c) R₆, (d) R₁/R₂ and (e) R_f all give negative feedback at DC and AC. (f) Shared R_e1 gives DC/AC current-series negative feedback; R_f1/R_f2 give DC interstage voltage-shunt negative feedback, interrupted at AC by C₂.

pitfalls.zh: (f)中C₂接地而非串联隔直，它通过交流短路中间节点切断R_f链的信号传输。
pitfalls.en: C₂ in (f) shunts the middle node to AC ground; it is not a series blocking capacitor.

pitfalls.zh: 局部反馈与跨级反馈要分清。
pitfalls.en: Distinguish local feedback from interstage feedback.

methods.zh: 逐图使用输出扰动法，与输入扰动法交叉核对负反馈极性；(f)另按C₂直流开路/交流短路重新画连接，确认交流仍存在共享射极R_e1反馈。
methods.en: Cross-checked output-perturbation and input-perturbation sign tracing for every circuit. For (f), separately redrew C₂ open at DC and short at AC, confirming that shared-emitter R_e1 feedback remains at AC.

assumptions.zh: 器件处于小信号放大区，运放线性；按题设中频电容短路，直流电容开路。
assumptions.en: Small-signal active devices and linear op amps; capacitors short at midband and open at DC.

f.Rf1_Rf2: negative dc only; C2 AC-grounds midpoint

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 反馈组态：输出短路测试，加上输入求和方式
title.en: Feedback topology: output-short test plus input mixing

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 试判断图题8.1.1所示各电路中，级间交流反馈的组态。
statement.en: Determine the interstage AC-feedback topology for every circuit in Fig. 8.1.1.

alt.zh: 图8.1.1的六图：(a)运放和射极跟随器，输出经R₂/R₁反馈到反相端；(b)A₂作电压跟随器，经R₃反馈到A₁反相求和点；(c)两运放串联，负载电流经过R₆，其电压返回A₁同相端；(d)运放驱动NMOS，源极经R₁接地，并经R₂回反相求和点，漏极R_d输出；(e)三级共源极，R_f从末级漏极回首级栅极；(f)三级PNP共射，T₁与T₃共用R_e1，R_f1/R_f2之间有接地电容C₂，输出经C₃耦合。
alt.en: Six circuits: (a) op amp plus emitter follower with R₂/R₁ feedback to the inverting input; (b) A₂ voltage follower returns through R₃ to A₁ summing node; (c) two op amps, with load-current sense resistor R₆ returning to A₁ non-inverting input; (d) op amp driving NMOS, source resistor R₁ and R₂ return to the summing node, drain-resistor output; (e) three common-source stages with R_f from final drain to first gate; (f) three PNP common-emitter stages, shared T₁/T₃ emitter resistor R_e1, and grounded C₂ at the R_f1/R_f2 junction, with C₃ output coupling.

prerequisites.zh: 电压/电流取样；串联/并联混合；交流通路。
prerequisites.en: Voltage/current sampling; series/shunt mixing; AC equivalent circuits.

recognition.zh: 输出短路后返回量消失的是电压取样，仍可由输出电流产生返回量的是电流取样；再看净输入是电压差还是电流和。
recognition.en: If shorting the output removes the feedback signal, sampling is voltage-based. If current still produces feedback, it is current-based. Then identify voltage subtraction versus current summation at the input.

text.zh: (a)输出电压分压送反相端，与同相输入电压相减，是电压串联。(b)输出电压由A₂缓冲后经R₃返回同一个反相求和点，是电压并联。
text.en: (a) A divided output voltage is subtracted from the non-inverting input: voltage-series. (b) A₂ buffers output voltage and R₃ returns current to the inverting summing node: voltage-shunt.

text.zh: (c)R₆与负载电流串联取样，返回A₁另一个输入端形成电压差，是电流串联。(d)源极支路取样MOS电流，R₂把反馈电流送回与输入R₁共用的求和点，是电流并联。
text.en: (c) R₆ samples load current and returns a voltage to the other A₁ input: current-series. (d) The source branch samples MOS current, with R₂ returning current to the same summing node as input R₁: current-shunt.

text.zh: (e)R_f跨输出电压与输入栅极求和点，是电压并联。(f)C₂切断电阻链交流跨级返回，剩下共享R_e1取样末级电流并改变首级射极电位，与基极输入相减，是电流串联。
text.en: (e) R_f connects output voltage to the input gate summing node: voltage-shunt. (f) C₂ interrupts the resistive interstage AC path; shared R_e1 samples final-stage current and changes the first emitter voltage, subtracting from base input: current-series.

answer.zh: (a)电压串联；(b)电压并联；(c)电流串联；(d)电流并联；(e)电压并联；(f)电流串联。各图均为负反馈。
answer.en: (a) Voltage-series. (b) Voltage-shunt. (c) Current-series. (d) Current-shunt. (e) Voltage-shunt. (f) Current-series. All are negative feedback.

pitfalls.zh: 不要仅凭“反馈电阻接输出端”判断电压反馈，要看被取样的具体电流/电压。
pitfalls.en: A resistor connected near an output does not by itself establish voltage feedback; identify the sampled quantity.

methods.zh: 输出短路测试与输入混合关系分别核对六图；特别(c)(d)(f)输出短路并不消除各电流取样支路中的反馈信号，(a)(b)(e)则消除电压返回量。
methods.en: Applied output-short and input-mixing tests independently to all six circuits. In particular, shorting the output does not remove the current-sampling signals in (c), (d) and (f), but removes the voltage feedback in (a), (b) and (e).

assumptions.zh: 中频小信号，题设电容容抗忽略。
assumptions.en: Midband small signal with negligible capacitor reactance.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 差分输入反馈：判断哪一支栅压抵消净输入
title.en: Differential-input feedback: identify the opposing gate signal

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 试判断图题8.1.7所示各电路中，级间交流反馈的极性及组态。
statement.en: Determine the polarity and topology of the interstage AC feedback in each circuit of Fig. 8.1.7.

alt.zh: 四图均以MOS差分级为输入。(a)T₂栅由末级T₃源电流经过R₃及R₁/R₂分压返回；(b)T₁栅接地，电流源输入T₂栅求和点，末级T₅源电流由R₂取样、经R₁返回；(c)输入T₁栅，T₃为PNP级，反馈由其集电极R₃及R₁/R₂送T₂栅，输出取T₃发射极；(d)末级源极输出直接送T₂栅。
alt.en: Four MOS differential-input circuits: (a) final T₃ source current is sampled by R₃ and divided by R₁/R₂ back to T₂ gate; (b) T₁ gate grounded, current-source input at the T₂ gate summing node, with final T₅ source current sensed by R₂ and returned through R₁; (c) PNP final T₃, collector current sampled through R₃ and R₁/R₂ to T₂ gate, with output at the emitter; (d) final source output directly returns to T₂ gate.

prerequisites.zh: 差分级电流转向；有源负载；电流取样与电压取样；输入混合。
prerequisites.en: Differential current steering; active loads; current/voltage sampling; input mixing.

recognition.zh: 差分级的两个栅输入极性相反，不能把左右支路都当作普通共源反相级。先追踪电流转向，再追末级和返回信号。
recognition.en: The two differential gates have opposite signal signs; do not treat both branches as ordinary common-source stages. Trace current steering, final-stage response, then the return signal.

text.zh: T₁输入升高使T₁电流增大、T₂电流减小，T₂漏电压升高，使T₃电流增大。其源极取样电压经R₂/R₁使T₂栅升高，促使T₂电流回升，抵消原来的差分输入；输出电流取样、栅极电压差混合。
text.en: Raising T₁ gate raises its current and lowers T₂ current, raising T₂ drain voltage and T₃ current. The source-sense voltage divided by R₂/R₁ raises T₂ gate and restores T₂ current, opposing the original differential input. Sampling is current-based and mixing is a gate-voltage difference.

text.zh: 输入电流进入T₂栅求和节点，栅压升高使T₂漏极节点下降，末级T₅电流下降，R₂取样节点下降，经R₁送回的电流减小，抵消输入作用。反馈与输入在同一节点按电流求和。
text.en: Input current enters the T₂ gate summing node. Increased gate voltage lowers its drain node and final T₅ current; the R₂ sense node falls and returns less current through R₁, opposing the input change. Input and feedback currents mix at one node.

text.zh: T₁栅升高使其漏极电压下降，PNP T₃基极下降，集电流大小增大；R₃上取样电压升高，经R₂/R₁提高T₂栅，抵消差分输入。输出取T₃发射极，但反馈取其集电流；不能仅看v_o端位置判断为电压反馈。
text.en: Raising T₁ gate lowers its drain and the PNP T₃ base, increasing collector-current magnitude. The R₃ sense voltage rises and raises T₂ gate through R₂/R₁, opposing the differential input. The output is at T₃ emitter, but feedback samples collector current; the v_o terminal alone does not make this voltage feedback.

text.zh: T₁栅升高经差分有源负载使T₅栅升高，源极输出升高；输出直接提高T₂栅，减小差分净输入。输出电压直接取样，与T₁输入构成电压差。
text.en: Raising T₁ gate raises the T₅ gate through the active-loaded differential stage, raising its source output. Direct return to T₂ gate reduces the differential input. This samples voltage and mixes a voltage difference.

answer.zh: (a)电流串联负反馈；(b)电流并联负反馈；(c)电流串联负反馈；(d)电压串联负反馈。
answer.en: (a) Negative current-series. (b) Negative current-shunt. (c) Negative current-series. (d) Negative voltage-series.

pitfalls.zh: (c)取样端不是标注v_o的端点，必须检查实际反馈网络。
pitfalls.en: In (c), sampling is not at the labeled v_o terminal; inspect the actual return network.

methods.zh: 对每图独立做输入正扰动和反馈端正扰动，两者对差分净输入的作用相反；输出短路测试将(a)(b)(c)的电流取样与(d)电压取样区分开。
methods.en: Independently traced positive input and feedback-terminal perturbations; they oppose one another at the differential input. The output-short test separates current sampling in (a), (b), (c) from voltage sampling in (d).

assumptions.zh: 晶体管均工作于小信号放大区；恒流源为理想；差分有源负载按图中连接。
assumptions.en: All transistors in small-signal active regions, ideal current sources, active loads connected as drawn.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 负反馈方框图：分清输入、反馈与净输入
title.en: Feedback block diagram: distinguish input, feedback and error

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 某反馈放大电路的方框图如图题8.2.1所示，已知其开环电压增益A_v=2000，反馈系数F_v=0.0495。若输出电压v_o=2 V，求输入电压v_i、反馈电压v_f及净输入电压v_id的值。
statement.en: For the feedback amplifier in Fig. 8.2.1, open-loop voltage gain A_v=2000 and feedback factor F_v=0.0495. If v_o=2 V, find input v_i, feedback v_f and net input v_id.

alt.zh: 输入求和点v_id=v_i−v_f，前向增益A_v，输出经F_v返回负号端。
alt.en: Summing junction v_id=v_i−v_f, forward gain A_v, with output returned through F_v to the negative input.

prerequisites.zh: 负反馈方框图代数；反馈深度；增益定义。
prerequisites.en: Feedback block algebra; feedback depth; gain definitions.

recognition.zh: 已知输出时先沿两条路径分别反求净输入和反馈，再用求和关系求外部输入，最不易混淆。
recognition.en: With output known, separately recover error and feedback from the two paths, then use the summing relation for external input.

text.zh: A_v乘的是净输入v_id，而非外部输入v_i。
text.en: A_v multiplies net input v_id, not external input v_i.

title.zh: 由反馈系数求反馈电压

text.zh: 反馈系数定义v_f/v_o。
text.en: The feedback factor is v_f/v_o.

text.zh: 负反馈v_id=v_i−v_f，所以外部输入是净输入与反馈之和。
text.en: Negative feedback means v_id=v_i−v_f, so external input is their sum.

answer.zh: v_i=100 mV，v_f=99 mV，v_id=1 mV。
answer.en: v_i=100 mV, v_f=99 mV, v_id=1 mV.

pitfalls.zh: v_id不是v_i；两者相差反馈电压99 mV。
pitfalls.en: v_id is not v_i; they differ by the 99 mV feedback voltage.

methods.en: Independent substitution gives 2000(0.100−0.099)=2 V and 0.0495×2=0.099 V. Closed-loop gain 2/0.1=20 matches A/(1+AF).

assumptions.zh: 线性静态方框图，图中负号连接，给定增益与反馈系数均为实数。
assumptions.en: Linear static block model with the shown subtractive junction and real stated gains.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 深反馈闭环增益：先定义输入输出量及电流方向
title.en: Deep-feedback gains: define input/output quantities and current signs

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题8.1.1a、b、d、e、f所示，试在深度负反馈条件下，近似计算它们的闭环增益和闭环电压增益。
statement.en: For circuits (a), (b), (d), (e) and (f) of Fig. 8.1.1, approximately calculate their closed-loop gain and closed-loop voltage gain under deep negative feedback.

alt.zh: 图8.1.1的六图：(a)运放和射极跟随器，输出经R₂/R₁反馈到反相端；(b)A₂作电压跟随器，经R₃反馈到A₁反相求和点；(c)两运放串联，负载电流经过R₆，其电压返回A₁同相端；(d)运放驱动NMOS，源极经R₁接地，并经R₂回反相求和点，漏极R_d输出；(e)三级共源极，R_f从末级漏极回首级栅极；(f)三级PNP共射，T₁与T₃共用R_e1，R_f1/R_f2之间有接地电容C₂，输出经C₃耦合。
alt.en: Six circuits: (a) op amp plus emitter follower with R₂/R₁ feedback to the inverting input; (b) A₂ voltage follower returns through R₃ to A₁ summing node; (c) two op amps, with load-current sense resistor R₆ returning to A₁ non-inverting input; (d) op amp driving NMOS, source resistor R₁ and R₂ return to the summing node, drain-resistor output; (e) three common-source stages with R_f from final drain to first gate; (f) three PNP common-emitter stages, shared T₁/T₃ emitter resistor R_e1, and grounded C₂ at the R_f1/R_f2 junction, with C₃ output coupling.

prerequisites.zh: 深反馈净输入趋零；四种闭环增益单位；节点KCL；反馈网络加载。
prerequisites.en: Near-zero error under deep feedback; units of four gain types; nodal KCL; feedback-network loading.

recognition.zh: 电压并联的基本闭环增益是跨阻，电流串联是跨导；先定义量，才不会把不同单位的增益当成同一个数。电流取样支路会分流，需列KCL。
recognition.en: Voltage-shunt feedback gives a transresistance; current-series feedback gives a transconductance. Define the quantities before comparing gains with different units. Current-sense branches divide current, so use KCL.

text.zh: 运放两输入端交流电位近似相等，反馈分压节点等于v_i，输出包含射极跟随器且由总环路校正。
text.en: The op-amp inputs are nearly equal, so the feedback divider node equals v_i. The overall loop includes and corrects the emitter follower.

text.zh: A₂为理想电压跟随器，送回R₃的电压为v_o。A₁反相求和点近似零，正输入电流i_i=v_i/R₁由R₃返回输出。
text.en: A₂ is a voltage follower, returning v_o through R₃. The A₁ summing node is nearly zero; positive input current i_i=v_i/R₁ returns through R₃.

title.zh: (d) 电流并联：必须保留R₂的反馈电流

text.zh: 定义i_i=v_i/R₁流入求和点，i_o=i_D沿漏极流入MOS。运放反相节点≈0，KCL给v_s=−R₂i_i。源极电流分到R₁与R₂两条通路，因此i_D=v_s(1/R₁+1/R₂)，不能只取v_s/R₁。输出v_o=−R_di_D。
text.en: Define i_i=v_i/R₁ entering the summing node and i_o=i_D entering the MOS drain. The inverting node is nearly zero, so KCL gives v_s=−R₂i_i. Source current divides through both R₁ and R₂, giving i_D=v_s(1/R₁+1/R₂), not just v_s/R₁. Output is v_o=−R_di_D.

text.zh: 三级放大使总开环反相增益很大，首级栅极求和点近似零，MOS栅电流为零。定义i_i=v_s/R_si，KCL给i_i=−v_o/R_f。电压增益以图中源电压v_s为输入，实际首级栅电压是净输入而非外部信号。
text.en: With large inverting three-stage gain, the first gate summing node is nearly zero and gate current is zero. Define i_i=v_s/R_si; KCL gives i_i=−v_o/R_f. Voltage gain is referenced to the diagram’s source v_s; the actual first gate voltage is the error, not the external signal.

title.zh: (f) 电流串联，中频输出负载包含R_f2
title.en: (f) Current-series, with R_f2 loading the output at midband

text.zh: C₂把电阻链中点交流接地，因此R_f2与R_c3共同加载输出；共享R_e1仍反馈末级电流。采用本章常见深反馈近似：忽略T₁射极增量电流相对T₃，并取T₃集电流≈射极电流，净输入v_be1≈0，故v_e1≈v_i。定义i_o为流入T₃集电极的带符号增量，i_o≈v_i/R_e1；输出v_o=−i_o(R_c3∥R_f2)。
text.en: C₂ AC-grounds the resistive-chain junction, so R_f2 loads the output in parallel with R_c3. Shared R_e1 still feeds back final-stage current. Use the chapter’s usual deep-feedback approximation: neglect T₁ emitter-current increment relative to T₃, and approximate T₃ collector current by emitter current. Near-zero v_be1 gives v_e1≈v_i. With i_o defined as the signed increment entering the T₃ collector, i_o≈v_i/R_e1, and v_o=−i_o(R_c3∥R_f2).

answer.zh: (a)A_f=A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁；(b)A_f≈−R₃ Ω，A_vf≈−R₃/R₁；(d)按所定义电流方向A_f≈−(1+R₂/R₁)，A_vf≈(R_d/R₁)(1+R₂/R₁)；(e)A_f≈−R_f Ω，v_o/v_s≈−R_f/R_si；(f)A_f≈1/R_e1 S，A_vf≈−(R_c3∥R_f2)/R_e1，后者另采用首级射极电流可忽略、末级β大近似。
answer.en: (a) A_f=A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁. (b) A_f≈−R₃ Ω, A_vf≈−R₃/R₁. (d) With defined current signs, A_f≈−(1+R₂/R₁), A_vf≈(R_d/R₁)(1+R₂/R₁). (e) A_f≈−R_f Ω, v_o/v_s≈−R_f/R_si. (f) A_f≈1/R_e1 S, A_vf≈−(R_c3∥R_f2)/R_e1, additionally neglecting first-stage emitter current and assuming large final-stage beta.

pitfalls.zh: (d)R₂也承载取样电流；漏掉它会把1+R₂/R₁错写为R₂/R₁。
pitfalls.en: R₂ in (d) also carries sense current; omitting it incorrectly changes 1+R₂/R₁ into R₂/R₁.

pitfalls.zh: 电流增益正负号依赖所规定的i_o方向，本解已明确方向。
pitfalls.en: Current-gain signs depend on the defined i_o direction, stated here.

pitfalls.zh: (f)C₂交流短路后R_f2成为输出负载，不可从交流电路删除。
pitfalls.en: After C₂ becomes an AC short, R_f2 loads the output and must remain.

methods.zh: (a)(b)(d)(e)独立用理想输入条件列节点KCL，尤其(d)同时检查输入求和节点和MOS源节点；(f)用共享射极节点KCL及输出负载KCL验证所列近似，并明确忽略项。
methods.en: Independently wrote nodal KCL under ideal input conditions for (a), (b), (d), (e), checking both input and MOS-source nodes in (d). For (f), shared-emitter and output-load KCL verify the stated approximation, with neglected terms explicit.

assumptions.zh: 中频深度负反馈，器件放大区、忽略Early效应与沟道长度调制，取器件输出电阻r_o/r_ds→∞；(f)另忽略首级射极电流并近似末级I_C≈I_E。
assumptions.en: Midband deep negative feedback, active devices and device output resistances r_o/r_ds→∞ (Early effect/channel-length modulation neglected); (f) additionally neglects first-stage emitter current and uses final-stage I_C≈I_E.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 按跨级环路判断深反馈，再核对加载
title.en: Check global loop depth, then loading

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题8.4.3所示，试在深度负反馈的条件下，近似计算它的闭环电压增益。
statement.en: For Fig. 8.4.3, approximately calculate the closed-loop voltage gain under deep negative feedback.

alt.zh: T₁为NMOS，漏极经R_d接V_DD并驱动PNP T₂基极；T₂发射极经R_e接V_DD，集电极为v_o。T₁源极经R₁接地，并经R₂接v_o；栅极为v_i且R_g接地。
alt.en: NMOS T₁ drain through R_d to V_DD drives PNP T₂ base. T₂ emitter through R_e to V_DD, collector at v_o. T₁ source connects through R₁ to ground and R₂ to v_o. Input v_i is at the gate, with R_g to ground.

prerequisites.zh: MOS源极KCL；PNP带射极电阻的小信号输入；深反馈近似的适用条件。
prerequisites.en: MOS-source KCL; emitter-degenerated PNP input model; conditions for deep-feedback approximations.

recognition.zh: 本题问跨级深度负反馈下的近似增益，考试结论为1+R₂/R₁。要把“跨级环路很深”与“仅MOS互导很大”区分；后者单独不能保证反馈分压不被源极电流加载。
recognition.en: The requested deep global-feedback approximation gives the exam result 1+R₂/R₁. Distinguish a large interstage loop gain from merely large MOS transconductance; the latter alone does not ensure negligible source-current loading of the divider.

title.zh: 考试主线：跨级深负反馈的电压增益
title.en: Exam route: voltage gain with deep global feedback

text.zh: T₁共源与T₂共射两次反相，输出升高经R₂提高T₁源极，减小净输入v_gs1，为电压串联负反馈。按授课课件的跨级深反馈近似，v_s≈v_i，且首级源极电流相对跨级反馈电流可忽略，R₁/R₂形成近似不加载的反馈分压。因此以实际栅极电压v_i定义的闭环增益如下，R_g不引入额外源分压。
text.en: Common-source T₁ and common-emitter T₂ invert twice. A higher output raises the T₁ source through R₂ and reduces v_gs1, giving negative voltage-series feedback. Under the course’s deep global-feedback approximation, v_s≈v_i and first-stage source current is negligible relative to interstage feedback current, so R₁/R₂ form an approximately unloaded feedback divider. The gain below is referred to actual gate voltage v_i; R_g adds no source-divider factor.

title.zh: 保留加载：从原图列有限参数KCL
title.en: Retain loading: finite-parameter KCL from the original

text.zh: 取V_DD为交流地，T₁源极为v_s，T₂带符号基流i_b2定义为流入基极的增量；Z_b=r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e。漏极/基极节点给i_b2=−i_D/(1+Z_b/R_d)，输出节点给(v_o−v_s)/R₂+β₂i_b2=0，源节点给v_s/R₁+(v_s−v_o)/R₂=i_D。再用i_D=g_m1(v_i−v_s)，得到有限参数下的一般增益。
text.en: With V_DD at AC ground, let v_s be the T₁ source voltage and define signed incremental i_b2 entering the T₂ base. Set Z_b=r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e. Drain/base KCL gives i_b2=−i_D/(1+Z_b/R_d); output KCL gives (v_o−v_s)/R₂+β₂i_b2=0; source KCL gives v_s/R₁+(v_s−v_o)/R₂=i_D. Combining these with i_D=g_m1(v_i−v_s) gives the finite-parameter gain.

title.zh: 用跨级环路增益核对“深度”条件
title.en: Check depth using the interstage loop gain

text.zh: 把源极局部退化吸收到前向通道，令a=m/(1+m)、T_global=aD。一般式可严格重写为下式。T_global≫1时趋于考试答案1+r；而T_global≤D，所以跨级环路足够深本身要求D很大，源极电流的加载修正随之变小。不是只检查g_m1R₁(1+D)≫1就足够。
text.en: Absorb local source degeneration into the forward path and set a=m/(1+m), T_global=aD. The general gain rewrites exactly as below. For T_global≫1 it approaches the exam result 1+r. Since T_global≤D, deep interstage feedback itself requires large D, making the source-current loading correction small. Merely checking g_m1R₁(1+D)≫1 is insufficient.

steps.formula: a=\frac{m}{1+m};\quad T_{\rm global}=aD;\qquad G=\frac{a+T_{\rm global}(1+r)}{1+T_{\rm global}};\qquad (1+r)-G=\frac{1+r-a}{1+T_{\rm global}}

title.zh: 拓展检查：仅增大MOS互导的极限
title.en: Further check: increasing MOS transconductance alone

text.zh: 若只令g_m1→∞而D保持有限，会得到1+rD/(1+D)，其中保留了源极电流加载。这个结果描述v_gs1很小的局部极限，不能当成“跨级全局深反馈”的替代答案。若需评估实际器件误差，使用一般有限参数式；题目没有给数值参数，不据此虚构数值增益。
text.en: If only g_m1→∞ while D stays finite, gain becomes 1+rD/(1+D), retaining source-current loading. This is a local small-v_gs1 limit, not a replacement for the deep global-feedback answer. Use the general finite-parameter expression to assess a real device’s error. No numerical gain is invented because the problem supplies no device values.

answer.zh: 按本题跨级深度负反馈近似，A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁，为同相增益。条件为跨级环路T_global=[g_m1R₁/(1+g_m1R₁)]·β₂/[1+(r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e)/R_d]≫1；仅g_m1很大不等于满足此条件。有限参数加载修正见推导。
answer.en: Under the requested deep interstage negative-feedback approximation, A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁, a noninverting gain. The condition is T_global=[g_m1R₁/(1+g_m1R₁)]·β₂/[1+(r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e)/R_d]≫1; large g_m1 alone does not establish it. See the derivation for finite-parameter loading corrections.

pitfalls.zh: 考试主线用题设跨级深反馈条件，不要用仅g_m1→∞的有限D极限替代它。
pitfalls.en: Use the stated deep interstage-feedback condition for the exam answer; do not substitute the finite-D limit obtained by g_m1→∞ alone.

pitfalls.zh: MOS栅极电流为零，不代表源极电流恒为零；加载能否忽略要由环路与电流比验证。
pitfalls.en: Zero gate current does not imply zero source current. Check loop gain and current ratios before neglecting loading.

methods.zh: 依据课件第8章第47、70、80页关于1+AF≫1的深反馈定义；独立按原图源极、漏极/基极、T₂发射极及输出节点列MNA，与一般有限参数式交叉核验。再把局部源极退化并入前向，代数上严格重写为[a+T_global(1+r)]/(1+T_global)，证明真正跨级T_global≫1时趋向1+R₂/R₁。有限D、g_m1→∞的加载式仅标为另一极限，不用于替代题设答案。合成参数检查不冒充教材数据；未使用外部标准答案。
methods.en: Used the course slides, chapter 8 slides 47, 70 and 80, defining deep feedback by 1+AF≫1. Independent original-node MNA at source, drain/base, T₂ emitter and output agrees with the general finite-parameter expression. Absorbing local source degeneration into the forward path rewrites it exactly as [a+T_global(1+r)]/(1+T_global), proving convergence to 1+R₂/R₁ for deep interstage T_global≫1. The finite-D, g_m1→∞ loading expression is identified only as a different limit, not substituted for the requested answer. Synthetic checks are not presented as textbook values; no external answer key was used.

assumptions.zh: 中频小信号，两管具有正确偏置并处于放大区；忽略Early效应与沟道长度调制，取r_o/r_ds→∞。考试近似另要求跨级T_global≫1；一般式保留有限g_m1、β₂、r_be2与电阻加载。
assumptions.en: Midband small signal with both devices correctly biased in active operation; r_o/r_ds→∞, neglecting Early effect and channel-length modulation. The exam approximation additionally requires interstage T_global≫1. The general expression retains finite g_m1, β₂, r_be2 and resistor loading.

externalReferences.title: COCOA · Introduction to Feedback (loading and return-ratio analysis)
