completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 先高通分压，再乘同相增益
title.en: High-pass division followed by noninverting gain

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图题10.2.3所示为一阶高通滤波器电路，设A为理想运放，试推导电路的传递函数，并画出其幅频响应波特图，求−3 dB截止角频率ω_L。
statement.en: Figure 10.2.3 is a first-order high-pass filter. With ideal op amp A, derive its transfer function, draw its magnitude Bode plot and find the −3 dB cutoff angular frequency ω_L.

alt.zh: 输入v_i经串联电容C接运放同相端，同相端经R接地；反相端经R₁接地、经R_f接输出v_o。
alt.en: Input v_i reaches the noninverting input through series C, with R from that input to ground. The inverting input connects through R₁ to ground and R_f to output v_o.

prerequisites.zh: 复阻抗分压；理想运放虚短/虚断；同相放大；−3 dB定义。
prerequisites.en: Complex-impedance division; ideal op-amp input conditions; noninverting gain; the −3 dB definition.

recognition.zh: 电容在输入串联支路，低频时隔断信号。先求同相端v_p，再求运放比例，不能把R误当作R₁。
recognition.en: Series input C blocks low-frequency signals. Find v_p first, then the amplifier gain; R and R₁ are different components.

text.zh: 运放输入电流为零，同相端只由串联C、对地R分压决定。
text.en: Zero op-amp input current leaves a series C and shunt R divider.

title.zh: 同相放大与总传递函数

text.zh: 反相节点电压等于同相节点，R₁与R_f的电流相等。定义高频通带增益A₀=1+R_f/R₁。
text.en: The inverting and noninverting voltages are equal; R₁ and R_f carry equal currents. Define high-frequency passband gain A₀=1+R_f/R₁.

title.zh: 幅频、截止频率和波特图

text.zh: 幅值从直流0趋向高频A₀。截止处幅值为通带的1/√2，约低3.0103 dB。低频渐近线斜率+20 dB/十倍频，高频水平于20log₁₀A₀。附图纵轴减去了通带分贝值。
text.en: Magnitude rises from zero at DC to A₀ at high frequency. At cutoff it is A₀/√2, about 3.0103 dB below passband. The low-frequency asymptote rises at +20 dB/decade; the high-frequency level is 20log₁₀A₀. The plot subtracts the passband dB level.

answer.zh: A_v(s)=(1+R_f/R₁)sRC/(1+sRC)，ω_L=1/(RC) rad/s。低频+20 dB/十倍频，高频增益1+R_f/R₁，截止点相对通带−3.0103 dB。
answer.en: A_v(s)=(1+R_f/R₁)sRC/(1+sRC), ω_L=1/(RC) rad/s. The low-frequency slope is +20 dB/decade; high-frequency gain is 1+R_f/R₁, with cutoff 3.0103 dB below passband.

pitfalls.zh: ω_L是角频率；若求Hz需再除2π。
pitfalls.en: ω_L is angular frequency; divide by 2π for Hz.

pitfalls.zh: −3 dB相对通带增益，而非固定输出增益−3 dB。
pitfalls.en: The −3 dB level is relative to passband, not an absolute gain of −3 dB.

methods.zh: 从原图分别列同相端jωC(v_p−v_i)+v_p/R=0、反相端v_n/R₁+(v_n−v_o)/R_f=0及v_n=v_p，直接数值解节点，在归一化频率0.01、0.1、1、10、100处与传递函数一致；截止处归一化模平方恰为1/2；直流和高频极限相符。
methods.en: Independently solved the original noninverting-node equation jωC(v_p−v_i)+v_p/R=0, inverting-node equation v_n/R₁+(v_n−v_o)/R_f=0 and v_n=v_p. Direct node solutions at normalized frequencies 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10 and 100 agree with the transfer function; normalized magnitude squared is exactly 1/2 at cutoff, and both endpoint limits agree.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放线性负反馈、零输入电流、无限开环增益；R、R₁、R_f、C均为正，忽略真实运放带宽限制。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, zero input current and infinite open-loop gain; positive R, R₁, R_f and C. Real op-amp bandwidth limits are excluded.

alt.zh: 一阶高通归一化幅频波特图；纵轴相对通带增益，横轴ω/ω_L。
alt.en: Normalized high-pass Bode magnitude relative to passband gain, versus ω/ω_L.

title.zh: 按储能元件和连接判断阶数
title.en: Determine order from storage elements and connections

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设A为理想运放，试写出图题10.3.4所示电路的传递函数，指出这是一个什么类型的滤波电路。
statement.en: With ideal op amp A, write the transfer function of Fig. 10.3.4 and identify the filter type.

alt.zh: v_i经R₁、电容C串联接运放反相端；反相端经R_f接输出，同相端接地。
alt.en: Input v_i passes through series R₁ and C to the inverting input. R_f connects that input to the output; the noninverting input is grounded.

prerequisites.zh: 反相运放；输入复阻抗；低频和高频极限。
prerequisites.en: Inverting op amp; complex input impedance; low/high-frequency limits.

recognition.zh: 输入阻抗是R₁+1/(sC)，不是并联。题目位于高阶滤波章节，但本图只有一个独立储能电容，传递函数是一阶。
recognition.en: Input impedance is R₁+1/(sC), not a parallel combination. Although placed in the higher-order-filter section, this figure has one independent capacitor and a first-order transfer function.

text.zh: 虚地v_n=0，运放输入电流为零；输入串联支路电流全部流过R_f。
text.en: The inverting node is at virtual ground, v_n=0, with zero op-amp input current. All input-branch current flows through R_f.

text.zh: 分子在s=0有零点，分母为一次式。直流被隔断，高频时电容短路而恢复普通反相比例放大。
text.en: There is a zero at s=0 and a first-order denominator. DC is blocked; at high frequency C becomes a short, recovering an ordinary inverting amplifier.

title.en: Check filter type using endpoint limits

text.zh: 直流增益0，高频增益−R_f/R₁，故为反相一阶高通，R_f决定通带增益，R₁C决定截止频率。
text.en: DC gain is zero and high-frequency gain is −R_f/R₁. It is therefore an inverting first-order high-pass filter. R_f sets passband gain while R₁C sets cutoff.

answer.zh: A_v(s)=−sCR_f/(1+sCR₁)，是一阶反相高通滤波电路；ω_L=1/(R₁C)。
answer.en: A_v(s)=−sCR_f/(1+sCR₁), an inverting first-order high-pass filter, with ω_L=1/(R₁C).

pitfalls.zh: 不能根据章节名称直接断言本题是二阶滤波。
pitfalls.en: Do not infer second order from the chapter heading.

pitfalls.zh: R₁与C串联，不能把输入阻抗写成R₁∥1/(sC)。
pitfalls.en: R₁ and C are in series; input impedance is not R₁∥1/(sC).

methods.zh: 独立保留R₁/C之间节点v_x：列(v_x−v_i)/R₁+jωCv_x=0、−jωCv_x−v_o/R_f=0，并与传递函数做多频点复数对照；单极点−1/(R₁C)位于左半平面，直流0和高频−R_f/R₁均回代成立。
methods.en: Retained the original intermediate node v_x between R₁ and C and independently solved (v_x−v_i)/R₁+jωCv_x=0 and −jωCv_x−v_o/R_f=0. Complex solutions agree across multiple frequencies. The sole pole −1/(R₁C) is in the left half-plane; DC zero and high-frequency gain −R_f/R₁ both check.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放线性负反馈、正电阻电容、零初始条件的拉普拉斯传递函数。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, positive resistors/capacitor and zero-initial-condition Laplace transfer function.

completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 先比较v₂−v₁，再沿交点画输出
title.en: Compare v₂−v₁ and switch at each intersection

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题10.8.2a所示，其输入电压的波形如图题10.8.2b所示，已知输出电压v_o的最大值为±10 V，运放是理想的，试画出输出电压v_o的波形。
statement.en: The circuit and its input waveforms are shown in Fig. 10.8.2(a) and (b). The output limits are ±10 V and the op amp is ideal. Draw output waveform v_o.

alt.zh: v₁接反相端、v₂接同相端，各有5.1 kΩ对地电阻；输出负载5.1 kΩ。图b中v₁先于v₂，起点v₁=0且v₂<0，两条近似同幅正弦曲线依次相交，未给数值幅值、周期或相位差。
alt.en: v₁ drives the inverting input and v₂ the noninverting input, each with 5.1 kΩ to ground; load is 5.1 kΩ. In Fig. (b), v₁ leads v₂, initially v₁=0 and v₂<0. The roughly equal-amplitude sinusoidal sketches cross repeatedly; no numerical amplitudes, period or phase difference are specified.

prerequisites.zh: 理想比较器；同相/反相输入符号；两信号大小比较。
prerequisites.en: Ideal comparators; input polarities; comparison of two signal levels.

recognition.zh: 这是开环比较器，不能套用虚短。输出符号由同相端减反相端决定，即v₂−v₁。
recognition.en: This is an open-loop comparator, so virtual-short analysis does not apply. Output sign follows noninverting minus inverting input, v₂−v₁.

text.zh: 理想运放无输入电流，5.1 kΩ对地电阻不改变理想电压源给定的输入。输出在题给±10 V间切换。
text.en: The ideal op amp draws no input current. The grounded 5.1 kΩ resistors do not change input voltages imposed by ideal sources. Output switches between the specified ±10 V limits.

steps.formula: v_2>v_1\Rightarrow v_o=+10\,\mathrm V;\qquad v_2<v_1\Rightarrow v_o=-10\,\mathrm V

text.zh: 按时间从左向右把输入交点记为t₁、t₂、t₃。起始v₂<v₁，输出−10 V；第一交点后v₂>v₁，输出+10 V；第二交点后回−10 V；第三交点后再+10 V。附图是定性重绘，交点定义切换时刻，不添加原题没有给出的时间、相位数值。
text.en: Label the successive input intersections t₁, t₂, t₃. Initially v₂<v₁, giving −10 V; after t₁, v₂>v₁ gives +10 V; after t₂ output returns to −10 V; after t₃ it returns to +10 V. The attached reconstruction is qualitative: intersections define switching times, without adding numerical time or phase data absent from the problem.

title.zh: 交点及理想模型的边界

text.zh: 恰好v₁=v₂时，理想无偏置比较器不唯一规定输出电平；画竖直跳变即可，不应硬指定为0 V。真实器件会受输入失调、延迟等影响，题目不要求这些参数。
text.en: At exactly v₁=v₂, the ideal zero-offset comparator does not uniquely determine an output level. Draw a vertical transition rather than assigning 0 V. Real offsets and delays lie outside the stated problem.

answer.zh: v₂>v₁时v_o=+10 V，v₂<v₁时v_o=−10 V；图示初始为−10 V，之后在相邻输入交点依次切换为+10、−10、+10 V。
answer.en: v_o=+10 V for v₂>v₁ and −10 V for v₂<v₁. The shown waveform starts at −10 V, then switches to +10, −10 and +10 V at successive input intersections.

pitfalls.zh: 反相端接v₁，不能按v₁−v₂决定输出正负。
pitfalls.en: v₁ is the inverting input; do not determine output sign from v₁−v₂.

pitfalls.zh: 未给数值相位或周期，只能依据交点给出定性波形。
pitfalls.en: Numerical phase and period are unspecified; the waveform is defined qualitatively by intersections.

methods.zh: 逐段对照原图两条输入曲线的上下关系，并在每个交点左右检查v₂−v₁的符号。输出电平严格采用题给±10 V，不误用电源±12 V；原图起点及交点顺序与定性输出一致。
methods.en: Checked which original input curve is higher in each interval and the sign of v₂−v₁ on both sides of every intersection. Output levels use the specified ±10 V rather than ±12 V supply rails; initial sign and switching order match the original sketch.

assumptions.zh: 理想开环比较器，输入为题给理想电压波形，输出限幅±10 V；忽略传播延时与失调，输入相等时不唯一。
assumptions.en: Ideal open-loop comparator driven by the given ideal voltage waveforms, output limited to ±10 V. Delay and offset are neglected; equal inputs do not determine a unique level.

alt.zh: 定性重绘输入与输出：t₁、t₂、t₃为输入交点，输出依次−10、+10、−10、+10 V；未假设原题未给的数值相位。
alt.en: Qualitative reconstruction: t₁,t₂,t₃ are input intersections; output levels are −10,+10,−10,+10 V. No numerical source phase is assumed.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 正反馈产生两个门限：随输出状态分别求
title.en: Positive feedback gives two state-dependent thresholds

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设运放为理想器件，试求图题10.8.4所示电压比较器的门限电压，并画出它的传输特性（图中V_Z=9 V）。
statement.en: With an ideal op amp, find the comparator thresholds and draw the transfer characteristic for Fig. 10.8.4, where V_Z=9 V.

alt.zh: 反相端接地；v_i经R₁=5 kΩ到同相节点v_p；输出v_o经R₂=15 kΩ反馈到v_p。运放输出经R₃=5 kΩ到限幅后的v_o，双向稳压管将v_o限制在±V_Z=±9 V。
alt.en: Inverting input is grounded. Input v_i reaches noninverting node v_p through R₁=5 kΩ; v_o returns through R₂=15 kΩ. The op-amp output reaches the clamped output v_o through R₃=5 kΩ; the bidirectional limiter holds v_o at ±V_Z=±9 V.

prerequisites.zh: 正反馈比较器；节点KCL；稳态一致性；滞回方向。
prerequisites.en: Positive-feedback comparators; nodal KCL; state consistency; hysteresis direction.

recognition.zh: 输出返回同相端，所以有记忆、两个门限。先固定输出为+9 V或−9 V，再令v_p=v_n=0求翻转边界；不要先套线性运放虚短。
recognition.en: Output returns to the noninverting input, producing memory and two thresholds. Fix output at +9 or −9 V, then set v_p=v_n=0 only at the switching boundary. Do not apply a linear virtual short throughout.

text.zh: 输入电流为零，v_p由v_i与限幅后v_o加权决定。反馈取样点在R₃之后，因此门限用±9 V。
text.en: Zero input current makes v_p the weighted average of v_i and the clamped v_o. Feedback samples after R₃, so thresholds use ±9 V.

text.zh: 此前输出为低电平−9 V。输入上升至v_p=0时满足3v_i−9=0，于+3 V跳到+9 V。
text.en: Starting from low output −9 V, increasing input reaches v_p=0 when 3v_i−9=0. At +3 V output switches upward to +9 V.

text.zh: 此前输出为高电平+9 V。输入下降至3v_i+9=0，于−3 V跳到−9 V。两个门限之间两种状态都可自洽，取决于历史。
text.en: Starting from high output +9 V, decreasing input reaches 3v_i+9=0 and switches down at −3 V. Both output states are consistent between thresholds, so history determines the state.

text.zh: 上升扫描：保持−9 V到+3 V后跳到+9 V。下降扫描：保持+9 V到−3 V后跳到−9 V。v_i>3 V唯一高电平，v_i<−3 V唯一低电平；中间保持先前状态。
text.en: Increasing sweep: stay at −9 V until +3 V, then jump to +9 V. Decreasing sweep: stay at +9 V until −3 V, then jump to −9 V. Above +3 V only high output is consistent; below −3 V only low output is consistent; between thresholds retain the previous state.

answer.zh: 同相滞回比较器；上门限V_T+=+3 V，下门限V_T−=−3 V，滞回宽度6 V。输出±9 V；上升输入在+3 V由低跳高，下降输入在−3 V由高跳低。
answer.en: Noninverting Schmitt comparator: upper threshold +3 V, lower threshold −3 V, hysteresis width 6 V and output ±9 V. Rising input switches low-to-high at +3 V; falling input switches high-to-low at −3 V.

pitfalls.zh: 门限来自±9 V限幅输出，而非未给出的运放饱和电压。
pitfalls.en: Use the ±9 V clamped output, not an unspecified op-amp saturation voltage.

pitfalls.zh: −3<V_i<3 V时输出与先前状态有关，不是一个单值线性函数。
pitfalls.en: For −3<V_i<3 V, output depends on history; it is not a single-valued linear function.

methods.zh: 独立逐状态检查比较器一致性：v_o=+9时v_p>0要求v_i>−3；v_o=−9时v_p<0要求v_i<+3。边界分别−3和+3 V；以离散上升/下降输入扫描，检查每个稳态同时满足节点KCL、限幅及比较器符号，得到图示滞回方向。
methods.en: Independently checked state consistency: v_o=+9 requires v_p>0, hence v_i>−3; v_o=−9 requires v_p<0, hence v_i<+3. Boundaries are −3 and +3 V. Discrete rising/falling input sweeps satisfy node KCL, clamping and comparator sign in every stable state, reproducing the plotted hysteresis direction.

assumptions.zh: 按图中双向限幅±V_Z=±9 V建模，不另外加未给出的正向压降；理想比较器零输入电流，忽略延时，门限等值时为切换边界。
assumptions.en: Use the drawn bidirectional clamp ±V_Z=±9 V without adding an unspecified forward drop. Ideal comparator has zero input current and no delay; exact threshold equality is the switching boundary.

alt.zh: 同相滞回特性：上升输入在+3 V由−9跳到+9 V，下降输入在−3 V由+9跳到−9 V。
alt.en: Noninverting hysteresis: rising input switches −9 to +9 V at +3 V; falling input switches +9 to −9 V at −3 V.
